chapters.title: Chapter 151 - Four Side Missions
paragraphs: Evacuation?!
They had not even started yet and they had to evacuate?
Fang Heng and Mo Jiawei looked at each other.
No, the game wasn’t that simple!
Fang Heng asked, “Colonel Barker, what should I do?”
“I noticed that the creature that attacked the helicopter earlier was very similar to Tyrant that was discovered during the biochemical crisis three years ago.”
“However, Tyrant is unable to use weapons. The enemies that we have encountered have a higher level of intelligence than Tyrant.”
“[ think that it is most likely the latest product of Meteorite Company’s biological weapons project.”
Fang Heng listened to Barker’s narration and looked at Mo Jiawei beside him.
From a certain point of view, Mo Jiawei’s detection skills were also at a heaven-defying level.
With just a glance, he could obtain information that even the Dark Knights could not know.
After all, those who could join the Dark Knights were all top-tier players in the game.
‘Mo Jiawei continued to speak.
“Captain Barker, that’s nemesis, the product of implanting ne-a cells in Tyrant T103’s body.”
“ne-a cells?”
“Yes, it can form a ‘second brain’ in Tyrant’s body. I don’t know what exactly ne-a cells are, but this is also the first time I’ve heard of this name.”
“The information you provided is very useful. We have to relay this information back.”

“The headquarters of the Dark Knights in the outside world should have already learned about our attack. According to the backup plan, the Dark Knights will still send a few helicopters into the city at 2 pm tomorrow to investigate.”
Barker said in a deep voice, “So before that, we have to think of a way to get rid of the nemesis.”
‘When Mo Jiawei heard that, he panicked.
He looked helplessly at Fang Heng.
D*mn, were they going to kill a Tier 4 mutated zombie?
That was too ridiculous!
Fang Heng nodded calmly.
He had already expected it.
Thinking about it, it made sense.
‘With the nemesis standing in the middle of the city, no matter how many helicopters the Dark Knights sent, they would be shot down by the rocket launcher.
However, what should he do?
How could he kill the nemesis?
The strength of Tier 4 mutated zombies was self-evident.
It was different from before.
The environment in Pine City was too harsh.
In the past, when dealing with a Tier 4 mutated zombie, Fang Heng could still plan and make use of the terrain to gain an advantage.
‘As he was deep in thought, Fang Heng heard Barker continue, “Fang Heng, there’s something else that you need to know.”
“What?”
“This time, we entered Pine City to investigate with a special mission. Originally, I was going to give this mission to you.”
“But given the current situation, I’m afraid it’s a little difficult to complete this mission.”
Fang Heng’s interest was piqued, and he asked, “What’s the specific content of the mission?”
“About half a week ago, we discovered an unknown signal source when we were inspecting the periphery of Pine City.”
“The signal from the location signal source was very weak and intermittent, but after verification, it was a man-made distress signal.”
“We had tried to communicate with the other party, but the signal from the other party was very bad and difficult to communicate with.”
Fang Heng raised his eyebrows.
“Are you saying that there is still someone in the ruins of this city?”
“Yes.”

“The signal appeared at the Pine City Hospital. We are unable to confirm the identity of the survivor for the time being, but his ability to survive in such an extremely dangerous environment like Pine City is something that we are very concerned about.”
“If there is a chance, we still hope that you can go to the hospital to investigate.”
“Okay.”
Fang Heng agreed.
“Don’t force yourself. Safety first. The helicopter is scheduled to arrive at 2 pm tomorrow. We are very pressed for time. We must think of a way to get rid of the nemesis before then!”
“Lunderstand.”
“also, regarding Lucia, she is very strong on her own, but she is not a good leader.”
“Considering her ability and personality, I arranged for her to be in the logistics team.”
“Originally, the logistics team would not act alone. I did not expect such a thing to happen.”
“Consider it as my request. Help me take care of Lucia.”
Fang Heng agreed immediately.
“Okay.”
[Hint: Player has completed the sixth stage mission-desperation, triggering the seventh stage mission-desperate survivor.]
Mission name: Desperate survivor.
Mission difficulty: SSS.

Mission description: You have completed the maintenance of the communication tower base station and have contacted the captain of the team, Barker. The situation of the Dark Knights was very bad. Barker hoped that you could lead the team to evacuate safely from Pine City.
Main storyline requirements: Protect Lucia until 2 pm tomorrow, and try to clear the way for the team to leave Pine City.
Optional mission branch 1: Rescue the Barker team.
Difficulty: sss.
Optional mission branch 2: Find and rescue other survivor teams.
Difficulty: s.
Optional mission branch 3: Explore the distress signal in the hospital.
Difficulty: sss.
Optional mission branch 4: Kill or attempt to control nemesis so that it can not attack the helicopter.
Difficulty: sss
(Description: The completion rate of the side mission will change the difficulty of the main storyline mission. Please choose carefully.)
Communication with Barker was interrupted.
‘Mo Jiawei was expressionless.
D*mn it, four side missions.
None of them was reliable!
He felt that staying here and waiting for death was the most comfortable choice.
It would have been better if he was outside. At the very least, he would have spent some money to find a mercenary to help him.
However, a mercenary could not enter this godforsaken place at all!
‘Mo Jiawei turned his head to look at Fang Heng, placing his last hope on the God.
Fang Heng was checking the game log, analyzing the current mission difficulty and priority.
It was not good to stay in the same place and wait.
‘There was a high chance that the helicopter that came to support them would be shot down by the nemesis.
The most reliable one would be to kill the nemesis and completely solve the worries of the future.
If they wanted to kill the nemesis, it would be a little risky to rely on the strength of their team alone.
From the perspective of a player who had more than ten years of experience in his previous life, Fang Heng felt that he should start by rescuing his teammates.
Gradually gather up the lost team, accumulate strength and then rely on the strength of many NPCs to kill the nemesis!
As for the hospital’s distress signal, it might be an additional reward...
Fang Heng pressed his temples.
He knew that the King of Gods’ game had high flexibility, and players could use other methods to complete the mission.
Perhaps he could think of a way to completely restore the communication tower base station, and contact the rescue helicopter through the base station first to come tomorrow.
This way, he could buy more time...
‘Mo Jiawei didn’t know what Fang Heng was thinking. He asked in a low voice, “Fang Heng, there’s no way to survive this mission. What should we do?”
Fang Heng raised his head.
What should he do?
Of course, he had to complete all four side missions!
BY completing them, he would receive the highest level reward!
However, before that, he still needed to gather more effective information.
“Don’t worry, it might not be impossible. I’ll go offline first to see the situation.”
“What? Go offline?”
Mo Jiawei was stunned.
What the heck!! Could it be that God had an offline think tank team to come up with ideas?!
Mo Jiawei had heard of similar businesses in the past. At that time, he thought that it was an IQ tax.
Now that they had encountered such a situation, the advantage of an offline think tank team was displayed.
The mercenary group could not do anything to Pine City, but an offline think tank could at least come up with an idea, right?
God was still thoughtful.
He would follow after them!
It was just spending more money. Mo Jiawei did not care.
While Mo Jiawei was lost in his thoughts, Lucia walked over from the side..

chapters.title: Chapter 152 - Communication
paragraphs: After learning that Barker was safe, Lucia had completely calmed down.
She was very regretful for almost leading her team to their deaths.
“Fang Heng, thank you for what happened before. I’m very sorry. I was too impulsive. I’m very sorry!”
“It’s understandable, but there won’t be next time.”
Lucia lifted her head and raised her hand, making a solemn promise to Fang Heng.
“Yes! I promise!”
[Hint: Your favorability rating with Lucia has increased.]
Ha! Woman!
It was obvious that she was not sincere!
Such a promise would never work.
Fang Heng shook his head in his heart.
He couldn’t give her the chance to repeat the same mistake in the future!
However, her ability was good.
After all, she was an NPC with a name.
After thinking for a while, Fang Heng immediately arranged the next step of the team’s operation.
“Lucia, we will stay in this building tonight to rest and reorganize. I need you to lead the team to thoroughly clean up the building and make sure that there are no zombies on the first floor.”
“Especially on the first floor. I need you to seal and reinforce all the entrances. Can you do that?”
“Yes! I promise to complete the mission!”
Lucia did not have any objections to Fang Heng’s arrangement. She was even grateful.
She felt that Fang Heng did not get angry or punish her because of what happened just now. He even gave her a chance to carry out the mission.
“after cleaning up, try to contact the survivors of the other teams.”
“Yes!”
Lucia turned around and looked at the NPCs of the Dark Knights.
“Let’s go!”
Seeing that the team members had started to carry out the building clearing mission, Fang Heng took out his sleeping bag and nodded at Mo Jiawei.
“While I’m offline, keep an eye out for me. If anything happens, kick my sleeping bag immediately.”
After saying that, Fang Heng immediately went offline.
In the game, the helicopter that the Dark Knights were on was attacked by the nemesis. The teams were scattered in the corners of the city and it was difficult to contact them.
But Fang Heng’s team was different from them!
They were players!
They could contact each other in real life through offline means!
Fang Heng wanted to know what happened to the people from the Federation.
There was also Old Black!
‘What was the purpose of that guy deliberately luring him to the logistics team?
After exiting the game, Fang Heng did not even have the time to open the game cabin when he heard his phone ring.
Chen Yu probably had his men call him twenty-four hours a day...
Fang Heng took the phone by the bed and saw that it was indeed Chen Yu calling.
“Hello? This is Fang Heng.”
“Mr Fang Heng, Please Wait a moment. Captain Chen Yu will be here soon to answer the call.”
Chen Yu was standing at the side. He picked up the phone anxiously.
“Fang Heng? How are you? You didn’t get blown up by the nemesis, did you?”
“Unfortunately, it got blown up. I even got to experience the fun of parachuting for free. I suggest you try it sometime. It feels pretty good.”
“You still have the mood to joke around?”
Chen Yu completely lost his temper.
However, he was slightly relieved in his heart.
Since Fang Heng could say that, it meant that his situation was still under control.
“Where are you now?”
“Tm at the jewellery store near the north of Pine City.”
Chen Yu, who was holding the phone, nodded to his assistant. The latter immediately drew a big red circle on the map of Pine City.
Fang Heng immediately began to exchange information with Chen Yu.
“My team’s overall situation is good. We found the materials’ boxes left behind after the helicopter crashed and completed the construction of the communication tower base station.”
“However, the base station was seriously damaged. I tried to repair it, but unfortunately, I lacked advanced parts and was unable to complete the repair.”
“Currently, we are trying to restore the team’s communication. Oh right, I forgot to mention that I am now part of the logistics team.”
After a pause, Fang Heng added, “Yes, I am also the captain of Team 9.”
“Captain!?”
Chen Yu was shocked.
However, after thinking about it, it seemed to make sense. When Fang Heng was in prison, he suddenly recruited so many elite Dark Knights.
His honor points must have exploded to high numbers.
“Wait, did you say logistics? Why did you go there...”
“Sigh, it’s a long story. This is not important. We can chat later. Let’s talk about your situation first.”
Chen Yu was at a loss. He subconsciously thought that Fang Heng had received some special mission.
After all, Fang Heng’s honor level in the Dark Knights was extremely high.
Chen Yu quickly organized his thoughts.
“alright, Fang Heng. In this mission, two players from our Federation have joined the Dark Knights. Each of them was assigned to two teams respectively, Team 2 and Team 11.”
“Team 2’s luck is very good. During the entire mission into Pine City, they were not affected by the nemesis.”
“Two hours ago, Team 2 had already landed in the building according to their plan.”

“As they were unable to establish effective communication in the game, Team 2 did not know that the other teams had already been attacked by the nemesis. They were carrying out the search mission on campus according to their original plan, looking for a place to rest tonight.”
“According to Team 2, Team 7, who had landed around the same time as them, was also safe and sound. They were currently exploring Meteorite Company’s Area B.”
“The other eleven teams are in a worse situation. Their plane was attacked by the nemesis and landed near the park in the south of Pine City.”
“after landing, they were attacked by a dense horde of zombies.”
“Half an hour ago, they just left the park and found an abandoned mobile phone factory as their base. Two members of the team were injured. The situation is very critical.”
Factory?
Fang Heng pondered.
That was a good place. Perhaps they could disassemble high-level precision components and repair the damaged communication tower base station.
Fang Heng thought for a moment and continued to ask, “Right, what kind of mission did the two of them receive?”

“They are all different. The mission received by Team 2 players is to explore Area A, while the mission received by Team 11 players is to survive and find a way to meet up with the action team captain, Barker.”
Fang Heng continued to think.
From the current situation, Old Black didn’t seem to have tricked him.
The mission he received was indeed the most suitable for the main storyline, and the information he had was the most complete.
However, this made Fang Heng even more curious.
Old Black must have sent someone to join the exploration team in Pine City.
‘Which team was his person hiding in?
Why didn’t he follow the Team 9 logistics team with him?
“What about you? What’s your mission?”
Fang Heng calmly replied, “Yes, find a way to kill the nemesis.”
Chen Yu was silent for a while.
“are you kidding?”
“No, that was the mission that I received.”
“also, I’ve contacted the captain of the operation team, Barker. He’s currently at the Whitechapel in Pine City. His life isn’t in danger yet, but it’s hard to say if it drags on.”
Fang Heng thought for a moment and added, “I think it’s a little risky.”
“alright, Whitechapel.”
Chen Yu gestured to his companion and handed the handwritten note to a staff member at the side.
In the tactical analysis room, a federal staff member immediately began to analyze the relevant information regarding the Whitechapel..

chapters.title: Chapter 153 - Old Black’s Request
paragraphs: “also, I heard from Barker that the Dark Knights received an unknown distress signal from Pine City before heading there. The location is Pine City Hospital.
“I think this is a bit strange. Do you have any relevant intelligence or information?”
“Distress signal? Hospital?”
Chen Yu was still at a loss.
“I don’t know. I’m going to check the information about the hospital now. I’ll contact you in ten minutes.”
“Okay, I’ll wait for your call.”
Fang Heng had just hung up the phone. Before he could catch his breath, Old Black’s call came in again.
“Hehe, Fang Heng, how was the conversation with the people from the Federation?”
Fang Heng’s expression turned serious, and his eyes unconsciously narrowed into slits.
“You’re monitoring my phone?”
“Not to that extent. At most, I’m only monitoring your mobile activity. I know that you just called the Federation not long ago.”
Old Black chuckled.
“Hehe, I still don’t dare to monitor the Federation’s phone. My life is more important.”
“By the way, did it go well today?”
Fang Heng lay on the sofa and changed to a more comfortable position.
“What do you think? Do you feel that everything is within your expectations?”
“Don’t be angry, Fang Heng. You should know that it is very difficult to obtain information about the main storyline mission.”
“My information is limited to following closely to Team 9 to be near the main storyline mission.”
“To be honest, you should be thanking me.”
Old Black explained to Fang Heng.
“And I’m not sure if you’re willing to cooperate with me. Revealing too much information will only bring trouble to me.”
Fang Heng curled his lips. “Then can you be sure now?”
“Hahaha, the facts have proven that we can still cooperate. You should be able to understand my difficulties, right?”
Old Black became serious.
“Fang Heng, I want to know what happened after you all entered Pine City.”
“Old Black, it’s my turn this time. What do you want to know? Spend money to buy it!”
Old Black was very happy and laughed loudly.
“You’re learning fast, Fang Heng. I like your attitude. 50 King of Gods’ points. I want to know everything that happened after you boarded the plane.”
“Deal.”
Fang Heng raised his eyebrows.
After confirming that he had received the King of Gods’ points, he quickly recounted the development of the matter. It was no different from what he had told the Federation previously.
Old Black pondered for a moment after hearing this and said, “So he’s hiding in the hospital...
“Him? The hospital? You know about the hospital mission?”
“Yes, Fang Heng. I can tell you now that the person in the hospital is one of the important clients of the employer.”
“If you can think of a way to enter the hospital and kill the person who issued the distress message to the outside world, I can provide you with 500 King of Gods’ points as the mission reward.”
500 points?
He was worth that much money?
Fang Heng’s heart skipped a beat.
This meant that the mysterious person must be an extremely important figure!
“Fang Heng, think about it. I won’t force you to complete the mission. After all, it’s very difficult to go to the hospital under such circumstances.”
“Considering that we have a long-term cooperative relationship, I don’t wish for you to die in Pine City.”
Fang Heng asked, “Why do I have to kill him?”

“I didn’t give you much information. I can only say that this person is very important. To prevent the Federation from contacting him, the employer feels that killing him is the easiest way to deal with him.”
“Alright, I’ve said enough. You need to consider whether to accept this mission or not. In addition, the information you provided will be handed over to the employer in four hours.”
“If you want to complete this mission, you’ll have to do it fast. The employer has placed someone in the team this time, and that person will also think of a way to complete the mission.”
“Also, the entire process of completing the mission needs to be recorded.”
Old Black said as he hung up the call.
Fang Heng’s brows were tightly knitted.
‘The Federation’s intelligence was once again far behind the mysterious employer.
500 points were very tempting.
However, Fang Heng was even more curious about the identity of the mysterious person in the hospital.
Let’s go to the hospital and take a look!
Just as he was thinking, Chen Yu called him again.
“Fang Heng, we just found out that the hospital in Pine City is also secretly controlled by the Meteorite Company. We found the layout of the building and are sending it to you now.”
“In addition, according to the information we have, we believe that the hospital is also cooperating with the Meteorite Company to conduct relevant clinical experiments.”
“We found that in the game settings of District 8, there is a famous leukaemia clinical research and experiment centre in Pine City that is set up in the hospital
“We suspect that the cancer treatment centre in the hospital may be secretly conducting clinical experiments for the G-virus.”
“Do you have any way to let me go into the hospital to take a look?”
“Uh... You mean now?”
“Yes.”
Chen Yu recalled the scene when he worked with Fang Heng in Hope Town.
He had a faint feeling of pain in his balls.
“Don’t tell me, it’s quite a coincidence. We just found the blueprints for the construction of the underground sewer in Pine City.”
Chen Yu probed, “If it’s you, maybe there’s a way to go around to the hospital from there?”
Underground sewer?
That was a good place!
Fang Heng’s eyes lit up.
“Okay! Quick! Send it over!”
“Fang Heng, be safe and let’s keep in touch.”
‘A few minutes later, Fang Heng received the sewer map of Pine City from Chen Yu.
Pine City had been rebuilt many times, so the layout of the sewer was extremely complicated.
Chen Yu, out of consideration for him, had marked the route from the jewellery store to the hospital on the map.
No problem!
It was too dangerous to walk on the ground of Pine City.
‘The sewer was a good way to avoid a large zombie horde.
Fang Heng estimated the distance in his mind.
The hospital was not far from the jewellery shop. If everything went smoothly, it would only take an hour to get there.
He returned to the game.
The number of zombies resurrected had reached 20.
Lucia had led her team to quickly clean up the jewellery shop and was sparing no effort in trying to contact the Dark Knights’ teams through the base station.
Seeing that Fang Heng had come online, Mo Jiawei hurriedly came up to ask.
“How is it? What did the think tank say?”
What think tank... what a mess...
“Lwent offline to inquire about the situation. Some of the Dark Knights’ teams have entered Pine City ahead of time. They are investigating the interior of the Meteorite Company Park.”
“The other teams were attacked by the nemesis just like us. The situation is not good.”
‘Mo Jiawei was helpless.
“alright, we’re just unlucky.”

Fang Heng said, “It’s too dangerous to move at night. We’ll stay here tonight. You can bring some of the Dark Knights with you to reinforce the residence. We’ll think of a way to carry out the rescue mission after dawn tomorrow.”
Seeing how the God was calmly making arrangements, Mo Jiawei felt relieved.
“Okay. What about you?”
“Lwant to go to the hospital.”
“Hospital?!”
Mo Jiawei was shocked.
“You want to go to the hospital at night?”
Didn’t he say that it was not suitable to move at night?
“It’s okay. Iam going down the underground sewer alone.”
“Sewer?!”
Wouldn’t the difficulty be doubled?!
Mo Jiawei was even more shocked.
Fang Heng patted Mo Jiawei’s shoulder.
“Add me as a friend. If you run into any trouble, feel free to contact me..”

chapters.title: Chapter 154 - Entering the Sewer
paragraphs: Including the rooftop on the top floor, the entire jewellery store had a total of five floors.
Before heading to the first floor, Fang Heng once again opened the boxes of materials that he had picked up earlier.
He had already checked all of them before.
The equipment in the last two boxes was unexpectedly good!
‘There was even a flashbang and a bag of medium explosive packs!
Flashbang was a life-saving item.
Even the nemesis would be affected by the flashbang and be frozen on the spot for a few seconds.
‘There was also the medium explosive pack.
Its power was five times that of a small explosive pack.
Considering that he might encounter danger on the way to the hospital, Fang Heng decided to take them all!

[Hint: You have obtained flashbang*1, grenade*12, small explosive pack*7, medium explosive pack*1, automatic rifle (WCX)*1, rifle bullet (200)*5, first aid bandage*s, medical spray*10, first aid blood bag*20.]
Finally, Fang Heng picked up a black gun from the bottom of the box and weighed it in his hand.
[Automatic rifle (WCX)]
‘Type: Weapon.
Description: A short-barreled automatic rifle that fires powerful shots in rapid succession when the trigger is held down.
Minimum equipment requirement: Strength: 15, gun mastery: Level 5.
(Description: If the strength is below 20 and gun mastery is below Level 10, there will be an additional penalty for a lower hit rate.)
It’s very powerful!
Unfortunately, Fang Heng’s current level of gun mastery was not enough to use it perfectly.
In addition, the automatic rifle was not equipped with a silencer. The noise produced after firing would easily attract more zombies to gather.
“Bring it, in case anything happens.”
Fang Heng put away the rifle.
After he had completed equipping himself, Fang Heng became more confident. He held his machete and brought the zombie clones along the stairs to the first floor.
‘The Dark Knights had cleaned up thoroughly and he did not encounter any zombies along the way.
‘When they reached the first floor, Fang Heng compared the map that was imported from outside the game and fumbled his way into the staff changing room.
From the sewer map that Chen Yu gave him, the manhole cover that was closest to him was in an alley two streets away.
Currently, the number of zombie clones was not enough. It was too risky to run outside and face the zombie horde head-on.
After thinking for a while, Fang Heng decided to settle for the second-best option.
He might as well dig a big hole from the inside of the jewellery shop that led directly to the sewer!
“It should be around here.”
In the staff changing room, Fang Heng first sealed the side with wooden planks, then found the right spot and waved his hand.
“Smash!”
‘The zombie clones standing behind him all picked up iron hammers and started to smash the ground!
[Hint: Your zombie clone has disassembled the floor. You have obtained gravel*2.]
[Hint: Your zombie clone has disassembled the floor...]
“Bang! Bang! Bang!!”
A dull knocking sound was heard in the room.
‘The zombie clones were not equipped with iron pickaxes or shovels, so the speed of digging was unusually slow.
The knocking lasted for more than two hours.
The number of zombies in the zombie team had also resurrected to 65.
It was finally done!
Fang Heng heard the muffled sound of a large number of rocks falling into the sewer.
He stood up to observe.
The zombies had dug a five-meter-deep hole in the floor.
Fang Heng used his flashlight to sweep around the hole.
The zombie horde in the sewer was attracted by the light, and they chased after the light, letting out wailing sounds.2
The sewer in Pine City was also filled with zombies!
However, the situation was still good.
The density of the zombies was much lower than the last time in Hope Town.
It was within control!
The vine zombie clones jumped down into the hole and landed in the stinky sewer.
They slowly stood up and raised their iron spears to attack the zombie horde in the sewer.
The zombies looked at their kind in confusion.
“Ah, a bunch of lambs waiting to be slaughtered.”
[Hint: Your zombie clone has killed a normal zombie. You have gained survival points +2.]
{Hint: Your zombie clone has killed a normal zombie...]
‘The game log began to refresh again.
‘The damage caused by the iron spears was almost double that of the wooden spears. In addition, Fang Heng’s strength attribute had improved a lot recently.
The efficiency of killing zombies had increased a lot compared to the last time he was in Hope Town!
In less than ten minutes, the zombie clones had cleared out a clean area below.
[Hint: Your zombie group has cleared out the zombies. You have gained 3,162 survival points, 162 evolution crystal fragments and complete evolution crystal*12.]
Fang Heng raised his hand and absorbed the evolution crystal fragments into his hand. Then, he jumped down into the hole.
“Pada!”
Fang Heng could not help but pinch his nose when he landed on the ground.
‘The nauseating stench assaulted him once again.
“This damned place!”

[Warning: The environment you are in is extremely harsh. Due to the influence of the stench, as you stay in the sewer for a longer period, your HP will continue to decrease, and the rate of decrease will gradually increase.]

[Hint: Your physique has been partially enhanced and has reached 20 points. You have a certain degree of resistance to the stench. You can stay in the sewer for a longer period, but your infection index will continue to increase.]
‘There was such a benefit to having a stronger physique?
Fang Heng thought to himself, and quickly took out a bottle of blue potion specially made by Qiu Yaokang from his backpack and drank it.
[Hint: You have used a powerful anti-infection potion. Within 24 hours, your resistance to infection will be greatly increased.]
‘Then, Fang Heng made a simple mask.
He used the healing spray and sprayed it on the mask to dispel the smell, then put it on his face.
He could barely breathe.
Fang Heng tested the effect of the mask, then commanded the zombie group to continue moving forward.
‘The dark underground sewer had long been occupied by the rotting zombie horde.
Under the flashlight, there was a sewage passage in the middle of the underground sewer. There were raised pathways on both sides for people to walk on.
Alarge portion of the zombie clones walked in the sewer.
The sewage water almost reached their knees.
‘The zombie clones raised their iron spears one after another, cleaning up the zombies along the way.
‘They walked and stopped, and their progress was unusually slow.
‘There were many Tier 1 puz zombies in the sewer. Sometimes, they even appeared in groups.
‘Whenever he encountered them, Fang Heng had to carefully avoid them.
The puz that exploded would not only cause blood loss, but it would also cause a significant increase in the infection index.
After about ten minutes, Fang Heng’s HP began to decrease.
‘The negative effects of the environment began.
Fang Heng was already prepared. He grabbed the healing spray and sprayed it into his mouth.
“At this speed, it’ll take at least an hour.”
Suddenly, Fang Heng sensed a threat.
He put away the healing spray and controlled the zombie group to stop. He slightly narrowed his eyes and raised his head to look ahead.
Along the way, the sewage passage became deeper, and the sewage water had already reached the waist of the zombies.
Right in front of the sewer, there were strange ripples in the calm water.
‘There was something under the water!
It was rapidly approaching them.
There was more than one!
The sense of threat was getting stronger!

chapters.title: Chapter 155 - Hunter
paragraphs: Fang Heng quickly took out two grenades and threw them at the rippling water ahead of time.
“Bang! Bang!”
‘The two grenades exploded after entering the water.
Along with the burst of dirty water, three black shadows jumped out from under the water!
“Chi! Chi!”
Fang Heng stared at the water.
The moment the black shadows attacked, Fang Heng’s brain instantly transmitted the information of the three dark green monsters.
Tier 2 mutated zombies!
Hunter!
Its appearance looked like a mutated frog. Its head was flat, its forelimbs were short, and its hind limbs were extremely thick and developed. There were webbed fingers and toes.
From the information in his memory, the Hunter was a product of the Meteorite Company’s gene editing. They were better at fighting in the water, and their strength was comparable to a Licker.
At close range, its huge mouthpart could swallow a human!
Out of the three Hunters, two were affected by the grenade. Their skin was damaged, and blood was oozing out.
But almost at the same time, the three Hunters jumped up.
Their powerful jumping ability allowed them to directly jump over the zombie clones and pounce toward Fang Heng.
“F*ck!”
Fang Heng took out his automatic rifle and aimed at the Hunters in the air.
He pressed the trigger to the end!
“Tatatata...”
Dense gunshots rang out.
Two Hunters who had already been heavily injured by the grenade fell from the air.
Thirty bullets were instantly emptied!
The gunshots paused.
There was still the last Hunter in the air.
“Squeak squeak!”
It opened its huge mouth towards Fang Heng.
Its black mouth was densely packed with ghastly white teeth!
Fang Heng smelled an even stronger stench at a close distance.
He took a small step back and switched to a shotgun, aiming the muzzle at Hunter’s open mouth.
“Bang!”
‘The Hunter was sent flying backwards.
[Hint: You have dealt critical damage to Hunter’s weakness. You have gained gun mastery experience points +12.]
At the landing point, the vine zombies quickly surrounded the Hunter. They extended layers of vines from their bodies and wrapped around the Hunter.
If it was a one-on-one fight, there was no doubt about the outcome.
The Hunter could directly swallow the vine zombie in one bite!
However, when faced with a large number of vine zombies, the Hunter had no way to swallow them.
‘The Hunters were surrounded by vine zombies that were gathered around. They didn’t have any space to dodge and were entangled by countless vines.
They couldn’t struggle.
In comparison, the strength of Hunter’s forelimbs wasn’t strong!
It was fine if it wanted to break free from a layer of vines, but once it was entangled by seven or eight layers, it could not break free at all.
‘The remaining vine zombies started to use their iron spears to stab at the Hunter.
Seeing that the three Hunters were all controlled by the vine zombies, Fang Heng carefully walked forward and temporarily stopped his attack.
He took out a box of live sample collection from his backpack and took out a collector from it.
Even though he had strict weight-bearing control before boarding the plane, Fang Heng did not dare to throw the three boxes that Qiu Yaokang had made overnight.
“Since I’m already here, might as well get some samples while I’m at it.”
Fang Heng said as he pressed the collector on Hunter’s shoulder.
*Chil”
‘There was a slight sound.
‘A slow channelling bar appeared above Fang Heng’s head.
{Hint: You have obtained a live sample-Hunter*1.]
After collecting three samples in a row, Fang Heng closed the box in satisfaction.
The vine zombies continued to attack with their iron spears.
Soon, the three Hunters died under the siege of the vine zombies.
{Hint: Your zombie group has killed Hunter*3. You have obtained survival points*22. You have obtained Tier 1 evolution cystal*1.]
“Troublesome Hunter!”
Fang Heng was glad that he anticipated that the sewer was not that easy to walk through.
After confirming that there was no longer any danger in the sewer, Fang Heng continued forward.
He had walked through the sewer for a full hour and a half.
He had killed two groups of Hunters in a row.
In front of him, Fang Heng finally saw a ladder going up.
“Tm finally here.”
Fang Heng gulped down another bottle of HP potion.
If he hadn’t found the supply box earlier, he really wouldn’t have enough medicine to make this round trip.
Fang Heng climbed up the ladder.
Up above, the closed manhole cover blocked the way.
Was it locked?
“Bang! Bang! Bang!”
Fang Heng took out a hammer and tried to knock on the manhole cover.
This was troublesome.
Fang Heng had no choice but to jump down from the ladder.
‘The difficulty of the game for the underground sewer was no lower than that for the surface.
There was a Tier 2 Hunter and the negative effect of the ‘stench’.
Now, even the manhole cover was locked!
However, Fang Heng had a way.
He quickly made a few wooden frames on the spot and accumulated the frames to form a platform.
The zombies climbed up the frames one by one and finally stood on the platform and knocked on the manhole cover.
“Dong! Dong! Dong!”
The sound of knocking on the manhole cover echoed in the sewer.
Ten minutes later, the manhole cover with a total of 5,000 HP was forcefully broken by the zombies.
[Hint: Your zombie clone has dismantled the manhole cover. You have obtained scrap metal*28.]
The sky outside the manhole cover was pitch black.
Fang Heng didn’t even have the time to climb outside before he heard the howling of zombie dogs from the outside world.
A group of zombie dogs was attracted by the sound of knocking on the manhole cover, and they surrounded the manhole cover and howled.
Their howling attracted the wandering zombies nearby.
“It’s not over yet. How troublesome!”
Fang Heng complained in a low voice.
He controlled the zombie clones to climb out onto the ground and clear out the zombie horde.
The zombies climbed out of the sewer.
They raised their spears and slowly killed the zombie dogs.
‘The zombie dogs were not easy to deal with. They immediately counterattacked and attacked the vine zombies.
Unfortunately, their damage was nothing to the vine zombies.
{Hint: Your zombie clone has killed the zombie dogs. You have gained survival points +4.]
(Hint: Your zombie clone has killed an ordinary zombie...]
Another round of ‘kill’ notifications flooded the screen.
Fang Heng couldn’t hold it in any longer after the noise outside had died down.
He stuck his head out from under the manhole cover and breathed in the hard-earned fresh air.
He quickly checked his surroundings with his flashlight.
‘The zombie clones were still fighting with the wandering zombies in the hospital.
Among the wandering zombies, there was no lack of Tier 1 mutated zombies.
Fortunately, there were not as many zombies in the hospital as there were on the streets in the city centre.
Fang Heng took in a few breaths of air and quickly hid in the underground sewer.
‘Taking advantage of this time, Fang Heng began to study the next step of his plan.
Next, it was time to find that mysterious survivor.
The exit of the manhole cover was located in the ‘small park’ within Pine City Hospital.
The hospital was very big, so it was very troublesome to find it.
Fang Heng opened the map of the hospital to check.
“Building No. 3... Leukemia Clinical Research and Experiment Center.”
Fang Heng muttered softly.
Chen Yu had mentioned before that the Leukemia Clinical Research and Experiment Center of Pine City Hospital might be related to the Meteorite Company’s human G-virus testing.
If there were no other clues, he would start his investigation there!

chapters.title: Chapter 156 - Random Character No. 3
paragraphs: Ia hotel-style apartment.
In the room, Old Black skillfully dialled a cell phone number.
“Random target No. 3 has been confirmed. He is currently hiding in the hospital in Pine City.”
A voice changer was used on the other side of the phone, and the voice was very hoarse.
“It’s earlier than I expected by more than a month.”
Old Black licked his lips and chuckled. “It’s beyond your expectations again? What do you want me to do?”
“Kill him and find No. 1, No. 2 and No. 4 as soon as possible.”
“Ineed to eliminate the possibility of the Federation’s Server 8 opening the passage.”

Old Black forced a smile and replied, “My people have already thought of a way to rush to the hospital. However, considering the current situation in Pine City, it won’t be easy to complete the mission.”
“Are your people reliable?”
“There will never be a 100% reliable person.”
“From a practical point of view, it has only been less than half a month now. At this stage, no one can trigger that NPC’s high-level mission.”
Old Black shook his head, “What we should be worried about is the mission itself, With the current player’s strength, if there is no one supporting them, it will be impossible to enter the hospital.”
“Don’t delay too long. Once the Federation finds out No. 3’s identity, they’ll do their best.”
“Yes, I understand. I’ll think of a way to get rid of him as soon as possible.”
After the zombies outside were cleared, Fang Heng carefully climbed out of the sewer.
It was pitch-black all around.
The player would enter the ‘dark fear’ state in the wild at night. They had to think of a way to quickly enter the building.
Fang Heng roughly identified the direction and jogged in the direction of Experimental Building No. 3.
That’s right!
After approaching Experimental Building No. 3, Fang Heng was even more certain that there was something wrong with this experimental building.
The other experimental buildings were all in tatters, but the windows and doors of this experimental building were completely sealed by wooden planks.
Fang Heng went to the side of Building No. 3 and shot the wooden planks with his shotgun.
After breaking the window, Fang Heng climbed into Building No. 3.
Behind the window was an old utility room.
There were no zombies in the utility room.
Fang Heng tried to push the door open.
The experimental building was quiet, without any sound.
Fang Heng thought for a moment, then sat down and let the zombies enter the building to explore.
Taking advantage of the time gap, Fang Heng took out a bowl of instant noodles from his backpack and some biscuits and started eating.
Ten minutes later, Fang Heng checked the game log again.
The stairs leading to the fourth floor were blocked.
The zombies had no choice but to stop after they finished exploring the third floor.
[Hint: Your zombie group has completed the search and found firewood*32, nails*5, scalpel* 4, case record book*2, nail clipper*1, broken parts*4, bottles*2, needles*4...]
The building was very safe. They didn’t encounter any zombies during the entire search.
Similarly, the zombies searched for a long time but didn’t find any food or water.
“It seems that we didn’t make a mistake. Someone must have cleaned the building and collected the materials in advance.”
Fang Heng stood up and led the zombie group to the third floor.
On the third floor, the door leading to the fourth floor was locked.
Fang Heng looked through the glass window on the door.
The other side of the door was wrapped with a thick iron chain.
Fortunately, the iron door was not strong.
The zombie group came over one zombie with one hammer.
A few minutes later, the iron door was smashed into pieces.
Fang Heng successfully passed through the iron door and entered the fourth floor by climbing along the stairs.
The passage was shining with a green light.
The emergency light on the fourth floor was still on!
He didn’t go the wrong way!
There must be someone here!
Fang Heng was relieved.
To play safe, he controlled the two vine zombies to open a path in front of him.
The entire passage was silent. Only the footsteps of Fang Heng and the zombies could be heard.
On the left side of the pathway was a ward, and on the right side was a row of windows that were sealed by wooden slats.
Fang Heng used a flashlight to illuminate the room.
There was a corner in front of him.
Fang Heng walked around the corner and saw another door more than 20 meters away from the passage.
There were more than a dozen semicircular objects on the ground in front of the door.
When the flashlight shone over them, the semicircular spheres flickered with a metallic lustre.
What was this?
Fang Heng was puzzled.
Mechanical metal?
An ordinary hospital wouldn’t have such strange objects, right?
Fang Heng was puzzled.
“Squeak, squeak, squeak...”
The metal ball started spinning on its own.
The outer shell of the metal ball spun down, revealing the muzzle hidden in the black hole.
“Crack! Squeak, squeak...”
The muzzle twisted at the same time, aiming at Fang Heng and the two zombie clones beside him.
“D*mn it!”
The hairs on Fang Heng’s back stood up!
He realized what was about to happen and immediately dodged to the side.
“Bang! Bang!! Bang!!! Bang! Bang!! Bang!!!”
Dense bullets poured out from the muzzle of the gun.
Fang Heng quickly escaped!
The two zombie clones were unable to dodge in time and were continuously struck by the bullets until their HP was reduced and they fell to the ground.
More than a dozen metallic robots had opened fire for nearly a minute!

The HP of the two vine zombie clones that were standing in the front to scout the way was reduced from 100% to 20%. After activating the skill ‘strengthen the body’, their HP was instantly full, and they were once again hit to 0%!
Fang Heng stuck close to the wall, his heart thumping rapidly.
Luckily, he ran fast!
Who would have thought that he would encounter such a thing in a place like a hospital?
He had lost two zombie clones for nothing!
The most annoying thing was that the zombie clone’s stunned debuff was too long, and the blocking and dodging skills were not even activated!
He did not gain any skill or experience points at all.
Fang Heng pressed his temples and began to think of a strategy.
Most of the robots here were set up by the survivors in the hospital.
The goal was to deal with zombies.
Fang Heng thought that the robots might have been testing him through some method.
And mistook him for a zombie.
Ifhe tried it forcefully, he wouldn’t be able to face them head-on.
He had already tried it just now. More than ten mechanical spheres fired at the same time. Their firepower was too fierce.
Even the vine zombies couldn’t withstand it.
He had to change the method...
“Hehe, I got it.”
After thinking for a while, Fang Heng had an idea.
He first controlled a zombie clone to stand out alone.
“Chi Chi Cl
The other three vine zombies extended their vines from their bodies and slowly wrapped around the zombie’s body.
The zombie clone that was wrapped was still moving.
However, its movements were slower than before.
Under Fang Heng’s control, it slowly moved toward the corner.
Until it entered the shooting range of the mechanical robot.
“Bang! Bang Bang Bang!!”
Another barrage of bullets fired.
Fang Heng stared at the zombie clone’s HP.
When its skill, ‘strengthen the body’, was used up, its HP fell to 50% again.
“Pull!”
Fang Heng suddenly shouted.
Chi chi chi!
The three vine zombies that stayed beside Fang Heng quickly pulled back the vines!
The zombie clone that stayed outside to attract the firepower was pulled back by a huge force.
The gunshots instantly stopped.
Fang Heng looked at the zombie beside him.
Its body was full of bullet holes.
Very good.
It did not die. It still had 18% HP left.
The experiment was successful!
Fang Heng continued to control three zombies and tied the next one alive with vines..

chapters.title: Chapter 157 - Victor’s Request
paragraphs: His plan was very simple.
It was impossible to determine how this kind of mechanical object was aimed.
In short, they could find and attack zombies.
In that case, he would make them waste their bullets and make use of the weakness of their insufficient supply!
Guns had limited ammunition capacity.
‘When they ran out of bullets, they naturally lost their ability to attack.
They only needed to use a few hundred bullets each time. Let’s see how many more bullets they could waste!
It was still early, so Fang Heng wasn’t in a hurry.
He began to slowly consume the remaining bullets in the mechanical robots.
“Bang! Bang Bang Bang!”
“Bang Bang! Bang!”
In less than half an hour, the guns could no longer fire bullets.
The vine zombies entered the attack range and the guns could only make “ka ka ka ka” sounds.

“Ugh... forget it. I don’t want to dismantle it.”
After thinking for a while, Fang Heng put the wrench back into his backpack.
The mechanical robot here was most likely left behind by the mission NPC.
Dismantling other people’s things would reduce their friendship.
What if the NPC bore a grudge against him? What would he do then?
He passed through the door behind the round mechanical robot.
It was another long pathway.
Fang Heng felt a headache.
To be safe, he still let the vine zombies block in front of him.
After walking a few steps, Fang Heng heard a faint cracking sound again.
He turned his head sharply.
There was a camera on the wall not far in front of him.
The camera turned and pointed in Fang Heng’s direction.
“Tm from the Dark Knights. I received a distress signal from the hospital and came to check the situation.”
Fang Heng said as he walked to the camera.
“Did you hear what I said?”

He quickly wrote a line of words on the record book and placed the book in front of the camera.
“Ka ka ka.

“Tl wait for you here.”
‘The camera nodded up and down again.
Fang Heng also heaved a sigh of relief and waited on the spot.
It would be best if he could be contacted.
He didn’t want to move forward alone and get shot in the head by a mechanical robot that suddenly appeared out of nowhere.
After about five to six minutes, a middle-aged man wearing a protective suit and holding a shotgun pushed open the door of the room at the end of the corridor.
Fang Heng waved at him, indicating that he didn’t mean any harm.
“The zombies behind me are my talent ability. You probably don’t know this, but many people have awakened this ability since the zombie crisis.”
‘The middle-aged man’s voice was very dry and hoarse, and his lips were dry.
“T’ve heard of talent abilities. Do you have any extra water?”
“Yes, I have a lot more.”
Fang Heng took out a bottle of mineral water from his backpack and threw it at the middle-aged man, then added, “Enough!”
‘The middle-aged man took the bottle of water from Fang Heng.
“Phew!”
He checked the bottle of mineral water and heaved a sigh of relief.
“Thank you.”

“It hasn’t rained here for a long time. Fortunately, you found me.”
“Oh right, I haven’t had the chance to introduce myself. I’m Victor, a former mechanical engineer from the Meteorite Company.”
Victor noticed Fang Heng’s probing gaze.
“That’s my daughter, Angel.”
“She’s very cute, right?”
Victor looked at the girl with loving eyes. He slowly told Fang Heng his story.
“Three years ago, Angel was diagnosed with leukaemia. To treat her illness, I took her to almost all the doctors.”
“Two years ago, I learned that a hospital in Pine City had established leukaemia-related Clinical Research and Experimental Centre. I came to Pine City with the idea of trying.”
“They indeed could control Ange”s illness. From then on, Angel and I moved to Pine City and joined the Meteorite Company.”
“at first, everything was fine. Angel’s illness gradually improved, but later, the rejection still happened and Angel fell into a coma
“It wasn’t until half a year later that I found out Meteorite Company injected the modified G-virus into Angel’s body.”
“I knew that it was very dangerous, but at that time, I had no way out.”
“The G-virus was the only way for Angel to survive. I could only pray that the G-virus was effective.”
Victor sighed deeply. “Then, the disaster broke out.”
“One day, I suddenly received a warning from the Meteorite Company. Due to the outbreak of the biochemical crisis, the helicopter would take me out of Pine City in half an hour.”
“I could leave, but Angel couldn’t do it.”
“She can’t withstand such torment. Once she is exposed to a dangerous environment, she will die.”
“Ican’t leave her alone, so I chose to stay with her.”
“L originally thought that the Federation and the Meteorite Company would rush back to rescue her soon, but that’s not the case.”
“Two days later, I lost contact with Meteorite Company.”
“To prevent the invasion of zombies from the outside world, I could only constantly reinforce this place and do my best to protect Angel’s safety.”
Listening to Victor’s story, Fang Heng frowned.
This was the story of a father.
‘The strange thing was that the mission given by Old Black was to kill Victor.
Why?
Fang Heng asked, “You sent out a distress signal to the outside world because you wanted to bring Angel away from Pine City?”
“The medicine to maintain Angel is almost exhausted. She has at most two months.”
Fang Heng’s heart skipped a beat. He asked, “What will happen if there’s no medicine?”
Victor’s face revealed a pained expression.
He could not help but clench his fists.
“If we stop injecting the medicine, after losing control of the medicine, Angel’s body will gradually be eroded by the G-virus.”
“I’ve read the report. There’s a 99% chance of dying directly after stopping the medication.”
“The remaining 1% chance will be to turn into a monster.”
Fang Heng looked at the thin and weak girl on the hospital bed and fell into silence.
Fortunately, he had come earlier.
According to the thinking of this stupid game, if it was two months later, the little girl would most likely turn into a monster. Then, it might be another tough battle.
Victor forced a smile. “I believe that Angel and I can get through it.”
“How can I help you?”
“Thank you.”
[Hint: Your favorability rating with Victor has increased slightly.]
Victor stood up as he spoke and took out an experimental report from a cabinet at the side.
“This is the relevant information I found from a friend.”
“Meteorite Company’s latest drug, G-virus cell blocker. If we can get it, Angel should be able to survive the high-risk period for some time and evacuate from Pine City.”
“We should be able to find it in Meteorite Company’s Area D.”

chapters.title: Chapter 158 - Mechanical Badge
paragraphs: “Also, you must be careful of the nemesis after entering Meteorite Company.”
Fang Heng raised his eyebrows.
“It’s an experimental product of Meteorite Company.”

“Originally, after the biochemical virus was leaked, Meteorite Company released the nemesis. They wanted to take advantage of the biochemical crisis to conduct biological weapon experiments in Pine City and collect relevant information.”
“But the strange thing is, Meteorite Company completely disappeared after the disaster.”
“Now, no one has continued to control the nemesis.”
“The nemesis is still carrying out her final order to wipe out all the humans in Pine City.”
Victor said as he took out a mechanical badge from his pocket and handed it to Fang Heng.
“What’s this?”
“Meteorite Company is controlling the nemesis by implanting a chip into her brain.”
“This badge can emit a fixed low-frequency sound wave, causing the chip to react, making the nemesis think that you are Meteorite Company’s experimenter.”
Fang Heng hesitated.
“What about you? What are you going to do? And Angel?”
“Tm fine, don’t worry.”
Victor explained to Fang Heng.

“Tve roughly figured out the structure of this badge. I’ve also simulated and set up a signal source in the hospital, so the hospital area is relatively safe. Under normal circumstances, it won’t be attacked by the nemesis.”
[Hint: You’ve obtained the badge of Chief Mechanical Engineer of the Meteorite Company branch (Victor).]
Fang Heng put away the badge.
It was a good item!
With this item, he could temporarily block the attacks of the nemesis!
This way, he would have a lot of room to maneuver when dealing with the nemesis in the future.
“You still have to be careful. The badge is only effective against the nemesis. The other zombies will still attack you.”
“Okay, I will find the G-virus cell blocker as soon as possible and come back.”
“You have to be careful during this period of time.”
Fang Heng said as he put away the badge and left some mineral water in his backpack to Victor.
Just as he was about to leave, Fang Heng thought of something.
He turned around and looked Victor up and down.
Victor was puzzled. “What?”
“Uh... to be honest, Victor, did you offend anyone outside?”
“Offend someone...”
Victor was a little confused by Fang Heng’s question.
He still tried to recall.
“Ever since I entered the Meteorite Company, I’ve spent my time either at work or with Angel. I’ve rarely interacted with outsiders. I might have unintentionally offended someone at work.”
Fang Heng nodded.
It was just as he had thought.
Old Black’s employer’s motive for wanting to kill Victor was not targeted at Victor.
It should be a game plot related to Victor.
Most likely, after killing Victor, it might trigger some special plot.
Could it be related to Angel?
For example, if Angel became a Tier 5 mutated zombie after being stimulated, would it bring great trouble to the Federation?
“Fang Heng? Is there some trouble?”

Fang Heng stopped thinking and said, “Victor, before I came here, I heard that there are people in the Dark Knights who may harm you. They already know that you’re staying in the hospital, and they might come to look for you.”
“Think about it, do you want to leave this place with me?”
Victor frowned. He thought about it and rejected Fang Heng’s suggestion.
“Thank you, Fang Heng. But I can’t leave Angel here alone. I’ll always stay here to protect her.”
“Okay, I understand.”
Fang Heng nodded. “Then be careful. Don’t let your guard down when you meet anyone.”
“Okay.”
Fang Heng stopped again.
“Oh right, Victor, there’s one more thing. Do you have any high-level machines here?”
Victor looked puzzled.
He was a little confused by Fang Heng’s out-of-the-box thinking.
“High-level machines? Yes, there are, but they’re in another hospital building.”
“What do you want that for?”
“Lwant to dismantle some parts from it.”
Fang Heng took out a wrench from his pocket and gestured with it in front of Victor.
“Ineed some high-level parts.”
Victor looked at the wrench in Fang Heng’s hand and smiled bitterly.
“No need to dismantle them. Come with me.”
After a while, Victor brought Fang Heng to a storage room on the fourth floor.
Fang Heng’s eyes lit up when he opened the door of the storage room.
What the heck!
This is...
Amechanical waste collection point?
Fang Heng originally thought that his ore pile was already messy enough, but the mechanical pile here was even more messy!
Strange mechanical parts were piled up everywhere in the room.
Only the central mechanical console and the surrounding area were cleared out.
There were a total of six mechanical arms on the mechanical console.
‘The mechanical arms were operating.
What was that?
Fang Heng narrowed his eyes, and a chill ran down his spine.
On the mechanical console was a dismembered mechanical ball.
Wasn’t that hemisphere the mechanical ball he had encountered at the entrance of the fourth floor?
“It’s a bit messy, don’t mind it.”
Victor walked into the messy pile of machines.
His movements were unusually skillful.
Fang Heng opened his mouth.
That’s right!
Fang Heng finally remembered.
Victor was a mechanical engineer!
He was the Chief Mechanical Engineer in charge of the entire Meteorite Company!
So, he should be at least an A-level NPC, right?
Maybe even an S-level?
Should he trick him back home?
Fang Heng’s mind was already working.
If he wanted to lure Victor back, he would most likely need to start with Angel.
Victor was already prepared to leave Pine City.
But now it was already the apocalypse outside.
‘Where could he go?
Wouldn’t he have to come to his own shelter?
The sterile ward!
Fang Heng immediately understood.
‘The purpose of recruiting Victor was most likely to build a sterile ward in the shelter for Angel to live in!
With Victor around, the experimental equipment in the shelter would most likely be repaired perfectly!
It would greatly increase the efficiency of scientific research!
Victor turned his head from the pile of machines and asked, “Fang Heng? What type of mechanical parts do you want?”
Fang Heng came back to his senses.
“General purpose advanced mechanical parts will do.”
Recalling the need to repair the communication base station, Fang Heng asked again, “Oh right, is there a communication base plate? A-type base plate.”
“Yes, let me see. What do you want to repair?”
“It’s a kind of radio communication base station used to send and receive signals.”
Fang Heng explained to Victor with a bitter smile.
“When our team came here, we were attacked by the nemesis. The radio base station accessories transported on the helicopter were damaged.”
“T managed to repair it a little. Now its release power is very low. It’s very difficult to contact the other Dark Knights’ teams.”

“Sigh, there’s no hope for it to be completely repaired. I can only try to repair it as much as possible. I can try to expand the communication range of the base station and try to contact other people.”
Unfortunately, Victor had no way of leaving the hospital.
If it’s him, he should be able to easily repair the base station to its perfect state..

chapters.title: Chapter 159 - Victor’s Teachings
paragraphs: “I got it, it’s a communication base station.”
Victor walked out from the pile of discarded machinery and handed the advanced parts in his hands to Fang Heng.
“To be specific, what problems did you encounter during the repair?”
“The parts you lacked were the advanced parts and part of the A-type circuit parts base plate. I guess the circuit template was damaged...”
Victor nodded and pondered. “Combined with the communication interference you mentioned, intermittent problems...”
“Tm guessing that there’s a problem with the base circulating circuit.
“How about this, I’ll provide you with three solutions. The first one is to use direct coupling...”
Fang Heng took the advanced parts from Victor and listened to Victor’s long speech in silence.
Hmm!
“L like your answer to your question!”
“although I don’t understand it, it should be very powerful.”
Then, the next second, Fang Heng was stunned again.
A row of messages appeared in the game log.
[Hint: You have obtained A-type circuit parts base plate*2, advanced part*10.]
(Hint: Your friendship with Victor has reached a limit.]
(Hint: Victor has taught you mechanical knowledge.]
[Hint: You have listened to Victor’s teachings.]
[Hint: Your intellligence is 5. You have mastered a skill-Victor’s teachings.]
He had mastered a skill just like that?
Fang Heng was stunned. He immediately opened his character panel to check.
Skill: Victor’s teachings.
Level: C.
Description: All your mechanical skill levels +10 (you can break through the current player’s level limit, but the maximum skill level does not exceed Victor’s mechanical skill level).
Awesome.
Fang Heng was currently a Level 13 mechanical maintenance and mechanical disassembly.
With Victor’s teachings, the two skills were directly upgraded to Level 23!
Closing the character’s attribute panel, Fang Heng stared at Victor with a burning gaze.
Just a few casual pointers and it was a C-level skill.
Victor must be an S-level NPC!
He must trick Victor into going back with him!

Fang Heng followed the original path of the sewer and returned to the jewellery shop.
He raised his head to look at the big hole above him. He used a wooden frame to build a platform on the spot and used it to crawl back to the ground.
He left 20 zombies to wait for orders. The rest scattered and began to clean up the zombies in the underground sewer.
After all, there was a high possibility that he would need to use the sewer, therefore he had to clean it up sooner or later.
After giving the order to the zombie clones, Fang Heng returned to the rooftop on the fifth floor.
At night, the members of the Dark Knights were divided into two groups and took turns resting.

“Shoo!”

“Two hours ago, I contacted Team 12. Their current situation is good. Not long ago, they cleaned up a chemical factory and settled down.”

“They will temporarily stay in the factory to rest tonight. The chemical factory is very close to the Meteorite Company. The original plan was to find a way to enter the Meteorite Company after dawn tomorrow.”
Lucia said and quietly looked at Fang Heng.
“wanted to look for you just now, but I couldn’t find you. Later, the communication with Team 12 failed again.”
“Where did you go? Mo Jiawei said you had a plan and went off on your own, but everyone was worried about you.”
“Tm fine. I just ran outside to find some good things.”

“Look at this.”
Lucia looked surprised.
“You went out? At night?”
“Lucia, I think you should focus on the good stuff I’ve found.”
Lucia blinked and looked at the black block in Fang Heng’s hand.
She was even more curious.
“What is this?”
“alright, move aside. I’ll demonstrate it to you on the spot.”

Victor was really powerful!

Along channelling bar appeared above his head again.

Success!
Fang Heng put away the wrench and turned to Lucia. “Come, let’s try again.”
“Okay!”
With the previous successful experience, Lucia was confident in Fang Heng this time.
She sat next to Fang Heng and restarted the communication base station.
Just as she turned on the receiving switch, a voice came from the tower.
“Calling base station! Calling base station!”
“Hello? Hello? Base station? Can you hear me?”
Lucia turned her head to look at Fang Heng in surprise.
The voice coming from the tower had some obvious electric currents, but the communication between the two parties could be heard clearly!
Lucia immediately picked up the communication device to reply.
“Roger! This is the base station, go ahead!”
“Great, we’ve finally made contact!”
“This is Team 3’s leader, Yu Le. I repeat, this is Team 3’s Yu Le. We’ve made a major discovery. We discovered a weapons factory during our mission to search Meteorite Company’s Area E.”
“L repeat, we have discovered a weapons factory.”
Fang Heng and Lucia quickly looked at each other.
He had already gotten some information about the other teams from Chen Yu.
The first batch of people who went to Meteorite Company had better luck, so they were not attacked by the nemesis.
They did not even know that the rest of the troops had already been killed by the nemesis.
However, Lucia was not aware of this.
Lucia quickly communicated the situation of the rest of the troops being attacked by the nemesis to Yu Le, the leader of Team 3.
Yu Le was silent for a moment before replying quickly.
“Lucia, we found a lot of bulletproof armoured vehicles when we were searching earlier, but most of them were damaged. We will immediately try to check the condition of the armoured vehicles.”
“If we are lucky, I think we can rely on the armoured vehicles to gather the teams scattered around the city.”
Armoured vehicles!

chapters.title: Chapter 160 - New Side Mission
paragraphs: (Hint: Your friendship with Lucia has increased.]
Lucia excitedly turned her head to look at Fang Heng and hugged him.
“That’s great! Fang Heng! We’ve found the armoured vehicle!”
‘Was it necessary... to be so excited...
Fang Heng touched his cheek.
Lucia’s eyes flashed with excitement.
This news was too good for Lucia!
Armoured vehicles had high defense capabilities and this could allow them to move around the city!
They could also rescue more members of the Dark Knights and evacuate from Pine City!

“Fang Heng, I’ve contacted Yu Le. They will immediately think of a way to confirm whether the armoured vehicles can be used. Once they find an armoured vehicle that can be used, they will immediately contact us.”
“If everything goes smoothly, they will drive the armoured vehicles to pick us up tomorrow morning.”
[Hint: Your seventh mission: desperate survivors triggered a new special side mission-damaged armoured vehicles. }
Side mission 5: Damaged armoured vehicles.
Side mission difficulty: SSS.
Side mission description: After repairing the survival radio station, you learned that there are damaged armoured vehicles in the weapons factory of Area E of the Meteorite Company Park.
Side mission requirement: Confirm the completeness of the armoured vehicles, and try to repair more armoured vehicles so that they can be used.
Bad luck.
The sudden hint of the mission made Fang Heng’s heart sink.
He quickly glanced at the hint of the mission, and he understood everything.
Once the mission was triggered, most of the armoured vehicles in the factory were in a damaged state.
It seemed that he had to personally go over and repair them.
Fang Heng turned his head and asked, “What are their specific coordinates?”
Lucia confirmed the coordinates and suddenly turned her head.
“You’re going to look for them?”
Fang Heng raised the wrench in his hand.
“The armoured vehicles are damaged. I need to go over and help them restore the armoured vehicles. I’ll also bring them some food supplies.”
“Lremember you said that the food supplies are loaded on the helicopters of the logistics team, right?”
“If everything goes well, I will come back to pick you up tomorrow morning with the armoured vehicle.”
Lucia stood up immediately.
“want to go with you.”
“You? No.”
“Why? I need to protect your safety! It’s very dangerous to move alone.”
Lucia argued.
“Thave enhanced dynamic vision and night vision. In the dark, I can identify all kinds of zombies and target their weak spots.”
“Ican protect you if you encounter special danger.”
“also, I have special training. I can drive an armoured car that ordinary people can’t drive.”
“Once the armoured car is repaired, I can also set off to rescue the others at the first possible moment.”
Oh...
She really had some ability?
“You can drive at night?”
“Yes! I can do it!”
Fang Heng hesitated.
The biggest reason was the current main storyline mission.
The current requirement for the seventh loop main storyline mission: Protect Lucia’s survival until 2 pm tomorrow, and try to clear the obstacles for the team to leave Pine City.
In the process of receiving the mission, Fang Heng realized that Lucia was very important!
If they left Lucia for too long, Fang Heng could not guarantee her safety.
Secondly, it was very early in the morning.
If Lucia had night vision and could drive at night, then they could buy a lot of time!
“We need to use the sewer to get to the interior of the Meteorite Company Park. Moreover, the sewer environment is an anomaly. Are you sure you can hold on?”
“Yes! I can definitely hold on!”
“Okay, one last question.”
Fang Heng spread his hands and signalled with his eyes to the communication base station behind Lucia.
“If we’re leaving, who’s going to control this machine?”
Lucia pointed at the rooftop entrance.
“Him! Can’t he?”
Fang Heng turned his head to look at the iron gate at the entrance.
Mo Jiawei was looking at the two of them with a dumbfounded expression.
Just now, he was still lying on the table in a daze.
The sudden game hint was incomprehensible to him, so he hurriedly went up to the rooftop to check.
“Private Mo Jiawei! I need you to immediately learn the basic operating skills of the base station!”
Mo Jiawei: ???
Fang Heng quickly thought about it.
It didn’t seem to be a problem.
“Sure, you have half an hour. If you can teach him how to operate the communication tower base station, I’ll bring you along.”
Mo Jiawei still looked at Fang Heng with a blank expression.
What’s going on?
Did the God sell him out?
Fang Heng called Mo Jiawei over and patted his shoulder. “Learn well. I’ll go offline to understand the situation. If there’s anything, kick my sleeping bag.”
‘Mo Jiawei opened his mouth and wanted to say something, but a fierce gaze came from the side.
“Private Mo Jiawei! Come here! Now! Now!”
“Ineed you to learn how to operate the communication tower base station as soon as possible!”
While Mo Jiawei was learning, Fang Heng went offline.
“Ding, Ding, Ding!!!”
Opening the game cabin, his phone still rang nonstop.
Fang Heng took the phone.
“This is Fang Heng.”
Chen Yu’s voice soon came from the other end.
“Fang Heng, what’s your current situation?”
“There’s good news. We’ve contacted the Dark Knights’ Team 3 in Area E.”
“They found Meteorite Company’s weapons research and development factory in area E. They also found armoured vehicles inside.”
“If we can repair the armored vehicle, we can think of a way to leave.”
Chen Yu nodded, “Is it the Meteorite Company Park, Zone E? Do you have the specific coordinates?”
Chen Yu quickly memorized the location and handed it to his colleagues at the side.

“Lwill immediately think of a way to inform the players in Team 2 and get someone to persuade the team leader of Team 2 to meet at the coordinates. However, our people don’t have any mechanical maintenance skills.”
“What a coincidence, I learned it. I will go there as soon as possible to help the team repair the armoured vehicle.”
Chen Yu opened his mouth.
He thought, how could Fang Heng even know this?
This was a good thing!
Their success rate of completing the main storyline mission had increased again!

Chen Yu did not think too much and continued, “Alright, there’s another situation. Previously, when Team 2 was exploring Area A, they saw a distress signal sent from Area B. The coordinates were (2701, 8782).”
“Team 2’s leader, Zhang Fang, saw the signal and immediately led his team to provide support. However, after 10 minutes, Team 2 rushed over and discovered that the entire Team 4 had disappeared.”
“Currently, the danger level of Area B within the park has increased significantly.”
“I suggest that we don’t go near that area for the time being without investigating the situation.”
“Alright, I got it. I’ll contact you again.”
Fang Heng memorized the coordinates and hung up the call.
Why was there a problem with Meteorite Company’s Area B?
The Dark Knights’ mercenary group was extremely powerful. In just ten minutes, they were all wiped out. Not a single one of them escaped..2
“Is there something hidden in Area B?”
Fang Heng muttered to himself. The more he thought about it, the more confused he felt.
“Whatever, I shouldn’t think too much. It’s not wrong to follow the main storyline mission!”
Fang Heng decided not to think too much. Currently, he was following the main storyline mission and thinking of ways to gather more Dark Knights’ teams.
At the same time, he was thinking of ways to trick Victor, the engineer that Old Black wanted to kill, into going home with him!
As he was thinking, Fang Heng immediately dialed Liao Bufan’s number.

“Sorry to disturb you so late. It’s an urgent matter.”
Liao Bufan got up from the bed.
He rubbed his eyes and took out the notebook beside the bed. “Boss, please tell me.”
“Get online as soon as possible. Tell Qiu Yaokang to arrange a sterile ward in the shelter as soon as possible.”
“It’s very important. You have to do your best to cooperate. If any special materials are missing during the construction process, contact me immediately.”
Sterile ward?
Liao Bufan quickly wrote it down in his notebook.
His mind was still a little muddled.
He thought that Big Brother was getting more and more complicated.
“Okay, Boss. I’ll tell Qiu Yaokang when I get online.”
“Yes, and one more thing,” Fang Heng warned in a deep voice, “This matter must be kept strictly confidential. No one can know about it, understand?”
Liao Bufan immediately sobered up.
Confidential?!
Big Brother must be dealing with something big!
He nodded solemnly.
“Okay, Boss! Apart from you and me, I guarantee that no one else will know.”

Strong adaptability!

He was most worried that Lucia would forcibly endure the negative effects of the sewer and eventually faint.
At that time, he would have to use the vine zombies to bring her along.
That would be troublesome!

Fang Heng was puzzled.
Earlier, Lucia had shown strength that was beyond that of ordinary people.
For example, when they were on the second floor, she had punched a fist mark on the wall.
Also, Lucia had appeared as the target of the main storyline mission.
She was holding a secret!
Fang Heng moved his gaze away from Lucia.
Now was not the time to explore this secret.

“Now we’ve caught up with them.”
Lucia suddenly understood.
She had felt that something was wrong before.
Indeed, how could the underground sewer be so peaceful? They didn’t even meet half a zombie along the way?
It turned out that Fang Heng’s special ability to control zombies had cleaned it up in advance.
But why did those zombies surround the front?
‘What kind of danger did they encounter?
A layer of red light was attached to Lucia’s pupils.
Through this layer of red light, she could see everything clearly in the darkness.
It was the Hunter!
Lucia felt a chill in her heart.
What a terrifying scene!
A group of zombie monsters surrounded a Hunter in the center.
The vines that extended from the zombie monster’s body tightly wrapped around the Hunter.
The thin thorns on the vines pierced into the skin of the Hunter.
Black blood kept oozing out from under the skin of the Hunter.
The vines seemed to have a life force as they greedily sucked the ‘blood’ of the Hunter.
Amoment later, the Hunter was drained of its blood and fell to the ground.
The zombies spread out one after another and continued to advance with their spears, killing the zombie horde along the way.
Lucia turned back to look at Fang Heng.
Fang Heng nodded.
“Let’s go, let’s follow them.”
After levelling up their equipment, the zombie clones were quite efficient in dealing with ordinary zombies.
Once they encountered the Hunters lurking in the sewer, they would rely on the advantage of the sea of zombies to crush them.
The Hunters couldn’t withstand the siege of so many vine zombies!
But in this way, the speed of the zombie group would be slowed down.
Lucia followed the slow-moving zombies for a few minutes and couldn’t wait any longer.
She quickly switched to the sniper rifle and started to assemble the silencer.
Fang Heng glanced at her but didn’t stop her.
After all, this was a straight passage throughout.
The zombies, attracted by the gunshots, would be dealt with sooner or later.
Sooner or later.
However, when he turned his head, Fang Heng noticed the red glow in Lucia’s pupils.
“Bang! Bang Bang!”
Lucia’s shots were so accurate! She practically hit all her targets!
Fang Heng followed behind Lucia and took out his automatic rifle, trying to aim at the zombies.
Aim, lower the shoulder and relax the arm.
“Bang! Bang Bang!”
“D*mn it, I shot my zombie teammate again!”
Lucia turned her head and looked at Fang Heng.
Fang Heng looked back without blushing.
“What are you looking at? Haven’t you seen a rookie before?”
“You haven’t learned any shooting skills?”
Lucia’s tone was a little surprised.
“Tsk.” Fang Heng curled his lips and said confidently, “Who would learn that!?”
So he also had things that he didn’t know.
Lucia secretly laughed in her heart and started to guide him.
“Bend your right elbow, point the muzzle up, and place it on the right side of your cheek.”
“Oh? Like this?”
“No, it’s not like this.”
Lucia walked behind Fang Heng and taught him how to stand.
Fang Heng swallowed his saliva.
He felt a hot blonde girl close to his back.

“When you shoulder, you should place the end of the gun below the collarbone and the shoulder socket on the inner side of the deltoid muscle of your right arm. The right side of your body is in a straight line with the gun...”
But...
Why did this strategy that Lucia mentioned feel so familiar?
Could it be copied from the forum?
This body had seen this strategy before and had learned it before.
The result was that the brain knew it, but the body...
Fang Heng was mumbling in his heart when a line of small words floated across the lower right corner of his retina.
