chapters.title: Chapter 162 - Weapons Factory
paragraphs: Fang Heng immediately opened the mission panel to check out the skill.
Skill: “C.A.R” tactical shooting action.
Level: C.

Skill effect 1: Using firearms to determine the equipment will increase gun mastery skill level to Level 10; using firearms will increase hit rate by 10% and critical strike rate by 5% (passive effect).
Skill effect 2: After one second of using tactical shooting, the next gun attack will increase the hit rate by 25% and critical strike rate by 15% (passive effect, can stack with effect 1).
Amazing!
Another free C-level skill!
After aiming, it will increase the hit rate by 35% and the critical strike rate by 20%!
In addition, equipping guns will increase the skill level of gun mastery to Level 10. In this way, equipping rifles can avoid the penalty of reduced critical strike rate!
Fang Heng closed his character’s attribute panel and looked at Lucia’s back, deep in thought.
In the underground sewer, Lucia controlled the sniper rifle and shot the zombie through the head!
One-shot, one Tier 1 mutated zombie gone.
What level was she at?
Fang Heng muttered to himself.
Could she also be an S-level?
Should he...
Bring her back to the shelter as well?
“Fang Heng, look over there! We’re here!”
Lucia pointed to an iron ladder not far away, her face full of surprise.
“Fang Heng? What’s wrong?”
“Oh, nothing, nothing. Let’s hurry up.”
Fang Heng felt guilty that he had been caught on the spot.
He focused his mind and looked back at the passage leading up, then tried to wave the communicator in his hand.
“Mo Jiawei? Can you hear me?”
“Roger that, Fang Heng. I’ve confirmed your coordinates. The area above you is the underground equipment room of Meteorite Company’s weapons factory. It has been cleared. There’s no danger.”
“In addition, Team 2 and Team 3 have met up twenty minutes ago. They’re all inside the factory now.”
“Okay!”
“Wait! It’s not over yet!”

‘Mo Jiawei said anxiously, “We just received the feedback from Team 3’s captain. The zombie horde may be affected by the signal flare not long ago. Most of the zombies outside have been attracted to Meteorite Company. The zombies are attacking the Arsenal.”
“What about now? What’s the situation?”
“It’s said that it’s still under control. The entrance of the Arsenal is open and cannot be locked. The team is still guarding it.”
Fang Heng nodded at Lucia.
“Let’s go and take a look.”
The two of them immediately climbed up the ladder.
Fang Heng lifted the manhole cover. The fresh air made him feel refreshed.
Lucia also took off the mask on her face.
Fang Heng temporarily left the zombie group in the sewer. He and Lucia went to the main entrance to meet up with the team.
‘When they arrived at the main entrance of the Arsenal, Yu Le and Team 2 were guarding the entrance to the Arsenal together.
Team 3, led by Yu Le, was very lucky.
‘When they took the helicopter to Pine City, they were not attacked by the nemesis, so the team did not suffer any losses.
After landing at the predetermined location, they immediately followed the original plan to search the entire Meteorite Company Park, Area E, and even found Meteorite Company’s weapons factory.
“Hello, I’m the captain of Team 3, Yu Le. This is the captain of Team 2, Zhang Fang.”
Yu Le noticed Fang Heng and Lucia who had rushed over.
He nodded at the two of them and signalled Zhang Fang, who was commanding the battle.
“So many zombies?”
Fang Heng glanced at the entrance of the weapons factory.
Zombies kept staggering out of the darkness.
They sensed the presence of human beings and rushed into the weapons factory.
At first glance, they could see the zombie horde outside the factory.
“There was a large zombie horde outside the wall. Maybe the zombie horde was affected by the signal bomb, and the wall collapsed under pressure. Then, the zombie horde rushed in.”
“The entrance to the weapons factory is open. After the power is lost, the entrance to the weapons factory cannot be closed.”
“If we evacuate, we can’t take the armoured vehicles away. It will take more time to clean up the factory later.”
Yu Le briefed Fang Heng on the current situation.
“Tve discussed with Zhang Fang. For smoother and more efficient operations, we might as well stay here and guard this place. We can directly eliminate this group of zombies.”
“The number of zombies has started to decrease. We should be able to clear them out in another half an hour.”
“Okay.”
Fang Heng made a rough judgment of the current situation.
The zombies from the outside had not even set foot inside the factory before they were killed by the elites of the Dark Knights.
‘There was also a weapons factory here. There was no shortage of bullets.
With the ability of the Dark Knights, it was not a problem for them to guard the entrance of the weapons factory.
Currently, he only needed to settle the armoured vehicles as soon as possible.
“Where are the armoured vehicles? I’ll go and repair the armoured vehicles first.”
“They’re in the underground parking lot at the back.”

Zhang Fang, who was at the side, heard this and used his assault rifle to signal to Fang Heng the back of the weapons factory. He shouted, “Xiao Jing! Take Captain Fang Heng to the underground parking lot at the back!”
“yes!”
Xiao Jing was a player from the Federation.
He had just graduated not long ago and was lucky enough to be randomly selected out of a few hundred people to join the Dark Knights.
He was just killing zombies to earn some points.
Hearing the order, Xiao Jing put away his gun and stood out from behind the cover.
“Captain Fang, I’ll take you there.”
Fang Heng looked at Lucia who was beside him.
Lucia picked up the sniper rifle and said to Fang Heng, “You go, I’ll stay here to help.”
“Okay! Be careful!”
Fang Heng followed Xiao Jing and retreated towards the passage inside the weapons factory.
“Fang Heng, this is the first time we’ve met. I’m a member of the Federation’s elite team, Xiao Jing.”
He was from the Federation!
Fang Heng came to a sudden realization and became slightly wary of Xiao Jing.
“Hello, Chen Yu told me before that there’s someone in Team 2. Add him as a friend and it’ll be easier to contact him.”
After both parties added each other as friends, not knowing if it was because of his personality, Xiao Jing fell silent.
Xiao Jing was secretly observing Fang Heng.
He was curious about Fang Heng.
Initially, when Xiao Jing heard Chen Yu mention Fang Heng, he was still a little disdainful.
After all, he was just a professional player. He was lucky enough to obtain an $-level talent.
In the game, initial talent did not mean everything. There were a lot of trash skills with S-level talent.
Sometimes, even if it was an A-level skill, after a Level 10 talent enhancement, there was a chance that it would soar to the sky.
However, his superiors also ordered him to pay attention to Fang Heng in this operation.
This caused Xiao Jing to raise his guard against Fang Heng.
During this in-game mission, Xiao Jing quickly realized that Fang Heng was different.
‘The two NPC team captains had completely different attitudes towards him and Fang Heng.
This was caused by the hidden reputation index of the player and the Dark Knights’ honor points!
Xiao Jing’s backer was the Federation. He had spent a lot of effort to join the Dark Knights.
Relying on the Federation’s resources, he had painstakingly completed two days of missions, and he had only just reached the ‘recruit’ honor level.
He wanted to know how Fang Heng had managed to obtain such a high honor level in the Dark Knights, to be able to directly become the captain of the team.
Even the two captains of Team 2 and Team 3 had listened to Fang Heng’s suggestion and had unanimously decided to take the risk to defend the weapons factory.
There was also the sewer!
Xiao Jing checked the sewer after receiving Chen Yu’s order.
‘There were a large number of zombies in the sewer, and among them, there was no lack of Tier 1 mutated zombie-puz zombie.
How did he climb up from that damn place?
He had to observe him! He had to record it!
Xiao Jing thought to himself as he took out his black notebook.
There were two lines of small words on the notebook.
“The target may have a clone skill, to take note.”
“The target’s honor level in the Dark Knights is very high. I have to observe him.”
He wrote another sentence on it.
“The target can pass through the sewer that is densely packed with zombies. I have to observe him..”

chapters.title: Chapter 163 - Pursuers
paragraphs: Soon, Xiao Jing brought Fang Heng to the underground parking lot.
Almost twenty bulletproof armoured vehicles were parked in the parking lot.
“All the armoured vehicles are here. We just checked their condition. Currently, only one of them can still be used, but there’s something wrong with its steering wheel.”
“Okay.”
Fang Heng responded.
He randomly found an armoured vehicle parked on the side of the road and went closer to observe.
(Hint: Detected that you have a skill-mechanical maintenance.]
[Hint: Currently awaiting repair-damaged armoured vehicle. Current damage: 43% (can not be used) (can be repaired).]
Fang Heng took out a wrench from his backpack and looked around.
‘There were so many armoured vehicles in the parking lot. When the time came, it should not be a problem to repair five complete armoured vehicles.
Unfortunately, the armoured vehicles were too heavy and could not be stuffed into the backpack and moved back to the shelter...
Seeing the hesitation on Fang Heng’s face, Xiao Jing asked, “Is there a problem?”
“It’s not a big problem to repair it, but I need some time. You can go outside and help. I won’t delay you from completing your mission.”
While speaking, Fang Heng waved his hand and gave the order to the zombie clone to come and support him.
Xiao Jing wondered if Fang Heng had sent him away on purpose.
“It’s okay. I’ll stay here and guard. Call me if you need help.”
“Okay.”
Fang Heng shrugged, waved the wrench in his hand, and started to repair the armoured vehicle.
It was troublesome to have the people of the Federation by his side.
For the time being, Fang Heng didn’t want to directly expose his zombie clone ability in front of the people from the Federation.
Xiao Jing was different from ordinary people like Mo Jiawei.
The Federation could analyze more details about the zombie clone.
Even though Fang Heng felt that with the Federation’s strength, they should be able to guess his ability very quickly.
‘They might even have guessed it already.
At this moment, Xiao Jing was indeed observing Fang Heng.
‘When he saw a channelling bar that was as long as a minute appear above Fang Heng’s head, Xiao Jing’s heart skipped a beat.
Amazing!
In fact, Xiao Jing had also learned maintenance skills through the Federation not too long ago.
However, he had been busy with the Dark Knights’ missions recently, so he simply did not have enough vitality and time to grind for skill level.
Previously, he had tried to repair the armoured vehicle using his Level 1 mechanical maintenance skill.
The time needed for one repair was 7 minutes, and the difficulty level was SSS.
It was almost impossible to complete the mission.
‘The current game had only been in progress for half a month, so it was already amazing that an ordinary single player could learn the mechanical maintenance skill.
Not to mention having the ability to repair the armoured vehicle, which was a late-stage combat vehicle.
This meant that Fang Heng’s maintenance skill level was very high!
“This should also be recorded and reported to the superiors.”
Xiao Jing thought as he opened the black notebook that he carried with him and added a sentence on it.

“The target has a very high mechanical maintenance level. Based on my judgment, it might be a high-level mechanical talent skill. It does not match the information provided by Chen Yu. This needs to be carefully observed.”
Fang Heng felt something. He raised his head and looked at Xiao Jing who was lowering his head to record.
‘What was he recording in the notebook?
Fang Heng felt that Xiao Jing was a little strange.
Who would carry a notebook with them!
Shaking his head, Fang Heng continued to lower his head to carry out the repair.
[Hint: You have completed the current repair. The damage of the armoured vehicle has been reduced by 7%.]
The repair would take more than one minute.
It was too slow!
At this rate, the repair might not be completed by tomorrow morning!
He had to think of a way to get Xiao Jing to leave.
Fang Heng was thinking of a way to get Xiao Jing to leave when he heard an explosion coming from the entrance of the weapons factory.
Xiao Jing suddenly turned around and looked at the location of the weapons factory.
Fang Heng felt that he had an excuse, so he immediately said, “Go and check on the situation first. I’ll continue to stay here to repair.”
“Okay!”
Xiao Jing felt a little uneasy after such a big commotion. He nodded and immediately returned to the entrance of the weapons factory to check.
It was much more convenient now.
Fang Heng let out a sigh of relief.
He opened the game log and started to control the zombie clones.
But before he could control the zombie clones to get out of the underground passage, the survival radio immediately sent him an emergency message.
[Hint: You have received an emergency message from the survival radio.]
Fang Heng opened the communicator to check.
Xiao Jing: Trouble! It’s the nemesis! Be careful!
The nemesis?!
Fang Heng was stunned.
Oh no!
As he had the badge, he was not afraid of the nemesis.
But what about the soldiers of the Dark Knights?
Oh no!
Lucia was still there!
Fang Heng realized that something was wrong.
Lucia was the key to the mission!
Once she died, the entire main storyline mission would be judged as a failure!
“Troublesome woman!”
Fang Heng did not care about the armoured car at this time, he quickly ran towards the entrance of the weapons factory.
‘What he was afraid of came true. Just as he took a few steps forward, Fang Heng heard Lucia’s voice through the walkie-talkie.
“Fang Heng, the nemesis is attacking the weapons factory. Think of a way to repair the armoured vehicles as soon as possible. I’ll try my best to stall her for a while.”
Stall the nemesis?!
Lucia, you boorish woman!
It’s better to live well than anything else!
Fang Heng was anxious and shouted into the walkie-talkie.
Fang Heng: “Don’t, Lucia. Find a place to evacuate. Don’t get involved with the nemesis!”
Fang Heng: “Hello? Lucia! Lucia?”
The walkie-talkie was quiet.
Pretending not to hear?
Fang Heng finally had a better understanding of Lucia’s personality.
He quickened his pace and ran towards the entrance of the weapons factory.
‘Mo Jiawei: “Fang Heng? Lucia? Can you hear me?”
Mo Jiawei:
‘Sorry to suddenly join the group chat.”
Mo Jiawei: “Previously, I used my talent skill to investigate the nemesis. The nemesis is divided into multiple stages. Now, it’s her first stage.”
‘Mo Jiawei: “The weakness of the first stage lies in the parts of her head and left shoulder that are parasitized.”
Mo Jiawei:
‘In addition, her biggest weakness lies in the back of her neck, where the nemesis is injected with ne-a cells. Once that part is attacked, she will be severely injured.”
Lucia: “Roger!”
Fang Heng opened his mouth.
D*mn it!
He thought, “You can hear the communication now?! Did you stop pretending? You are going to show your cards?”
Fang Heng had just run to the entrance of the weapons factory.
‘There was another loud bang.
“Boom!!!”
A loud bang exploded beside his ear, and Fang Heng stumbled.
He looked up.
‘The factory was burning with raging flames.
‘The nemesis carried a rocket launcher on her shoulder and walked forward step by step, continuously firing rockets at the interior of the weapons factory.
The members of the Dark Knights were scattered behind various shelters, trying to fire to block the advance of the nemesis.
“That’s...”
Fang Heng’s eyelids twitched.
“Chil”
Lucia had somehow made her way to the platform on the second floor of the factory.
She was taking advantage of the time when the nemesis had finished firing the rocket launcher!
She seized the opportunity and jumped down from a high altitude.
The dagger in her hand stabbed into the back of the nemesis’s neck..

chapters.title: Chapter 164 - Faith
paragraphs: “Roar!
The nemesis let out a painful howl as the back of her neck was pierced by a knife.
She was severely injured. She knelt on one knee and forced herself to not fall.
Lucia controlled her body and stepped on the back of the nemesis.
She switched to the assault rifle and pressed the muzzle of the rifle against the back of the nemesis’s neck.
“Bang! Bang! Bang!!”
Along with the sound of gunfire, purple blood splattered everywhere.
The nemesis struggled frantically. She suddenly stretched out her right hand and pulled Lucia behind her, throwing her forward ruthlessly.
“Bang!”
Lucia’s body was thrown out and smashed heavily onto the metallic machinery at the side, producing a dull thud.
Her entire body was in pain as if it had fallen apart.
Was Lucia’s combat strength that strong? Could she withstand the nemesis?
Fang Heng looked at Lucia and then looked at the nemesis.
The nemesis seemed to have suffered a great injury. She still maintained a posture of holding onto the ground with one hand, looking extremely pained.
“Quick! Shoot!”
‘The mercenary groups of the Dark Knights scattered around the various corners of the factory seized the opportunity and pressed their triggers one after another, crazily attacking the nemesis.
“Chi! Chi! Chil!”
The nemesis stretched out her hand again.
Her entire right hand was broken in the middle, breaking into expanding tentacles!
The tentacles were intertwined and tangled together, forming a protective net in front of her, blocking most of the bullets coming from the front!
The nemesis slowly stood up and raised the rocket launcher with her left hand again.
The rocket launcher slowly moved and aimed at Lucia, who had just been injured.
Lucia’s pupils instantly dilated!
She felt the murderous intent from the nemesis!
But she couldn’t stand up!
What should she do!
Lucia’s mind was blank.
At this moment, Lucia saw a figure flash out from the side.
Fang Heng walked forward step by step and stood in front of her.
“Fang Heng! Get out of the way! Don’t stand there!”
Xiao Jing shouted.
He was screaming in his heart.
Fang Heng must be crazy!
For an NPC?!
Blocking a rocket launcher with his body?!
Although the player had three times of rebirth...
But this was also...
Too crazy!
Was he risking his life to gain a favorability rating!
The other members of the Dark Knights couldn’t care less about Fang Heng at this time. They poured bullets on the nemesis, trying to stop her attack.
The next second, to Xiao Jing’s surprise, the nemesis stopped!
She was stunned on the spot for half a second.
Then, the nemesis slowly moved the muzzle away.
Xiao Jing was stunned.
What was going on?
He subconsciously took out the notebook in his pocket.
“The target seems to have scared the nemesis...2”
No! Cross them all out!
How should he write it?
“Xiao Jing!”
Xiao Jing heard Captain Zhang Fang calling his name and looked up.
The nemesis had already aimed the rocket launcher at the area where he was.
“F*ck.”
Xiao Jing could not help but curse in his heart. He clutched his notebook tightly and immediately jumped to the side.
Lucia stared blankly at Fang Heng who was blocking in front of her.
She had just narrowly escaped the gates of hell, and only then did she realize that her back was covered in cold sweat.
Fang Heng also heaved a sigh of relief.
Fortunately, he made it!
The main storyline mission was saved!
Victor’s badge saved his life!
Even now, Fang Heng’s heart was still pounding.
He was extremely glad that he had made a trip to the hospital and obtained the important mission item in advance.
For the first time, Lucia realized that even her voice was trembling.
“Thank, thank you...”
“Let’s go!”
Fang Heng pulled Lucia up from the ground and dashed towards the small door that they had come from.
At the same time, Fang Heng tured on the walkie-talkie and asked.
Fang Heng: “Mo Jiawu, can you hear me? How many forms does the nemesis have?”
‘Mo Jiawu: “I’m not sure. My investigation technique only indicated that this is the first form of the nemesis. From this, I can conclude that there are still many forms.”
Fang Heng quickly estimated the strength of both sides.
Could they kill the nemesis given the current situation?!
Impossible!
The biggest advantage of the nemesis was the powerful regenerative ability of the ne-a cells.
Based on the current conditions, it was impossible to kill her without setting up a plan beforehand!
What should he do?
Since the nemesis could not be provoked, then he should think of a way to escape first!
That’s right! Escape first!
There would be plenty of opportunities in the future!
Fang Heng didn’t have any psychological burden regarding the matter of escaping.
The main storyline mission only required him to protect Lucia!
Fang Heng had only run halfway with Lucia when he realized that Lucia wasn’t running with him.
Fang Heng turned to look at Lucia.
“Fang Heng, I’ll distract the nemesis.”
“Are you crazy?”
Lucia shook her head.
“T’ve thought about it carefully. The armoured vehicles left here are our best hope now.”
“Tm the only one with night vision here. I’m the only one who has a chance of surviving after luring her away.”
“Previously, I saw an intact motorcycle in the weapons factory. I can think of a way to escape with the motorcycle and get rid of the nemesis.”
Lucia stared at Fang Heng, her blue eyes flashing with determination.
“Ican feel it. The nemesis has a special hatred for me. She might be chasing after me.”
‘The nemesis was chasing after Lucia?
Fang Heng quickly thought of something.
If that was the case, then the main storyline mission’s requirement to protect Lucia might make sense?
“Trust me, Fang Heng. I can do it. I will come back alive.”
Let Lucia take the risk?
Absolutely not!
“This is too dangerous!”
Fang Heng said in a deep voice, “No, listen to me. You must not die.”
Lucia was stunned when she heard Fang Heng’s words.
Fang Heng thought to himself, this mission is too strange!
He worked so hard on a mission to reach the seventh loop!
He thought, “And you just had to go and send yourself to death? What do I want?”
Fang Heng wanted to forcefully stop Lucia, but he did not expect the game hint to flash in his vision again.
[Hint: Your favorability rating with Lucia has reached a critical value.]
[Hint: You have triggered the special mission-Lucia’s faith.]
Mission name: Lucia’s faith.
Mission description: Assist Lucia in completing her plan, or make a better battle plan and convince Lucia to complete it together.
Lucia revealed a warm smile.
“Thank you, Fang Heng. Other than my brother, you are the person who cares about me the most.”
Lucia approached Fang Heng and gave him a light peck on the cheek.
“Twill survive, I promise...”
Fang Heng touched his cheek.
He was stunned for a moment.
Lucia turned back resolutely and ran back the way she came.
This is nuts!
This d*mn mission!
“Bang!”
Fang Heng hammered the wall beside him as if he was venting.
This was a game mission. It was useless to forcefully persuade Lucia.
He had to think of a way to solve this problem.
Fang Heng took a deep breath and forced himself to calm down.
He turned on his communicator as he walked towards the entrance of the factory..

chapters.title: Chapter 165 - Lead the Way
paragraphs: Fang Heng: “Hello? Mo Jiawei, are you listening?”
Mo Jiawei: “Er... I’ve been listening to all this time, God.”
‘Mo Jiawei had been listening from the beginning to the end.
He was truly sincere when he shouted out the word “God”.
Mo Jiawei thought to himself that it was amazing!
At such a critical moment, he could still say some scandalous words to Lucia and earn her favorability rating.
Otherwise, why would he say that he was a God!
How could an ordinary person play this game?
God understood this game!
‘Mo Jiawu: “God, what are your orders?”
Fang Heng: “How many Dark Knights have been contacted so far? Do you have the specific locations?”
‘Mo Jiawu: “I’ve contacted seven teams so far. They are respectively at...”
Fang Heng and Mo Jiawei quickly checked the map information, their brains working at full speed.
If Lucia’s plan succeeded, she would be able to successfully get the nemesis out of the weapons factory.
What is the success rate of her shaking off the nemesis?
Very low.
First of all, the nemesis was different from ordinary zombies!
She had some intelligence!
This meant that she could run as fast as a human!
Moreover, her zombie attribute allowed her to not feel tired!
The enhanced effect of the virus body could even allow the nemesis to run faster than a normal human!
Even if she was driving a motorcycle, it would be difficult for Lucia to shake off the nemesis in a short period!
And now, there was a zombie horde outside. Once they encountered a large group of zombies, Lucia’s escape route would be hindered, and her speed would be slowed down.
At that time, she would be caught by the nemesis!
If she wanted to escape successfully, she had to plan her escape route first.
Fang Heng took out his communicator again. “Pull Xiao Jing from Team 2 into the group channel.”
‘Mo Jiawei: “No problem, wait a moment.”
‘Mo Jiawei: “Hello? Xiao Jing? Can you hear me?”
Xiao Jing: “Xiao Jing, copy.”
Fang Heng: “Xiao Jing, it’s Fang Heng. How’s your situation?”
Xiao Jing had just been affected by the rocket launcher’s explosion and was slightly injured. He hid to one side and used a bandage to treat his wound.
He was very curious about Fang Heng’s action when he stood in front of the rocket launcher.
‘What was even more unexpected was that the nemesis had stopped attacking.
“The target seems to have special feelings for a particular NPC. He even risked his life to save the NPC. I suspect that there is an unspeakable secret. It needs to be carefully studied.”
“When the nemesis was about to kill the target, she paused for an unknown reason. I suspect that the target might have a stronger talent skill. This needs to be analyzed.”
Record!
He had to record it down and report it to his superiors after the operation was completed!
Xiao Jing said, “It’s not a big problem. However, the Dark Knights are not in a good condition right now. We can’t stop the nemesis’s attack.”
Fang Heng asked, “What about the outside? Do you know the situation of the zombies inside the park?”
Xiao Jing said, “We checked it an hour ago. The interior of Meteorite Company Park is relatively safe. The density of zombies in the entire area is not as high as in the city.”
Xiao Jing said, “And now, most of the zombies are attracted by the weapons factory and the signal flares in Area B. I estimate that the number of zombies wandering around should be even lower.”
Fang Heng: “Lucia, did you hear that? The number of zombies in the factory is relatively small. After drawing the nemesis’s attention, bring her around the park. Do not leave Meteorite Company Park!”
Lucia: “Roger that!”
Fang Heng quickly ran to the entrance of the factory.
‘The nemesis was wreaking havoc.
She was using rocket launchers to deal as much damage as she wanted.
‘The members of the Dark Knights were no pushovers either.
‘Their movements were nimble, and they moved and dodged in all sorts of ways.
Even so, several people were hit by the rocket launcher and were injured.
“Retreat!”
“Think of a way to stall her!”
‘The members of Yu Le’s team retreated in an orderly manner. At the same time, they used their cover to counterattack, slowing down the nemesis’s movement speed.
“Why can’t this d*mn thing be killed?”
Even if they aimed at the nemesis’s weak point, the damage they could inflict on her was still limited!
“Shoo~!!”
“Bang!”
‘An enhanced armour-piercing bullet accurately hit the back of the nemesis’s neck!
Purple blood exploded from her back!
“Roar!!!”
After being heavily injured, the nemesis once again let out a painful howl.
She shook her body, turned her head again and looked behind her.
It was Lucia!
Lucia had unknowingly circled to the entrance of the weapons factory and hid behind the cover.
She was holding a black sniper rifle in her hand.
“Bang!”
‘The bullet was fired again, and the bullet accurately hit the nemesis’s throat once again.
“Roar!”
The nemesis was heavily injured a few times. She raised her rocket launcher and aimed it at the approximate location of Lucia. Another rocket was fired.
Lucia was already prepared. She dodged to the side with agility.
“Boom!”
Even so, Lucia was still in mid-air. She was hit by the shockwave of the explosion and fell to the ground.
She rolled a few times on the ground and endured the pain as she sat on the motorcycle next to her.
She turned around and glanced at the nemesis. Lucia immediately started the motorcycle and sped to the exit of the weapons factory.1
The nemesis raised her head and looked in the direction that Lucia had escaped.
She took large strides and chased after her.
Seeing that the gap between the two was growing larger and larger, the nemesis gradually increased her pace until she made a running pose.
She directly threw away the rocket launcher in her hand and ran with all her might!
‘What made the members of the Dark Knights even more surprised was that the speed of the nemesis running with all her might was on par with Lucia who was riding the motorcycle!
Fang Heng watched the whole process from the side.
It was a success!
The nemesis indeed had an additional hatred for Lucia.
But Fang Heng still frowned.
Lucia had taken the first step and lured the nemesis away.
Now, they had to think of a way to deal with the aftermath.
It was not a good idea to keep circling the park. Once the fuel ran out, or if an accident happened on the way, the nemesis would still catch up to her.
They had to think of a way to completely get rid of the nemesis!
Fang Heng opened the map and searched the surroundings for any terrain that could be used.
Eh? A chemical plant?!
Fang Heng quickly found the chemical plant located outside Meteorite Company Park.
He remembered that Lucia had mentioned not long ago that Team 12 of the Dark Knights was now staying at the chemical plant.
That chemical plant was also part of Meteorite Company’s assets.
It was very close to Meteorite Company Park!
Fang Heng realized something. He opened the sewer map again and put the two maps together to observe.
Got it!
Aplan was gradually formed.
Fang Heng clenched his fists tightly.
If everything went smoothly, he could even directly get rid of the nemesis!
But he could not carry out this plan alone!
Fang Heng turned his head.
Yu Le led Team 2 and Team 3 to gather the members of the Dark Knights and help treat the injured.
Fang Heng walked forward and said in a deep voice, “Captain Yu, Captain Zhang, I need your help.”
The two men looked at each other..

chapters.title: Chapter 166 - Strategy
paragraphs: Fang Heng’s strategy this time was very simple.
Get Lucia to lure the nemesis to the chemical plant!
Then, use the chemical plant’s flammable and explosive raw materials to blow up the chemical plant and the nemesis!
Even though there would be consequences.
The loud explosion and flames would attract more zombies to gather in Meteorite Company Park. They would be attacked by more zombies later.
However, Fang Heng had no time to think about these details.
Time was of the essence. This was the best method that Fang Heng could think of at the moment.
Yu Le listened to Fang Heng’s plan and frowned, “Fang Heng, I have a question. How can we guarantee Lucia’s safety?”
“Don’t worry. I will make arrangements in advance to ensure her safety.”
Yu Le and Zhang Fang looked at each other again, as if they were asking for each other’s opinion.
A row of game hints flashed under Fang Heng’s vision.
[Hint: In the process of determining... Currently determining the player’s Dark Knights’ honor level, current player’s friendship, current player’s reputation value...]
[Hint: Determining completed. Dark Knights’ Team 2 and Team 3 agree to your plan and will temporarily listen to your orders.]
Yu Le nodded and said, “Alright, there’s no time to lose. Captain Fang Heng, what do you need us to do?”
With the cooperation of the two captains, Fang Heng heaved a sigh of relief.
“Most importantly, I need you to clear out a passage between the park and the chemical plant immediately to ensure the safety of Lucia. The sooner, the better.”
“Tunderstand!”
Yu Le nodded and waved his hand. “Team 3! Follow me!”
Team 2’s captain, Zhang Fang, asked, “What about me?”
“Lead the team to the chemical plant first and meet up with Team 12. Set up the terrain of the chemical plant in advance. I’ll meet up with you guys soon after I finish setting up.”
“Okay!”
‘The members of each team immediately split up after listening to the instructions.
Fang Heng took a deep breath and nodded at Xiao Jing. “Follow Team 2. Keep in touch at all times.”
“Okay! Be careful.”
Xiao Jing had some respect for Fang Heng.
Other than the various ‘unorthodox’ operations that were completely different from those he had seen in the textbook, Fang Heng was indeed quite capable.
To be able to come up with a feasible plan in such a short time and convince Team 2 and Team 3 to be his helpers.
He clearly remembered that persuading the leader of Team 2, Zhang Fang, to come to the weapons factory had taken a lot of effort from his boss. He had almost worn out his mouth.
As he thought about it, Xiao Jing followed Team 2 and took out his black notebook.

“The target is a ruthless character. He just risked his life to save the NPC, and now he wants to use her as bait to lure the nemesis into a trap. He may have anti-social tendencies. I need to pay more attention to him.”
“The target has a high executive ability. He can calmly and quickly respond to unexpected situations. It is extremely dangerous. I suggest investigating his background.”
‘As he watched the members of the Dark Knights rush out of the weapons factory with guns in their hands, Fang Heng quickly turned around and returned to the firearms room and jumped into the sewer.
The sewer could also lead to the chemical plant outside Meteorite Company.
‘When he was planning, Fang Heng had already controlled the zombie clones to clean up the sewer from the weapons factory to the chemical plant.
After identifying the direction, Fang Heng walked toward the chemical plant and turned on his communicator.
Fang Heng: “Lucia? is everything okay?”
Lucia: “The nemesis is still chasing me.”
Fang Heng: “Hold on a little longer. Our people are cleaning up the passage from Meteorite Company’s Area E to the chemical plant. Later, I need you to bring the nemesis to the chemical plant.”
Fang Heng said, “Can you do that? Do you know the specific route to the chemical plant?”
Lucia said, “I can!”
Fang Heng said, “Okay, keep in touch.”
Fang Heng raised his head and sped up to follow the zombie group to clear the remaining zombies in the passage.
Half an hour later.
Fang Heng stared coldly at the two five-meter-tall metal cans in front of him.
The team leader of Team 12, who was left behind in the chemical factory, was unfortunately seriously injured during the crash. He died from a serious infection,
Team 2 and Team 3, who had already rushed over, gathered the original subordinates of Team 12 into their teams.
“Captain Fang, the passage has been cleared.”
“Those two are extremely dangerous flammable storage canisters. Once they explode, the power is enough to blow up the entire chemical plant.”
Fang Heng turned his head and said, “Thank you. Leave it to me from now on. For safety reasons, you guys should evacuate the chemical plant and return to the weapons plant.”
Yu Le frowned and asked in a deep voice, “What about you?”
“Tl stay here to support Lucia. After dealing with the nemesis, I’ll return to the weapons factory to meet up with you guys.”
Yu Le stared into Fang Heng’s eyes for a few seconds.
“Alright, I’ll wait for you at the weapons factory.”
With that, Yu Le waved his hand and led the team to retreat.
Zhang Fang also walked up and patted Fang Heng’s shoulder with his fan-like palm. He nodded at him.
“Take care!”
“Team 2! Follow me! Return to the weapons factory!”
Xiao Jing stood to the side.
He was a little stunned when he saw Fang Heng choose to stay.
He had thought that Fang Heng had chosen to sacrifice Lucia to destroy the nemesis.
But what was happening now?
Fang Heng had chosen to stay?
Was he going to stay here and wait for death?
Or did he have another way?
Could it be the sewer?
Xiao Jing knew that Fang Heng had a special way to enter the sewer.
But the entrance to the sewer was a short distance from the explosion.
Moreover, with such a strong explosion, it was not safe to hide in the sewer.
It was very likely that the sewer would collapse!
Xiao Jing was bewildered.
“Private Xiao Jing! What are you waiting for! Hurry up and follow!”
“Yes!”
Xiao Jing wanted to stay and hide not far away to observe the records.
Unfortunately, the leader of Team 2, Zhang Fang, did not give him this opportunity.
Xiao Jing opened the notebook and quickly crossed out the two records.
“The target has hidden means. Be careful!”
Lucia drove the motorcycle and brought the nemesis around Meteorite Company Park.
When she heard Fang Heng’s order, she immediately left Meteorite Company and followed the main road that had been cleared in advance to the chemical plant.
The chemical plant’s door was open, and there were still scattered zombies wandering inside.
With her night vision, Lucia avoided the scattered zombies along the way.
The motorcycle was still full of fuel.
Fang Heng’s voice sounded through the communicator.
Fang Heng: “Are you here?”
Lucia: “Yes, I can see the entrance.”
Fang Heng: “Lucia, I need your complete trust. Wait and follow all my instructions.”
Lucia: “Okay!”

Fang Heng: “After entering the plant, I need you to go to the chemical raw materials area behind the chemical plant. At that time, you will see two dangerous gas tanks that I have marked with an ‘X’ symbol.”
Fang Heng: “There are torches on the gas tanks, so it’s easy to identify.”

Fang Heng: “After confirming the target’s location, I need you to jump off the motorcycle immediately. The spot where you jumped off is in the middle of the two gas tanks. There is a circle mark on the ground there.”
Fang Heng: “Under the premise of ensuring your safety, try to aim at the circle as the landing point.”
Lucia: “Roger that!”

chapters.title: Chapter 167 - Fake Death
paragraphs: Lucia drove her motorcycle into the raw material area of the chemical plant.
Her eyes searched the area.
Found it!
‘Two gas tanks marked with an “X” symbol and two torches were placed on them. It was an anomaly!
Lucia did not hesitate. She jumped off the high-speed motorcycle and jumped toward the marked circle on the ground.
“Bang!”
Lucia fell to the ground and rolled on the ground twice to relieve the force.
Just as she stood up, she felt something under her feet.
Under her feet, fine vines were climbing up along her ankles quickly!
Her pupils slightly locked, and she subconsciously wanted to get up.
Fang Heng’s voice came through the communicator.
“Don’t move! Lucia! Listen to me! Don’t move at all!”
Lucia froze on the spot.
The thin vines coiled up under her feet at an extremely fast speed!
Lucia didn’t move at all, allowing the vines to gradually extend to her neck.
“Roar!”
The nemesis didn’t slow down, running towards Lucia.
“Chi!!”
Lucia felt the vines instantly contract.
‘A powerful strength pulled her back.
The vines gradually passed over her head and even completely blocked her vision.
Lucia could no longer see the outside world. She heard rustling sounds coming from the outside world.
She could feel that she was being dragged by the vines on the ground!
‘The nemesis chased after Lucia, who was wrapped in layers of vines until she saw Lucia being dragged into the sewer.
“Boom!”
The next second, a loud explosion sounded.
Asmall bomb that was installed on the chemical gas tank detonated.
Two metal tanks containing explosive gas exploded one after another.
“Boom! Boom!!!”
The ground shook violently!
‘The energy from the explosion of the chemical gas tank radiated out. The chain reaction caused the flammable gas tanks in the entire factory to explode one after another!
Amushroom cloud soared into the sky.
The entire factory was shrouded in a thick black fog.
Two kilometres away.
The Dark Knights were on their way to the weapons factory, cleaning up the zombies they encountered along the way.
“Boom!!!”
A thunderous explosion came from the direction of the chemical plant.
The ground under their feet shook violently!
Everyone could not help but look in the direction of the chemical plant.
In the light of the fire, amushroom cloud soared into the sky.
The entire chemical plant was engulfed in a sea of fire.
Everyone fell into silence.
Could they survive in such an environment?
‘The sewer must have collapsed from the explosion!
Xiao Jing swallowed a mouthful of saliva. Holding the notebook in his hand, he tried to open the communicator.
“Fang Heng? Fang Heng, how’s your situation now?”
Perhaps due to the impact of the explosion, the communicator was full of noise and could not be heard clearly.
Xiao Jing faintly felt uneasy.
He was about to take notes when Fang Heng’s voice appeared through the communicator.
Fang Heng said, “I’m fine. Don’t worry about me. Go to the factory first, we will meet up with you all later.”
He was not dead!
Even though he did not know what method Fang Heng used, he was still alive!
Xiao Jing could not suppress his excitement.
He had to record it down and report it to his superiors!
Xiao Jing opened the black notebook and took notes.
“The target has a strong survival ability. He survived the big explosion that could destroy the entire chemical plant. He needs to be observed!
“Private Xiao Jing! How many times have I said it! Don’t dawdle! Quickly follow the team!”
In the depths of the sewer.
The vines wrapped around Lucia’s body gradually dispersed.
Even so, the continuous collisions along the way still caused Lucia to nearly faint from the pain.
Lucia opened her eyes.
‘The first thing she saw was Fang Heng.
Lucia knew that she was safe.
“Fang Heng, Did we succeed?”
“Yes, let’s leave this place first.”
Lucia stood up with Fang Heng’’s help.
It was only then that Lucia realized that the dense vines had already covered the ceiling of the sewer.
It was precisely because of the stability of these vines that the sewer was not crushed by the previous explosion.
Even so, the violent explosion still caused cracks to appear on the ceiling of the sewer.
There were even a lot of crushed stones falling from the ceiling.
“Let’s go out and take a look.”
The entrance of the sewer that they had entered previously had been blocked from the outside.
Fang Heng had no choice but to bring Lucia out from another sewer exit outside the chemical plant.
The fire was still burning in the chemical plant.
After leaving the sewer, Fang Heng and Lucia immediately raised their guns and fired, taking care of a few zombies that were staggering towards the chemical plant.
‘The loud explosion and flames attracted the zombies in the city. They wailed and gathered here.
While there were not many zombies, Fang Heng took Lucia and the zombie team into the chemical plant.
“Fang Heng? Aren’t we going back?”
“Wait a little longer. I need to confirm the status of the nemesis.”
Lucia asked in surprise, “Is she still alive?”
“Tm not too sure.”
Fang Heng quickly flipped through the game log as he spoke.
At the moment of the explosion, a row of notifications about killing zombies appeared in the game log.
However, in his memory, he did not see any hint of killing the nemesis before, and there was no hint that the side mission had been completed.
As expected, there was no hint!
Fang Heng checked again, but he still could not find any relevant game hint.
The nemesis was still alive!
Fang Heng did not expect the nemesis to have such tenacious vitality!
The intensity of the explosion had already flattened the entire chemical plant, but it did not kill the nemesis.
He had to go over and take a look.
What if the nemesis was already at critical HP?
Now might be the best time to strike!
Fang Heng brought Lucia back to the chemical plant’s raw material area.
“Over there!”
Lucia, who had enhanced vision, saw the fallen nemesis at a glance.
Her body was already charred black.
She wasn’t dead yet?
Fang Heng signalled Lucia not to get close. He found a nearby cover to hide and took out an automatic rifle.
“Bang! Bang Bang! Bang Bang Bang Bang!”
Purple blood splattered out from the burnt body of the nemesis.
After a round of bullets, there was still no hint in the game log.
It was as if the bullets had hit a dead body.
Something was wrong!
Fang Heng frowned.
“Fang Heng, look at the ground. What is that thing?”
Lucia noticed something and pointed at the place where the nemesis was lying.
With the help of the light from the fire, Fang Heng’s eyes narrowed into a slit.
‘Was that...?
Aworm?
‘They saw a pale purple worm creature that was only half the size of a palm. It was hiding under the nemesis’s body.
Looking closely, similar purple worms were crawling in and out of the burnt body of the nemesis.
‘There was not much information related to the nemesis in Fang Heng’s body’s memory. He had no idea what this worm was.
He asked Mo Jiawei and Xiao Jing.
‘They might have relevant information.
Fang Heng turned on the communicator.
Fang Heng: “Mo Jiawei, Xiao Jing, Can you hear me? I see a light purple worm on the nemesis.”
Fang Heng: “Do you know what it is? Or how much information do you know about the nemesis?”
‘Mo Jiawei: “Yes, I can hear you. I’m sorry, I don’t have any information here. I can only use my talent skill to obtain information if I see it with my own eyes.”
Xiao Jing: “I know this. Fang Heng, what you are seeing now is the third form of the nemesis, ‘fake death’..”

chapters.title: Chapter 168 - Take It First
paragraphs: Xiao Jing: “After the mother worm that parasitized the nemesis died, the mother worm’s egg sac ruptured. The undead larvae left the ruptured egg sac and began to search for a new host.”
Xiao Jing: “In most cases, a small number of larvae will choose to continue infecting the corpse.”
Xiao Jing: “After some time, the larvae will grow back into a new mother worm within the nemesis. It will once again control the nemesis, which is what we see as ‘resurrection’.”
Lucia raised the muzzle of her gun and aimed it at the worm.
“Bang!”
The worm shattered into a ball of purple pus.
‘Mo Jiawei: “What? According to what you said, the nemesis can be resurrected indefinitely and never die?”

Xiao Jing: “Theoretically speaking, if the intensity of the instant output is sufficient, killing the mother worm and the mother worm’s eggs directly can destroy the nemesis. This has happened before.”

Xiao Jing: “In addition, after the mother worm dies, you can try to destroy all the larvae and worms, burning them continuously with high intensity or using corrosive chemicals to damage the nemesis’s corpse.”

Xiao Jing: “But in this way, the larvae in the nemesis’s body will be stimulated, and there is a chance that they will immediately grow into adult worms and take over the body completely, allowing the nemesis to enter the fourth form.”

Xiao Jing: “The fourth form is irreversible. The nemesis will be taken over by the adult and become an ugly monster. Its mobility will also be greatly reduced and it will no longer have the ability to resurrect.”
Xiao Jing: “Destroying the nemesis in its fourth form will also be able to completely kill it.”
Xiao Jing: “The information regarding the nemesis mentioned above is a top-secret of the Federation. Please do not divulge it to the public, Thank you.”
Larva?
Fang Heng sized up the disgusting creature.
Fang Heng: “How’s the attack power of the larva? Is it contagious?”
Xiao Jin;
‘m not sure, I don’t have any more information.”
Fang Heng: “Then how long does the resurrection time of the nemesis take?”

Xiao Jing: “It depends on the specific situation. Usually, it might take one to three to four hours. If we can freeze the corpse, burn it continuously, or find a way to put it in a bad environment, we can slow down its resurrection speed.”
Fang Heng: “I got it. Thank you.”
It was very troublesome!
Fang Heng felt that the nemesis was more difficult to deal with than the two Tier 4 mutated zombies he had encountered last time.
Continuous high-intensity flame burning? Corrosive chemicals?
This was a chemical plant. If it was sulfuric acid...
It would probably have been destroyed in the explosion just now.
Unfortunately.
On second thought, even if he forced out the nemesis’s fourth form, could he win?
“Fang Heng, what should we do?”
Lucia stopped shooting.
She was a little anxious.
‘There were simply too many worms. A large number of worm creatures had already entered the body of the nemesis. Shooting like this would not have any useful effect.
“There’s no need to waste bullets. Think of a way to slow down its resurrection time.”
In any case, he could not deal with the fourth form of the nemesis.
Why not take some benefits from the nemesis and think of a way to delay her resurrection time...
And then run away!
After making up his mind, Fang Heng turned his head and said, “Lucia, go and see if there’s anything nearby that you can use.”
“Yes, alright!”
Lucia nodded and raised her gun to explore the burning plant.
Fang Heng carefully sized up the nemesis who was in the ‘fake death’ state.
Then, he controlled a vine zombie to stagger to the front.
Fang Heng handed the zombie an empty glass bottle.
The zombie continued to stagger forward until it reached the side of the nemesis.
It slowly squatted down.
“Pada!”
‘The glass bottle covered the worm.
Fang Heng carefully controlled the vine zombie to put the worm into the glass bottle and tightened the cap.
[Hint: Your zombie clone has obtained a glass bottle containing an unknown creature*1.]
[Hint: This item is of high risk and can not be put into the backpack.}
Got it!
Fang Heng secretly cheered in his heart.
Aspecial worm that could control the nemesis.
Its research value was not small!
What if Qiu Yaokang could find a way to turn the zombie clone into the nemesis...
The zombie clone returned with the bottle and walked to Fang Heng.
Fang Heng didn’t reach out to take it.
It was too risky to carry it with him, so it was better to store it first.
With that thought, he controlled the zombie clone to return with the bottle and hide in the sewer.
‘Then, Fang Heng waved his hand again.
Another five zombie clones walked up.
‘When they passed by Fang Heng, each of them took out a few live sample collectors.
“As expected of an S-level character. Qiu Yaokang has foresight. He even predicted that I would encounter such a situation.”
Fang Heng smiled helplessly.
He had brought enough sample collectors this time!
The vine zombie walked to the side of the nemesis one by one.
Several channelling bars appeared above their heads at the same time.
{Hint: Your zombie clone has completed the live sample collection of the nemesis.]
{Hint: Your zombie clone has completed...]
[Hint: Collection failed. Your zombie clone is unable to collect more samples!]
Fang Heng only let go of the nemesis when the game hint failed to collect more live samples.
The zombies handed over all the collected samples to Fang Heng one by one.
[Hint: You have obtained the live sample of the nemesis*24.]
What should he do next?
Fang Heng was hesitating when Lucia’s voice came through the communication device.
Lucia: “Fang Heng, I saw a warehouse on the east side of the plant. We can think of a way to place the nemesis there.”
Fang Heng: “Alright, I’ll be right there.”
“Let’s go take a look at Lucia.”
Fang Heng closed his communicator and continued to control the vine zombies.
Six zombie clones extended out fine vines from their bodies and wrapped around the ‘corpse’ of the nemesis.
Fang Heng led the way while the six vine zombies followed behind, dragging the ‘corpse’ of the nemesis as they slowly moved forward.
Soon, Fang Heng saw Lucia in the burning ruins of the chemical plant.
“Fang Heng, what do you think of that?”
Lucia pointed at a burning chemical tank not far away.
Due to the previous explosion, the entire tank had been affected, and only two-thirds of it was left.
‘The tank was filled with an unknown liquid, which was constantly burning and emitting a pungent smell.
Fang Heng did not know what kind of liquid was in the jar, but there was a warning sign of a poisonous object drawn on the jar.
It was most likely a chemical poison.
Moreover, it looked like it was a combustible substance. It seemed like it could burn for a while longer.
Fang Heng’s eyes lit up.
This seemed to be a good place to dispose of it!
“Lucia, be careful. Let’s stay away from it.”
“Okay.”

chapters.title: Chapter 169 - Complete the Side Mission
paragraphs: Lucia hid behind a cover with Fang Heng.
She carefully stuck her head out and observed Fang Heng’s zombie clone.
“Chi chi chi!”
Six zombie clones dragged the ‘corpse’ of the nemesis to the front of the liquid.
The corpse was unusually heavy, and the six zombies couldn’t lift it at all.
What could they do? Fang Heng controlled more than ten zombie clones to join in.
They used the vines that extended from their bodies to wrap the nemesis tightly.
Then, the vines contracted.
The sixteen vine zombies worked together to lift the nemesis high up, moving her to the top of the burning chemical tank.
“Chi chi chil!”
“lop!”
The vines suddenly loosened, and the ‘corpse’ of the nemesis was thrown into the chemical tank.
Did he succeed?
Fang Heng stared at the chemical tank.
A few seconds later, a few hint messages appeared on the lower right corner of his retina.
(Hint: Player has completed the current mission, side mission 4: Kill or try to control the nemesis so that she cannot attack the helicopter.]
(Hint: The nemesis will not be able to complete the ‘resurrection’ for at least 18 hours.]
(Hint: Your reputation in the Dark Knights has increased significantly.
(Hint: Current mission-the estimated success rate of the desperate survivors has increased to 97%.]
Good!
Fang Heng clenched his fists.
Although he could not kill the nemesis completely, it was enough to complete the mission!
(Hint: You have completed the mission-Lucia’s faith.]
(Hint: Your favorability rating with Lucia has increased significantly.]
(Hint: Your reputation in the Dark Knights has increased significantly.
(Hint: Your favorability rating with Zhang Fang has increased, your friendship with Barker has increased, your relationship with...]
A row of densely packed hints appeared in the game log.
At first, it was still alright. Zhang Fang, David, Barker were all names that Fang Heng recognized.
In the end, all of them were names that Fang Heng had never seen or even remembered.
Was Lucia so popular among the Dark Knights?
Fang Heng felt strange.
He immediately closed the game log.
“Lucia, let’s go back first.”
Seeing that more and more zombies were attracted by the explosions and flames in the chemical plant, Fang Heng called Lucia to take her rifle and return to the sewer along the way they came.
The next day, the sun rose from the east as usual.
The explosion last night caused a large number of zombies to gather in the direction of the chemical plant.
Meteorite Company Park was also affected.
The Dark Knights had been guarding the weapon factory in shifts all night, and each of them only slept for less than three hours.
Until now, the endless zombie team was still attacking the weapons factory.
“Bang!”
Xiao Jing killed a zombie with one shot.
He took a break from his work and lowered his head to write on his notes.
Xiao Jing clearly remembered the scene when Fang Heng brought Lucia back to the weapons factory successfully last night.
‘The entire Dark Knights cheered for the safe return of the two, and their morale soared.
There was even a positive buff effect on them.
This was the first time Xiao Jing had seen Zhang Fang, the stern and old-fashioned captain, so happy.
“The target’s plan was a huge success. He successfully dealt with the nemesis and saved Lucia. His reputation in the Dark Knights has increased significantly. It’s worth noting!”
Xiao Jing stopped writing and looked at the door behind the factory.
He thought for a moment.
He continued to write.

“The target has a close relationship with Lucia. After they came back last night, they stayed in the underground parking lot together for a long time. During that time, outsiders were not allowed to enter. It’s very strange.”
Crack.
As he was thinking, Xiao Jing noticed that the passage door behind him was pushed open.
It was Fang Heng!
Yu Le saw Fang Heng walking out from the parking lot and nodded at him.
“Fang Heng, how i
Fang Heng smiled. “My luck is pretty good. I managed to repair five combat armoured vehicles. It’s enough for us to complete the transportation of the team.”
“Good! Well done, Fang Heng!”
On the other side, Zhang Fang, who heard the conversation between the two, also raised his fist to show his approval.
Xiao Jing looked at Fang Heng in disbelief.
Five cars?
All fixed?
Was his mechanic skill level that high?
And...
Did he have enough vitality?
Xiao Jing was shocked.
Even if he spent an entire night using drugs to overdraw his vitality, he wouldn’t be able to do it, right?
Not to mention, Xiao Jing felt that Fang Heng seemed to be in good spirits.
Fang Heng stretched.
He was indeed in good spirits.
Last night, he went offline to rest after setting the assembly line of the zombie clones.
He had just come online to inspect the work of the zombies.
After all, the threat of the nemesis had been temporarily resolved. There were also Dark Knights guarding the outside, and the parking lot was protected by the powerful Lucia.
He only needed to arrange the work of the zombie clones.
“Captain Yu, Captain Zhang, let’s discuss the next battle plan.”
“Okay.”
Xiao Jing looked at the four people who were gathered together and discussing in a low voice. He was quite envious.
He wanted to participate in it.
But he didn’t dare.
If he went over, he would most likely be kicked out by Zhang Fang.
At the same time, it would also reduce the favorability rating that he had spent so much effort to accumulate.
Helpless, Xiao Jing silently took out his notebook and started recording.

“The target completed the repair of five armoured vehicles in one night. Unless he has an S-level maintenance ability, there is no explanation for this situation. The follow-up needs to be investigated.]
After a simple discussion, the team came up with a follow-up plan.
Considering that there would be a helicopter heading to the rooftop of Area E of the park to evacuate the team, the team decided to split into three teams to move out.
Team 1 stayed at the Area E weapons factory and used the factory as a rendezvous point.
The other two teams led the armoured vehicles to rescue the other teams and return to the weapons factory.
At present, Mo Jiawei had already contacted 80% of the teams through communications.
If everything went well, they would be able to gather most of the members in three to five hours.
Next, they needed to clear out a passage from Area E to the top of the office building.
After getting ready, Fang Heng decided not to participate in the rescue mission.
‘There were less than eight hours left to evacuate Pine City.
He had too many missions at hand.
The first one was to complete Victor’s mission and find the G-virus cell blocker.
At the same time, he also had to find the T-virus used to modify the Licker.
If everything went smoothly, most of the four teams that were ambushed in Area B were also hiding mysterious missions.
Right, there was also the mysterious Area $ of the Meteorite Company.
He was short of time. Now that the nemesis could not move, it would be foolish to run and complete the low-difficulty rescue missions.
These missions could be left to the NPCs and Xiao Jing to complete.
Seize the time and make the most of it!
Lucia was arranged by Fang Heng to go to the Whitechapel with Yu Le’s team to pick up Captain Barker.
She saw that Fang Heng did not choose to go with her, so she walked up and asked.
“Fang Heng? Aren’t you coming with us?”

sentences.text: Lucia hid behind a cover with Fang Heng.
She carefully stuck her head out and observed Fang Heng’s zombie clone.
“Chi chi chi!”
Six zombie clones dragged the ‘corpse’ of the nemesis to the front of the liquid.
The corpse was unusually heavy, and the six zombies couldn’t lift it at all.
What could they do?
Fang Heng controlled more than ten zombie clones to join in.
They used the vines that extended from their bodies to wrap the nemesis tightly.
Then, the vines contracted.
The sixteen vine zombies worked together to lift the nemesis high up, moving her to the top of the burning chemical tank.
“Chi chi chil!”
“lop!”
The vines suddenly loosened, and the ‘corpse’ of the nemesis was thrown into the chemical tank.
Did he succeed?
Fang Heng stared at the chemical tank.

(Hint: The nemesis will not be able to complete the ‘resurrection’ for at least 18 hours.]
(Hint: Your reputation in the Dark Knights has increased significantly.
(Hint: Current mission-the estimated success rate of the desperate survivors has increased to 97%.]
Good!

chapters.title: Chapter 170 - Look, How About...
paragraphs: “No, I want to explore the interior of Meteorite Company during this time.” Fang Heng shook his head and said, “Don’t forget our initial mission. We can’t come here for nothing.”
“You want to explore the interior of Meteorite Company alone? It’s too dangerous.”
“It’s okay.”
Fang Heng spread his hands and looked fearless.
“Tm already used to danger. There’s nothing to be afraid of.”
Lucia pursed her lips.
After hesitating for a while, she made a decision.
“alright, I’ll go with you.”
Eh? Lucia didn’t bother to look for her brother?
Fang Heng was a little surprised. He raised his head and looked Lucia up and down.
“You?”
“Yes, I’ll go with you. I can protect you.”
Lucia said as she lowered her head and started to prepare her guns.
Eh...
Fang Heng felt that something was strange.
He knew Lucia’s strength very well.
She was very strong!
She was a ruthless character who could take on the nemesis in the first form!
Her adaptability to the environment and her resistance to attacks were top-notch!
However...
Considering that the main storyline mission needed to ensure Lucia’s safety, Fang Heng initially arranged for Lucia to go to the rescue of the Barker team.
After the explosion at the chemical plant last night, the number of zombies on the streets outside had decreased by a lot.
Xiao Jing from the Federation and the captain of Team 3, Yu Le, also participated in the mission.
‘The danger of the rescue mission was extremely low.
On the contrary, following him to explore the interior of Meteorite Company was extremely dangerous.
Previously, Xiao Jing had mentioned that the Dark Knights’ Team 4 had been completely annihilated while exploring Area B.
‘Who knew if there was any danger in Area D!
He couldn’t take the risk!
In view of Lucia’s reckless behavior, Fang Heng decided to finish the main storyline first.
Fang Heng pondered for a moment and was about to refuse.
Unexpectedly, Lucia said first, “And I know the internal structure of the Meteorite Company’s experimental building very well.”
“Lalso know the special passage to Area $ of Meteorite Company. I can help you if I go in with you.”
“You know about the special passage? Wait, how do you know about it?”
Fang Heng was really shocked.
“Because I’ve been here before.”
Lucia paused for a moment.
She reached out and rolled up her sleeves, revealing her fair arm, which she extended in front of Fang Heng.
There was a symbol on Lucia’s arm that looked like a reverse cross.
Meteorite company?!
Fang Heng’s heart skipped a beat.
He looked at Lucia in confusion.
“Lwas once part of the Meteorite Company’s biological weapon project.”
Lucia’s gaze was a little evasive as she rolled up her sleeves again.
“When I was seven years old, my father brought me to Meteorite Company as a tester for the biological weapon project.”
“At that time, there were hundreds of people my age who participated in the experiment. I was the only one who survived.”
“G-virus experiment?”
“Yes.”
Fang Heng looked at Lucia. “Then you...”

“It was Uncle Quinn who brought me out of here secretly. After that, I joined the government’s Special Witness Protection Program and was secretly transferred to a new city by the government. I started a new life by hiding my identity.”
Lucia did not want to continue recalling these painful memories.
She stroked her hair that hung down the side of her forehead and said with a smile, “After the biochemical incident broke out, I joined the Dark Knights.”
No wonder.
No wonder Barker chose to bring her into the mission.
No wonder Lucia was related to the main storyline loop mission!
Fang Heng already had some guesses in his heart.
‘The nemesis’s special hatred towards Lucia was also very likely because of this.
Lucia had the G-virus in her body!
“Click!”
Lucia finished preparing her guns.
“Tm ready, Fang Heng. We can set off now.”
Fang Heng pondered for a few seconds.
Based on his years of gaming experience, this was most likely one of the settings of the game.
Lucia was most likely required to accompany him into Meteorite Company to explore before they could discover the entrance to the secret Area S.
“Alright, but there are two conditions.”
“Yes!”
“First, you have to promise me that you will listen to me during the mission.”
Lucia raised her hand and vowed, “I promise!”
“Second.”
Fang Heng looked at Lucia’s fair arm.
His heart could not help but beat faster.
Wasn’t this a little too abrupt?
Fang Heng took a deep breath and took out a silver live sample collector from his pocket.
“Lucia, look... how about...”
“The target has shared with me a mission to rescue Captain Barker. The mission difficulty isn’t high, but the reward is extremely generous!!!”
“The target could have completed the mission on his own and earned a large amount of honor points, but he gave the opportunity to me!”
“I misunderstood him in the past. Chen Yu was right. He is indeed a rare good person. I will report this matter to my superiors and try my best to compensate him.”

“The target and Lucia returned to the garage together. What do they intend to do? I always felt that their relationship was a little strange. I have also heard of people having some kind of relationship with game characters in the game... most of these people have anti-social personalities, but if it’s Fang
Heng, it shouldn’t be...”
The car slowly started and headed to Whitechapel, where Barker was.
Through the window of the armoured car, Xiao Jing silently added a note on his notebook. Finally, he looked at the weapons factory with nostalgia.
Fang Heng and Lucia stood together.
He watched as the two armoured cars drove away from the weapons factory.
Until the armoured cars completely disappeared from his sight, Fang Heng turned on his personal communicator and used the single-person channel to contact Mo Jiawei.
“Mo Jiawei, how’s the signal situation?”
“No problem, it’s very clear. Two armoured vehicles have started to move out of the weapons factory. The remaining three armoured vehicles are still at the weapons factory.”
Fang Heng nodded. “Okay, if you see any armoured vehicles heading to the hospital in Pine City, immediately remind me.”
“Small matter! God, don’t worry, leave it to me!”
Fang Heng hung up.
Previously, after completing the repair of the armoured vehicles, he had secretly hidden a few signal transceivers in the interior of the armoured vehicles.
Mo Jiawei’s communication tower could track the location of the signal transceivers.
After all, the employer behind Old Black had also sent people to join this operation. Fang Heng felt that he had to take precautions in advance.
If someone finished off Victor in advance, wouldn’t he have lost an S-level NPC?!
Fang Heng tured to Lucia and said, “Let’s go to Area D to take a look.”
“Okay.”
The two of them returned to the entrance of the sewer.
At this time, the number of zombies in the sewer was close to 200.
The loud explosion last night not only affected the ground, but the zombies in the sewer were also attracted by the sound of the explosion.
For the whole night, the zombie clones in the sewer stayed at their original positions.
They silently cleared the zombie horde that was attracted by the sound.
Fang Heng, wearing a black face mask, took the lead and jumped into the sewer..

chapters.title: Chapter 171 - Qi-nourishing Breathing Technique
paragraphs: ‘There was a layer of red evolution crystals in the sewer.
Fang Heng raised his hand.
The red crystals flew into Fang Heng’s hands.
[Hint: You have obtained evolution crystal fragments*2391, complete evolution crystal*212.]
Lucia also jumped into the sewer behind Fang Heng.
So many zombies?
At first glance, the sewer was densely packed with zombies.
Lucia was shocked. She subconsciously raised her gun.
Wait, these zombies were all controlled by Fang Heng?
Seeing that the zombies were in a daze and had no desire to attack, Lucia put down her muzzle again.
Lucia looked at Fang Heng with surprise.
He could control such a large zombie group?!
Fang Heng looked calm. He continued to control the zombie clones to clear a passage leading to Area D of the Meteorite Company.
Then, he came to a corner.
There was a pile of miscellaneous items there.
They were all collected by the zombie group when they cleared the sewer last night.
Fang Heng checked them.
He didn’t even bother to pick up the miscellaneous items. He only picked up a few books from the pile of miscellaneous items.
Eh? Seven books dropped?
The drop rate today was so high?
“Could it be that they’re all recipes?”
Fang Heng had a bad premonition again.
He muttered softly and flipped through the books one by one.
‘As expected, most of them were recipes.

[Hint: You have obtained the recipe-pepper potato chips, recipe-potato stewed eggplant, recipe-chicken stewed mushroom, recipe-ribs stewed beans, recipe-pork stewed noodles, blueprints-crossbow trap, skill book-gi-nourishing breathing technique.]
Oh my god, today is the complete collection of Manchurian cuisine.
Eh? Skill book!
Fang Heng’s eyes lit up when he flipped to the end.
[Blueprints-Crossbow trap.]
Description: Master the production of the crossbow trap after learning.
Level requirement: Level 5.
[Skill book-Qi-nourishing breathing technique.]
Skill level: C-

Skill description: After learning this skill, the player will gain 1 point of the upper limit of vitality and a small amount of stamina recovery speed. Every time the player’s skill level increases, the player will gain 1 point of the upper limit of vitality.
Additional description: The highest level of this skill is Level 30, and the current skill level can not exceed the current character’s level.
“Blueprints are trash, but the skill book can still be used...”
Fang Heng flipped through to read the two skill descriptions, but he was not interested.
‘The crossbow trap was not easy to use.
It had a high lethality in the early stages, and normal zombies would be instantly killed. However, the problem was that it had to be reloaded every time it was used up.
It was very troublesome.
As for the skill book...
Fang Heng sighed in his heart.
For an ordinary player, the qi-nourishing breathing technique was a low-level skill.
In the game, skill books that could increase the upper limit of vitality and recovery speed of vitality were very rare.
However, for Fang Heng, this skill was of little value.
After all, under normal circumstances, the zombie clone would do all the physical work, so he didn’t need to do it himself.
“It probably means that I can run farther than ordinary people when I run for my life in the future.”
Fang Heng smiled self-deprecatingly.
“Forget it. I picked it up for free. I won’t ask for too much.”
Fang Heng threw a few cookbooks and skill book at his head.
[Hint: You have learned recipe*5. You have gained cooking skill experience points +77.]
[Hint: Your cooking skill has been upgraded to Level 4.]
[Hint: You have learned blueprints-crossbow trap. You have learned the skill-qi-nourishing breathing technique.]
After learning the skill, Fang Heng opened the map to roughly identify the location and pointed to one side.
“Lucia, let’s go.”
‘When the number of the vine zombies in the team reached a certain number, the overall strength of the zombie team had a qualitative change.
Now, even if they encountered a Tier 2 Hunter, the zombie clone could rely on the advantage of numbers to crush it.
‘The Hunters often died miserably. They were sucked dry by the vine zombies.
Fang Heng and Lucia walked forward slowly.
About 15 minutes later, in the back garden of Area D.
The manhole cover on the ground was pried open.
Lucia poked her head out from the manhole cover.
There were still many zombies wandering in the back garden.
Lucia immediately turned over and took out her assault rifle to shoot.
“Puff, puff...”
The assault rifle with a silencer made a faint sound.
The zombies scattered in the back garden were shot in the head one by one and died under the muzzle of Lucia’s gun.
Fang Heng climbed out from the manhole cover behind Lucia.
He looked at the experimental building in front of him.
Coincidentally, the modified T-virus and G-virus blocker that he needed to find this time were all in the experimental building in Area D!
“Lucia, do you know the G-virus blocker?”
Lucia frowned and thought about it carefully.
“No.”
“But this high-tech experimental building used to be the place where Meteorite Company conducts research on new drugs for virus bodies. There should be some in there, right?”
“Yes, let’s go in and look.”
The two of them tried to break open the small door at the back of the experimental building and enter the building.
‘The building was very dark and unusually quiet.
Lucia’s eyes were shrouded in a layer of red light.
She held an assault rifle and quickly scanned the surrounding environment.
Fang Heng also took out a flashlight to illuminate the surroundings.
After confirming that it was safe, Lucia put down the muzzle.

“Fang Heng, if you want to find the related T-virus, you should go to the special laboratory in the third basement. If you can’t find it again, then we can only go to Area S to try our luck and see if we can find anything there.”
“Area S?”
Fang Heng turned his head to ask Lucia, “Do you know anything about Area $2”
“Yes, Area S is where Meteorite Company keeps its top secrets. The company’s special human body experimental area is also set up in Area S. I escaped from there in the past.”
“previously, I heard from the Dark Knights that Meteorite Company’s Area S was destroyed after the biochemical virus was leaked.”
“We suspect that someone activated the self-destruct device in Area S, causing the entrance of the entire Area S to be destroyed.”
While speaking, Lucia had already brought Fang Heng to the stairs leading down.
Fang Heng waved his hand.
More than a hundred zombies behind Fang Heng spread out and began searching the entire building.
To save time, Fang Heng directly led more than ten zombies to the third basement to search for the T-virus research laboratory.
Fang Heng felt that something was wrong.
He didn’t meet any zombies along the way.
The two of them went to the research room for the T-virus in the third basement.
The door of the laboratory was tightly closed.
Lucia tried to press the emergency button on the wall.
The button was useless as it had lost its effect.
She raised her head and looked at the top of the laboratory door.
‘The emergency light button above the door was still on.
“Eh?
Lucia was surprised.
“What’s wrong?”
“It’s very strange. The T-virus research laboratory has entered a locked state. Under normal circumstances, it won’t be under this state.”
“There’s no way to open it?”
“Yes.”
“Forget it. Let’s just hammer our way in..”

He could control such a large zombie group?!

Eh?
Seven books dropped?
The drop rate today was so high?
“Could it be that they’re all recipes?”

He muttered softly and flipped through the books one by one.
