chapters.title: Chapter 172 - Blocker
paragraphs: “Wait, don’t.”
Lucia reached out to stop Fang Heng.

“The internal security of Meteorite Company is of the highest level. Forcefully destroying the door will cause the entire laboratory to be locked. It will be even more troublesome if we want to enter later.”
“Then what should we do?”
Lucia lowered her head and thought carefully.

“There are two options now. The first option is that we can return to the main control room on the sixth floor of the building and use the highest level of authority to lock and unlock it. However, the problem is that we lack the highest level of authority.”
“The second option is to return to the power room in the fourth basement and temporarily cut off the backup power supply there.”
“After cutting off the power supply, we can prevent the trigger of the permanent lock. At that time, we can directly use external force to forcefully break open the door.”
So roundabout?
Fang Heng thought that it was troublesome.
After going through so much, it was most likely a game setup.
However, it would take a lot of time to go back and forth again.
Considering that Old Black’s employer might make a move on Victor, he needed to hurry up and complete the mission.
He could only put the T-virus aside for now.
He had to think of a way to get the G-virus blocker, complete Victor’s side mission and then come back to look for the modified T-virus.
Hmm?
Just as he was about to ask Lucia, Fang Heng thought of something.
Right! Victor gave him a badge!
Victor had mentioned before that his badge could not only block the attacks of the nemesis, it was also Victor’s identity proof.
Victor was the chief engineer, perhaps he had access to it?
Thinking of this, Fang Heng took out the badge.
“Can you see if this thing can be used?”
“Eh? High-level access badge? Where did you get it?”
“A friend gave it to me. Is it useful?”
“Yes, it’s useful.”
“This badge belongs to the chief engineer of the Meteorite Company. It has the highest level of authority as an engineer. With it, we can smoothly enter the power distribution room.”
Lucia held the badge in her hand and observed it. Then, she tried to scan it on the detector on the wall.
“Beep Beep Beep! Insufficient authority!”
Lucia was a little disappointed.
“The engineer’s authority is ineffective against the T-virus laboratory. If I can have the Meteorite Company’s internal employee card, I might be able to give it a try.”
Hmm? Internal employee card?
Fang Heng’s eyes lit up.
Before entering Pine City, he had been to a tool shop by chance.
Not only had he met Old Black there, but he had also found an employee card.
‘The weight-bearing of the employee card was almost negligible. In addition, it was more or less related to Meteorite Company, so Fang Heng kept it in his backpack.
Fang Heng took out the employee card from the bottom of his backpack.
“Lucia, are you talking about this?”
“Do you have it?”
Lucia took the employee card from Fang Heng’s hand.
She looked at Fang Heng a few more times out of curiosity.
Even the Dark Knights couldn’t get their hands on the Meteorite Company’s employee magnetic card. Why was Fang Heng producing one card after another?
“How is it? Is it useful?”
“Tm not sure. The owner of this magnetic card is the research personnel of the G-virus. He should be able to open the G-virus laboratory.”
“If the G-virus research area is not locked, we can try it.”
What a coincidence?
Fang Heng was just about to go look for the G-virus blocker.
But the employee card he had was the magnetic card that could open the G-virus research room?
After thinking for a moment, Fang Heng immediately understood.
Old Black probably already knew part of the mission process in Pine City, so he sent people to the tool shop in advance to look for the G-virus and employee card.
But Old Black didn’t expect to meet him in the tool shop, nor that Fang Heng had found the card beforehand.
“Alright, let’s go to the G-virus research laboratory to check out the situation first.”
Fang Heng had planned to find the G-virus blocker first, so he followed Lucia back to the G-virus research laboratory in the second basement.
While going upstairs, Fang Heng also checked the game log.
The zombie clones had roughly searched the first and second floors of the experimental building.
Most of the rooms in the experimental building had been locked.
‘There were no traces of zombies in the remaining rooms, which was very strange.
At the entrance of the G-virus research laboratory, Lucia tried to verify the effectiveness of the magnetic card.
“Beep beep! Verification successful.”
“Kal!”
A clear sound was heard.
Success!
The door of the G-virus laboratory opened in front of them.
“The lock to the G-virus research room was not triggered!”
Lucia said in surprise and took back the employee card.
The T-virus research room had been locked, but the G-virus research room had not been locked?
Lucia did not have much hope at first, but the actual situation was surprising.
Fang Heng stepped into the laboratory.
The laboratory’s interior was extremely large, roughly divided into seven or eight areas.
The interior was very clean and tidy as if it had not experienced the biochemical virus leak incident.
Fang Heng waved his hand, and more than twenty zombie clones followed behind him. They began to search the interior of the laboratory.
They began searching every corner of the G-virus laboratory!
Fang Heng only needed to stand by the side and rest.
Ina few minutes, the zombies returned from the search and threw the tools they found on the experiment table in front of Fang Heng.
Hint after hint appeared on the right corner of Fang Heng’s retina.
{Hint: Your zombies completed a round of search and obtained three experimental teams’ annual budget*1.]
[Hint: Your zombies completed a round of search and obtained G-virus blocker*1, G-virus blocker research data*1.]
{Hint: Your zombies completed a round of search and obtained the complete G-virus*2...]
Found it!
In less than ten minutes, the zombie clones had already found the G-virus blocker required by Victor’s mission!
({Item-G-virus blocker]
Description: Meteorite Company’s latest research results can be effective against most G-viruses and temporarily block the effects of the G-virus on the human body.
Fang Heng kept the blocker in his backpack.
With it, the chances of getting Victor to return to the shelter would be greatly increased!
The G-virus body and the miscellaneous research data collected were also very useful.
If he gave them to Qiu Yaokang, he could probably increase the shelter’s research level.
Fang Heng thought and roughly browsed through the research data collected by the zombie clones.
‘The information was densely packed with experimental data and technical terms.
He couldn’t understand them at all!
“Whatever, I’ll take it with me!”
Fang Heng stopped struggling and directly stuffed the information into his backpack. He thought that he would just hand it over to Qiu Yaokang when he got back.
Raising his head again, Fang Heng noticed that Lucia was standing in front of an electronic door at the back of the laboratory corridor.
Fang Heng walked over and followed Lucia’s gaze, raising his head to look at the electronic door.
“What? Is there a problem inside?”
“Behind is the special laboratory of the G-virus. Usually, research projects with the highest level of confidentiality are conducted inside.”
“Look.”
‘As Lucia spoke, she tried to swipe the employee card on the magnetic card reader at the entrance.
“Beep beep beep... insufficient access, unable to open..”

chapters.title: Chapter 173 - Tyrant T103 Cultivation Pod
paragraphs: Fang Heng was curious.
“What’s in the research room?”
“Tm not sure about the specifics. I think it’s an experimental project related to the G-virus.”
Fang Heng raised a hammer and gestured to Lucia with his gaze.
“Should I smash the door?”
Lucia hesitated for a moment.
“It’s best not to. I’m not sure if this door is designed with a safety control system. If we force open the door, it might cause the entire room to be locked.”
“The safest way is to find a magnetic card with higher clearance, or to cut off the power first.”
“alright, I’ll find another place to check.”
Fang Heng shrugged.
As he spoke, he took two steps to the right of the door and knocked on the wall.
Fang Heng had just noticed that it was different from the entrance to the T-virus.
‘The outer layer of the wall was made of alloy metal, so it would take a long time to break through it.
The interior of the room was just an ordinary concrete wall.
Just as Lucia had said, breaking through the door might cause the security system to lockdown.
Then, he would make a compromise.
He would make a hole to go into the room!
Fang Heng controlled more than 20 zombie clones in the building to enter the laboratory in the second basement to provide support.
The zombie clones staggered over, raised their hammers and crazily hit the wall.
About 10 minutes later, a small hole was made in the wall.
After confirming that there was no danger in the room, Fang Heng went through the hole in the wall.
“Pada!”
‘As soon as he landed, the sensor light in the special laboratory lit up.
‘The blinding light made Fang Heng unconsciously squint his eyes.
What was that thing?
In the middle of the room, there were three extremely large cultivation pods.
‘The cultivation pods and a large experiment instrument on the side seemed to be in operation.
In the cultivation pod on the far left lay a human more than two meters tall.
From its appearance, it looked the same as the nemesis who attacked the Dark Knights!
The nemesis?!
This was the nemesis’s research room?
Lucia, who followed closely behind, was also shocked. She raised her assault rifle vigilantly.
This nemesis seemed to be still in deep sleep?
Lucia walked carefully to the nemesis and observed.
After a moment, Lucia shook her head and said in a deep voice, “Fang Heng, it’s already dead.”
“Yes.”
Fang Heng walked to the experiment table at the side and picked up a few experiment reports that were placed on the table.
[File-Tyrant T103 (mass-produced) and G-virus fusion report log (Group 29 experiment).]
The 29th fusion failed.
‘The current experiment project failed. It was confirmed that Plan 91 was unable to fuse Tyrant and G-virus.
‘The next group of experiments would use the two-way passage designed by Dr Ryan...
Fang Heng roughly skimmed through the experiment report description.
After reading it, he had a rough understanding.
The one in the cultivation pod was not the nemesis, but the Tyrant.
‘The secret research room of the Meteorite Company was to try and fuse the Tyrant T103 with the G-virus.
Fang Heng thought about it and continued to read another experiment manual.
[Tyrant T103 (mass-produced) cultivation pod instruction manual.]
Eh?
Cultivation pod instruction manual?
Fang Heng raised his eyebrows. He suddenly turned his head and looked at the three cultivation pods in the centre of the room.
These three cultivation pods were used to nurture the Tyrant?
For a moment, Fang Heng’s heart couldn’t help but beat faster.
Good stuff!
Making the Tyrant’s cultivation pod!!
Information about the Tyrant T103 quickly appeared in Fang Heng’s brain.
‘The Tyrant was the Meteorite Company’s first-generation biological weapon, modified by the T-virus.

‘Tyrant T103 was the third-generation version of the first-generation Tyrant. It possessed extremely powerful close combat abilities. Under normal conditions, it was 2.2 meters tall. It emphasized combat and practicality more than the first-generation.
In the awakening state, Tyrant T103’s muscles expanded explosively. Its various abilities were strengthened. Even its arms would evolve into a huge claw-like ‘weapon’!

Unfortunately, Tyrant did not possess high intelligence. It could only accept some of the most basic commands. Moreover, the probability of losing control after entering the awakening state was almost 100%.
So this place was carrying out experiments related to Tyrant.
Then...
With the cultivation pod, could his zombie clone complete the Tyrant’s transformation?!
Fang Heng was very self-aware.
He knew that it was impossible to transform the zombie clone into the nemesis at this stage.
After all, the nemesis was the advanced version of Tyrant, the product of the fusion between the Tyrant’s body and the special purple worm creature.
Therefore, after obtaining the purple worm, Fang Heng had no interest in trying to modify it.
He couldn’t even modify the Licker? And he still wanted to modify the nemesis?
But the Tyrant was different!
The breeding of the Tyrant only required a specially modified T-virus!
Fang Heng lowered his head and quickly flipped through the instruction manual for the cultivation pod.
The Tyrant’s initial cultivation pod had extremely strict requirements for the various attributes of the human body.
Fang Heng believed that the attributes of the zombie clone weren’t bad either.
Just by looking at its value, it could be twice that of an ordinary person!
Moreover, the manual didn’t mention that it had to be modified using a living human...
‘There was a very high probability that it could be completed!
Fang Heng pondered and walked to the front of the cultivation pod.
Other than the Tyrant’s corpse in the cultivation pod on the far left side, the other two cultivation pods were intact.
“Who cares!”
“What are you hesitating for?”
“Since we are already here, why don’t we give it a try?”
“Fang Heng? What’s wrong?”
Lucia was confused. She found that Fang Heng was pacing back and forth between the cultivation pod and the control panel with a worried look.
After a while, he seemed to have figured it out and was very excited.
“It’s nothing. I think we might be able to transform zombies into Tyrants.”
Turn zombies into Tyrants?
Lucia was shocked.
She thought that Fang Heng was crazy?
Fang Heng pressed the red button on the control panel.
“Click!”
The door of the cultivation pod in the middle opened.
Fang Heng controlled a vine zombie to slowly walk into the cultivation pod.
“Bang!”
The door closed again.
“Gulp gulp...”
The body of the cultivation pod was injected with cultivation fluid.
“Chi!!”
Twelve long needles were inserted into the body of the zombie clone under Fang Heng’s control.
“Injecting Tyrant T103 modified T-virus complete:
‘The next step was to wait.
Fang Heng stopped his operation.
He walked to the front of the cultivation pod and observed it, praying in his heart.
Whether this was a success or failure depended on this one move!
He had to succeed!
The zombie clone soaked in the pale yellow liquid didn’t move at all, and its HP didn’t change at all.
“Is it impossible?”
Just as Fang Heng was having doubts, a series of game hints appeared in the lower right corner of his retina again.
[Hint: Your zombie clone has an anomaly.]
[Hint: Your zombie clone is trying to undergo a higher level transformation.]
[Hint: Judgment completed. Current transformation can not be used on a proliferator.]
(Hint: Current transformation success rate: 31%.]
(Hint: Current transformation time: 300 hours.)
(Hint: You can use survival points to shorten the transformation time.]
(Hint: Current transformation can be fused with the original transformation at the same time. Fusion judgment level: low...]

[Hint: You can choose to overlay the transformation (after the overlay, the original transformation’s enhanced effect disappears), or you can choose to consume additional survival points to carry out the fusion transformation.}
(Description: Current fusion transformation success rate: 17%.]
(Hint: After the transformation is completed, there is still a huge risk. The player needs to consume additional survival points and evolution crystals to eliminate this risk..]

chapters.title: Chapter 174 - Probability of Transformation and Fusion
paragraphs: It worked!
It really worked!
Fang Heng was overjoyed. He waved his fist excitedly.
But what did fusion mean?
Did It mean that the original vine zombie and the Tyrant could coexist together?
It would have the vine zombie’s ability and Tyrant’s ability at the same time?!
Fang Heng’s heart was burning.
But 300 hours was a little too long.
After entering Pine City, he had killed a lot of zombies. So far, he had accumulated more than 12,000 survival points.
Spend the points! Quick enhancement!
Fang Heng opened the character panel, found the progress bar and directly filled it up.
“Pop, pop, pop...”
Aseries of bubbles appeared in the cultivation pod.
Visible to the naked eye, the muscles of the zombie corpse in the cultivation pod gradually expanded and its body gradually grew bigger and taller...
[Hint: You have chosen to consume 8,000 survival points to accelerate the evolution process. You will need at least 100 minutes to complete the enhancement.]
“More than an hour and a half?”
Fang Heng couldn’t wait any longer.
If he could complete the transformation of the Tyrant, then the combat ability of his zombie clone would have an explosive increase!
Regardless of the flashy operation, as far as ordinary combat ability was concerned, a Licker could defeat four or five vine zombies while a Tyrant could definitely beat up more than ten Lickers.
After all, it was a mass-produced Tyrant and its strength was somewhat weakened. It was slightly weaker than the first-generation Tyrant.
However, what if the Tyrant also had a part of the vine zombie’s ability after the fusion?
‘That would be very powerful!
Don’t get excited yet.
Fang Heng took a deep breath.
Calm down and think carefully.
The success rate of completing Tyrant’s transformation was only 31%, and the success rate of fusion was only 17%.
From a mathematical point of view, there was a high probability that the transformation would fail.
Moreover, there weren’t many modified nutrient solutions and virus bodies used for the injections in the laboratory.
Fang Heng estimated that he could only complete four modifications at most.
If the probability was low, he might as well fill it with quantity!
No, he couldn’t use it all four times. He had to leave one for Qiu Yaokang to study.
After all, he still needed to mass-produce it in the future...
With Qiu Yaokang around, he should be able to think of a way to increase the success rate of the modification.
Good! Let’s do it!

Fang Heng immediately controlled the zombie clone to pull out the Tyrant’s corpse from the cultivation pod on the left side. Then, he controlled two zombie clones to walk into the remaining two cultivation pods.
The three cultivation pods were fully loaded!
[Hint: You have chosen to use survival points to accelerate your evolution. A total of 16,000 points have been consumed...]
‘The next step was to wait.
From a purely mathematical point of view, there should be one who could complete the transformation...
Looking at the passing of time, Fang Heng could not help but feel a little anxious
Thinking about it, it was useless to stay here.
During the mission period, every minute was extremely precious.
He could not waste time. First, he wanted to find the T-virus.
On the side, Lucia looked at Fang Heng’s various operations. She was still in a rather absent-minded state.
‘Was there no problem?
Even the Meteorite Company was unable to control the Tyrant.
‘What if Fang Heng suddenly went crazy after completing the Tyrant’s transformation...
“Lucia, Lucia?”
Hmm?”
Lucia came back to her senses.
“Lucia, let’s go to the power distribution room and take a look.”
The power distribution room was located in the fourth basement of the experimental building.
Just as they entered the fourth basement, a thick metal door blocked their path.
Fang Heng went forward to try.
It wasn’t locked!
Just as he pushed open the metal door, two grey shadows flashed past Fang Heng’s eyes.
‘What was that!?
‘The black shadow quickly flashed into the right comer in front.
“Bang! Bang! Bang!”
Lucia immediately raised her muzzle.
A series of bullets shot at the black shadow.
There was a row of bullet holes on the wall at the end of the front.
“You saw it too? What is it?”
Lucia frowned.
“It’s a kind of spider. It’s brown and is very big.”
Spider?
Fang Heng was on guard. He gathered more zombie clones to the fourth basement and asked two zombie clones to scout ahead.
The two zombie clones staggered forward.
Fang Heng and Lucia raised their guns and carefully followed behind them.
“Whoosh!!”
A black shadow darted out from behind the corner!
‘The huge impact made the vine zombies fall to the ground.
Fang Heng was stunned.
This time, he saw it.
It was a huge spider! Its body was more than a meter tall!
‘The mutated spider used its sharp and hairy hind legs to firmly press down on the vine zombie’s body.
“Chi! Chi! Chi!!!”
It stood up like a human and used its forelimbs to crazily attack the lower abdomen of the zombie clone.
The vine zombie tried to counterattack.
However, its body was firmly pressed down. Before the vines that extended from its abdomen could spread out, they were cut off by the spider’s sharp forelimbs!
Lucia reacted extremely quickly. She immediately raised her gun and aimed at the spider, firing a series of bullets at it.
“Bang! Bang! Bang!”
“Squeak!!!”
‘The spider was hit by the gun. It let out a how! and quickly dragged the vine zombie into the darkness behind the corner.
[Hint: Your zombie clone (proliferator) is under attack.]
{Hint: Your zombie clone (proliferator) is under attack...]
{Hint: Your zombie clone (proliferator) is dead.]
A row of hints appeared in the game log.
In less than 30 seconds, the zombie clone was completely dead.
Fang Heng’s heart sank.
The vine zombie was crushed!
‘There was a Hunter stronger than the vine zombie inside the experimental building.
‘The team of Dark Knights who had sent out the distress signal earlier was most likely killed by the mutated spider.
Fang Heng turned his head to look at Lucia.
“Have you seen that thing?”
Lucia shook her head repeatedly. Her expression was equally solemn.
“T’ve never seen such a creature in all these years at the Meteorite Company.”
“It might be a mutated creature that combines the T-virus with a creature.”
“[heard that in the large-scale biochemical virus leak incident three years ago, the Meteorite Company discovered that the T-virus could combine with many creatures.”
“probably since that incident, Meteorite Company’s research findings have undergone new changes. Various new T-virus fusion experiments have gradually been put on the agenda.”
Fang Heng nodded.
‘The memory of this body didn’t contain any information about the mutated spider.
“Be careful, let’s continue.”
Since they were already here, they had to brace themselves and move forward to take a look.
Fang Heng controlled five or six zombie clones to walk up side by side. They gathered together to prevent another sneak attack.
‘They walked around the corner.
‘The spider that attacked them earlier had disappeared.
Fang Heng slowed down again.
At the side of the passage, a dried corpse was leaning against the wall.
The corpse was still wrapped in a layer of a white spider web.
Fang Heng slowly walked forward and lowered his head to observe the corpse.
“It’s been dead for a long time.”
‘As Fang Heng spoke, he carefully flipped the corpse.
He found something!
Fang Heng took out a booklet and a bunch of keys from the corpse.
[Hint: You have obtained the mechanic’s memorandum*1, you have obtained the sewage treatment area key*1.]
Fang Heng opened the memorandum and read it..

chapters.title: Chapter 175 - Mutated Spider
paragraphs: Recently, there had been a lot of problems with the ventilation ducts. This was already the seventh complaint.
I can’t delay any longer. If I don’t go and fix it tomorrow, the leader will probably find trouble with me.
T’ll just casually fix it.
This was already the third time. Every time, it was the ventilation ducts that had problems!
Just like the previous times, there was some sticky spider silk inside.
Although I reported it to my superiors, it didn’t seem to be of much use.
It’s only been half a day, and the ventilation duct was full of these sticky things again!
I spent a long time cleaning it up!
The sewage treatment area! That’s the source of all these problems!
That trash, Torre, took a month’s leave. Originally, he was in charge of the sewage treatment area.
T’m not going to that stinky place!
What’s going on? Emergency evacuation order?
Could it be that the biochemical virus has leaked?
Oh my god! I’ve never seen such a big spider!
It’s related to the biochemical virus!
Those b*stards! All the exits have been blocked by them!
Ican only try to leave through the ventilation duct.
This is my only chance to survive!
The contents of the notebook came to an abrupt end here.
Fang Heng handed the notebook to Lucia beside him and lowered his head in thought.
After playing the game for some time, he had a lot of understanding of items like the diary in the game.
Under normal circumstances, they would carry part of the information, which might even include a hint of a mission.
Currently, Fang Heng felt that this notebook gave him a total of three hints.
First, the source of the biochemical leakage incident in the Meteorite Company branch was most likely a mutated spider.
Second, the nest where the spiders first hatched was most likely the so-called dirty and smelly sewage treatment area in the diary.
As for the third...
Fang Heng raised his head and shone his flashlight on the ceiling above.
‘As expected, there was a ventilation duct above the corpse.
The iron railing of the ventilation duct had disappeared, leaving only a black hole entrance.
‘The mutated spider that they had just encountered was most likely using this ventilation duct as the passage.
After reading the diary, Lucia followed Fang Heng’s gaze and saw the passage in the ceiling.
Her pupils were once again shrouded in a layer of red light.
“Fang Heng, I saw a lot of spider webs inside...”
“and mutated spiders.”
Mmm.”
Fang Heng had already guessed it.
The next mission would most likely be related to mutated spiders.
Moreover, from the hint of the mission, they might have to enter through the ventilation duct!
Enter that d*mned place?
Fang Heng did not want to court death.
In such a narrow terrain, how could they still survive if they encountered mutated spiders?
One step at a time. For now, he shall focus on finding the T-virus.
First, he had to solve the problem of the ventilation duct.
Fang Heng used the iron nuggets to make an iron cover, then placed a few wooden frames on the spot.
The zombie clones picked up the iron cover and slowly climbed onto the wooden frames one by one. Then, they climbed to the entrance of the passage and blocked the passage with the iron cover.
Finally, they reinforced a few layers of the wooden planks back and forth.
“It should be able to hold on for a short time...”
Fang Heng muttered to himself.
After thinking for a while, he controlled another clone proliferator to stay on the spot as a ‘sacrifice’.
Once the ‘sacrifice’ was damaged, he could receive the message from the game log.
This way, he would be much safer.
As he continued to explore further, he wouldn’t be wrapped like dumplings by the mutated spider.
“Let’s go.”
Fang Heng and Lucia continued to move forward.
After walking along the straight passage for a while, Lucia stopped and pointed to the power distribution room next to her.
They had arrived.
Fang Heng took out the badge that belonged to Victor and swiped it in front of the power distribution room.
“Welcome, Mr Victor.”
Fang Heng pushed the door open.
The power distribution room was very safe.
He quickly looked at the layout of the room.
‘The entire power distribution room was divided into two rooms, the control room and the backup power room.
In the control room, there was a large monitor and a mechanical control panel.
In the back, the backup power room was filled with a backup generator set.
Fang Heng walked to the monitor and observed.
The monitor marked the distribution of power in each area of the experimental building.
Looking at the layout shown above, Fang Heng fell into deep thought.
“What’s wrong?”
“Do you think this area is a little strange?”
Lucia looked in the direction that Fang Heng was pointing.
She soon realized what was strange.
More than half of the third and fourth basement of the experimental building had been sealed off, forming a complete closed loop.
Lucia pointed at a point in the closed loop.
“This location is one of the emergency passages leading to Area D and Area S. I suspect that during the evacuation phase, the Meteorite Company may have sealed off all the entrances to Area S.”
Fang Heng had originally planned to directly destroy the backup generator set and create a large power outage.
Now, he was afraid that it would not work.
‘The G-virus experiment in the second basement was still ongoing. Once the power was forcefully cut off, Tyrant’s transformation would be stopped.
There was another reason...
Fang Heng reached out his hand and pointed at another location on the map.
“Lucia, look. The sewage treatment area is in this area. It’s very close to the entrance leading to Area S.”
Lucia also understood.
“Are you trying to say that the sealed area is to prevent the mutated spiders from escaping?”
“Yes, it’s very possible.”
If this guess was correct, once the power was tumed off, the originally sealed spiders would very likely completely lose control.
Each mutated spider was extremely powerful. It was unclear how many more mutated spiders were hidden within the Meteorite Company.
It would be troublesome if there were a large number of them.
“For safety reasons, turn off the power supply of the T-virus laboratory first to control the risk.”
Fang Heng walked to the control panel and controlled the mechanical control panel.
“The power distribution has been completed...”
It was done.
On the big screen, the area that was originally marked in red had tured dark, indicating that the power cut had been completed.
“Let’s go.”
Fang Heng and Lucia quickly returned to the entrance of the T-virus research room in the third basement.
The door to the room had been completely locked.
Fang Heng was already prepared. He waved his hand.
Dozens of zombie clones behind him rushed up. They raised the iron hammers in their hands and began to hit the door.
It took more than twenty minutes for the door to finally be broken open.
(Hint: You have dismantled the alloy door. You have received scrap metal*172, scrap alloy*34.]
“Fang Heng, be careful.”
‘The moment the door was broken open, Lucia’s red pupils suddenly contracted.
She immediately pulled Fang Heng back.
chil!
The next second, the brown mutated spider rushed out of the room.
It directly knocked away the two vine zombies that were shielding Fang Heng and pounced on Fang Heng.
Lucia took half a step forward and stood in front of Fang Heng. She raised her automatic rifle and pulled the trigger.
“Bang! Bang bang bang!”
“Squeak squeak!!”
The mutated spider was injured, and purple juice spurted out of its wound.
The powerful firepower forced the mutated spider to fly back into the darkness.
Fang Heng could not see clearly what was in the darkness, but he could hear the rapid sounds of friction coming from the room.
There were indeed mutated spiders in the T-virus research room!
And there was more than one!

This was already the seventh complaint.
I can’t delay any longer.
If I don’t go and fix it tomorrow, the leader will probably find trouble with me.
T’ll just casually fix it.
This was already the third time.
Every time, it was the ventilation ducts that had problems!
Just like the previous times, there was some sticky spider silk inside.
Although I reported it to my superiors, it didn’t seem to be of much use.
It’s only been half a day, and the ventilation duct was full of these sticky things again!
I spent a long time cleaning it up!
The sewage treatment area!
That’s the source of all these problems!
That trash, Torre, took a month’s leave.
Originally, he was in charge of the sewage treatment area.
T’m not going to that stinky place!
What’s going on?
Emergency evacuation order?
Could it be that the biochemical virus has leaked?
Oh my god!
I’ve never seen such a big spider!
It’s related to the biochemical virus!
Those b*stards!
All the exits have been blocked by them!
Ican only try to leave through the ventilation duct.
This is my only chance to survive!
The contents of the notebook came to an abrupt end here.
Fang Heng handed the notebook to Lucia beside him and lowered his head in thought.
After playing the game for some time, he had a lot of understanding of items like the diary in the game.
Under normal circumstances, they would carry part of the information, which might even include a hint of a mission.
Currently, Fang Heng felt that this notebook gave him a total of three hints.
First, the source of the biochemical leakage incident in the Meteorite Company branch was most likely a mutated spider.
Second, the nest where the spiders first hatched was most likely the so-called dirty and smelly sewage treatment area in the diary.
As for the third...

‘As expected, there was a ventilation duct above the corpse.

‘The mutated spider that they had just encountered was most likely using this ventilation duct as the passage.

“and mutated spiders.”
Mmm.”

The next mission would most likely be related to mutated spiders.
Moreover, from the hint of the mission, they might have to enter through the ventilation duct!
Enter that d*mned place?

In such a narrow terrain, how could they still survive if they encountered mutated spiders?

chapters.title: Chapter 176 - Tier 3 Mutants
paragraphs: “Lucia, how many are there?”
Lucia raised her assault rifle and stood at the door, sizing up the room.
“The laboratory is very large. I can’t be sure. There are at least 12 of them.”
“Can you handle it?”
Lucia switched to another magazine.
“No problem.”
They had already come this far. They had to get their hands on the modified T-virus!
Fang Heng and Lucia gave each other a look and made a strong attack gesture.
“Gol”
After receiving the order to attack, the vine zombies quickly rushed into the room.
Lucia followed behind the zombie team and rushed into the room.
“Bang! Bang! Bang!!”
Lucia’s night vision was extremely powerful in this kind of environment. She immediately pulled the trigger and fired.
Because the room was dark, Fang Heng’s vision was greatly restricted. At first, he didn’t dare to go into the room. He just stood outside the door.
Relying on the flashlight, he quickly scanned his surroundings.
As far as his eyes could see, there were at least five or six mutated spiders slaughtering the zombie team.
The zombie clones were at a disadvantage!
The sharp forelimbs of the mutated spiders could easily cut through the vines!
The most troublesome thing was that the mutated spiders were extremely fast. They could even climb along the walls and ceilings.
Lucia also noticed it. She immediately switched to the sniper rifle and relied on the powerful shooting ability of the sniper rifle to shoot down the mutated spiders on the ceiling one by one.
After being shot down, the vine zombies immediately surrounded it.
‘The mutated spider was surrounded by seven or eight zombies, but it still relied on its front limbs to deal crazy damage.
The vine zombies’ vines could not wrap around the spider, so it could only use its iron spear to attack.
{Hint: Your zombie clone is being attacked.]
[Hint: Your zombie clone is causing a small amount of damage to the spider...]
A dense number of game hints appeared in the lower right corner of Fang Heng’s retina.
The number of vine zombies began to decrease.
No, the zombie’s damage output was not enough!
Fang Heng quickly made a decision. He quickly switched to the shotgun, drank a bottle of anti-infection potion and stepped into the room.
He strode to the nearest mutated spider that was surrounded by the zombie clones.
He aimed the muzzle at the mutated spider’s head.
“Boom!!!”
The shotgun was fired at a very close distance.
The mutated spider was severely injured and was stunned.
The vine zombies found an opportunity to entangle the mutated spider with their vines.
The mutated spider had just recovered from its stiff state. It waved its forelimbs to cut the vines.
“Boom!!”
Fang Heng raised his shotgun and aimed at the mutated spider’s face. Then, he shot it into its stiff state.
“Boom! Boom! Boom!!”
Five shots were fired back and forth!
‘The mutated spider finally exploded in front of Fang Heng!
Purple blood splattered everywhere!
[Hint: You have killed a Tier 3 mutated spider. You have obtained a Tier 1 evolution cystal*1.]
The mutated spider was a Tier 3 mutated creature?
No wonder it was so difficult to deal with!
“Bang!”
The abdomen of the spider corpse exploded in front of Fang Heng once again.
Eh? What is this?
After the abdomen of the corpse exploded, Fang Heng saw a dense cluster of small spiders crawling out from under the corpse!
Asmall mutated spider the size of a fingernail?
The small spider immediately crawled towards Fang Heng quickly.
Fang Heng was shocked and quickly stepped back. He took out the Molotov cocktail from his backpack and smashed it on the ground in front of him.
“Boom!”
The Molotov cocktail ignited an area on the ground.
A large number of small spiders was swallowed by the flames.
The remaining small spiders quickly spread out when they saw the flames. In the blink of an eye, they entered some hidden corners and completely disappeared.
“Be careful, after the mutated spider dies, it will still bear small spiders in its body!”
Fang Heng called out to Lucia, who was shooting with a sniper rifle.
“Roger!”
Fang Heng raised his shotgun and walked towards the next mutated spider that was trapped.
‘At the weapons factory.
An armoured car slowly drove into the underground parking lot.
Opening the car door, Team 8 walked out from the armoured car one by one.
Following behind the team was a short-haired woman.
Liu Keyi had a delicate appearance. After graduating, she joined a large gaming company and was promoted to department manager two years later.
In everyone’s eyes, Liu Keyi was both beautiful and talented.
Very few people knew that she was a member of the anti-federal organization.
Liu Keyi followed behind the team and looked at the surrounding environment.
Not only did the players from the Federation deal with the nemesis in such a short period of time, they even completed the repair of the armoured vehicle.
This was very bad news!
This time, the mission she received was to destroy.
To wreak havoc on the Federation’s mission as much as possible and slow down their mission progress.
It was time to act.
Liu Keyi’s gaze stopped at the armoured vehicle in the parking lot.
Taking advantage of the fact that no one was paying attention, Liu Keyi left the team and quietly boarded the armoured vehicle.
‘There were three targets that had been updated not long ago.
First, kill a target NPC. According to the latest news, he was currently in the hospital.
Second, think of a way to resurrect the nemesis in advance and cause trouble to the Dark Knights’ evacuation.
Third, break open the passage in Area S and release the ‘monster’ hidden in Meteorite Company.
When it came to the ‘main storyline’ mission, Liu Keyi did not know what the so-called ‘monster’ was.

She only knew one thing. She only needed to think of a way to destroy the backup power supply in Meteorite Company Park to complete the mission, which would bring quite a lot of trouble to the Federation.
Of course, the most important mission was to think of a way to kill that NPC!
‘As the scene at the weapons factory was extremely chaotic, no one realized that Liu Keyi was driving the armoured vehicle to leave the weapons factory on her own.
Liu Keyi also didn’t know that the armoured car’s every move had long been seen by Mo Jiawei.
“God indeed predicted everything. This lady drove away secretly. It’s obvious that she’s not a good person.”
Mo Jiawei chuckled.
He immediately opened the communication device and tried to contact Fang Heng.
In the basement, the last mutated spider fell under the continuous bombardment of the shotgun.
Fang Heng skillfully threw a Molotov cocktail at the mutated spider’s corpse.
“Boom!”
Before the little spiders could escape from their mother’s body, they let out squeaking sounds and were burned to ashes by the flames.
(Hint: In this battle, you have obtained survival points*2,714. You have obtained complete evolution crystals*13, Tier 1 evolution cystal*5, gun mastery skill experience point +562.]
“Finally, it’s all settled!”
Seeing that the mutated spider was no longer crawling out of the ventilation duct, Fang Heng couldn’t help but sigh.
Fang Heng didn’t even have time to catch his breath, He made several iron covers in a row, then controlled the zombie clones to seal all the vents in the laboratory.
After reinforcing all the vents twice, Fang Heng finally let out a sigh of relief and sat down at the experiment table to rest.
This battle was a little too tiring.
Lucia changed the magazine.
“Fang Heng, we don’t have enough ammunition. If we encounter mutated spiders again, we’ll be in trouble.”
“Hang in there. We’ll go back immediately after we finish searching.”
Fang Heng also glanced at his backpack.
Not to mention Lucia, he didn’t even have many bullets left in his shotgun.
After searching for the modified T-virus, he will immediately run away!
The rest of the mutated spiders were none of his business!
After making up his mind, Fang Heng waved his hand and controlled the zombie clones to thoroughly search the T-virus laboratory.

chapters.title: Chapter 177 - Transformation-fusion Form
paragraphs: Taking advantage of the time while the zombie clones were harvesting, Fang Heng glanced at the game log again.
In the battle just now, he had lost more than 40 zombie clones!
(Hint: Your survival radio has received an emergency message.]
Eh?
Five minutes ago, Mo Jiawei sent a message.
The battle just now was too intense, so he ignored this message.
Maybe there was a signal interference inside the laboratory building, so the communication device of the Dark Knights could not receive the message from the tower.
Fang Heng turned on his survival radio to check.
Mo Jiawei: Fang Heng, the spy has made a move. An armoured car just left the weapons factory, and judging from its direction, it should be heading towards the hospital.
“The player of the anti-federal organization has started to make a move.”
Fang Heng whispered.
He turned off the radio and looked at the time.
‘There were less than 15 minutes left before Tyrant’s transformation was completed.
That ‘spy’ wouldn’t be able to find Victor so quickly, right?
Fang Heng decided to first confirm Tyrant’s condition, then go to the hospital to complete the mission.
“Lucia, let’s go back first.”
Leaving the zombie clones to search for the T-virus, Fang Heng and Lucia returned to the G-virus laboratory once again.
Second basement, G-virus laboratory.
Standing in front of the three large cultivation pods, Fang Heng’s breathing couldn’t help but become rapid.
31% probability of transformation, 17% probability of fusion.
It was time to evaluate his character!
Fang Heng stared at the countdown.
He had never been so nervous before.
The first Tyrant transformation was completed.
The nutrient solution in the cultivation pod was drained.
The zombie clone didn’t move.
“Bang!!!”
Fang Heng watched as the zombie clone exploded into a pile of meat paste in the cultivation pod.
[Hint: Transformation for your zombie clone failed. Your zombie clone is dead.]
“God d*mn it!”
Fang Heng cursed in his heart.
Next!
“Bang!”
Another pile of meat paste.
[Hint: Transformation for your zombie clone failed. Your zombie clone is dead.]
“No way! Am I that unlucky today?”
After failing twice in a row, Fang Heng was already panicking. He clenched his fists tightly.
His face was already a little ugly. He looked at the cultivation pod on the far right.
“Gulp... gulp... gulp...”
Aseries of bubbles emerged from the last cultivation pod.
Before the nutrient solution was completely drained, the zombie clone which was immersed in the nutrient solution suddenly opened its eyes.
“Eh?”
Fang Heng’s heart skipped a beat.
“Did it work?”
(Hint: Your zombie clone has been successfully transformed.]
(Hint: Your zombie clone has been successfully fused.]
Fang Heng was stunned.
“It worked?!”
“And it was a great success!”
“Not only was the transformation successful, but the fusion was also successful!”
He originally thought that he had gambled for nothing, but who would have thought that he had turned the tables?
Fang Heng instantly felt as if he had gone from hell to heaven!
He immediately lowered his head and looked at the game log.

[Hint: The current zombie clone (Tyrant form transformation, vine parasite transformation) has an anomaly and is unstable. You can spend 15,000 survival points and a Tier 1 evolution crystal*3 to eliminate the unstable risk and solidify the current Tyrant form and vine parasite fusion.]
[Hint: Once it enters an unstable state, the zombie’s body will lose control.]
[Hint: After solidifying the clone’s state, the clone can still maintain the Tyrant’s form and the vine parasite’s fusion state after it dies and resurrects.]
“Solidify?”
Seeing the game’s hint, Fang Heng immediately understood.
“Solidify” meant to pay a protection fee to the King of Gods.
Previously, when the vine zombie evolved, there was a similar setting. At that time, modifying the vine zombie required 3,000 points and 100 evolution crystal fragments.
‘The Tyrant’s body was a higher level of solidifying status. Just the price alone was 15,000 survival points.
In addition, he needed three Tier 1 evolution crystals to complete it.
Fortunately, he had just killed a wave of mutated spiders and obtained a substantial amount of survival points and Tier 1 evolution crystals.
Otherwise, he really wouldn’t have been able to pay the ‘protection fee’ to the King of Gods.
Fang Heng said in a low voice, “Choose to use points to solidify.”

{Hint: You have used 15,000 survival points and a Tier 1 evolution cystal*3. Your zombie clone has completed the solidification of the Tyrant’s form transformation and the vine parasite transformation.]
The liquid in the cultivation pod was quickly drained away and the door opened with a swoosh.
The modified Tyrant stood straight in front of Fang Heng.

It was different from the normal zombie clone he used to control.
It was a wonderful feeling that was hard to describe with words.
Fang Heng felt that he could give a slightly more complicated order to the Tyrant.

In the battle just now, he had lost more than 40 zombie clones!
(Hint: Your survival radio has received an emergency message.]
Eh?
Five minutes ago, Mo Jiawei sent a message.
The battle just now was too intense, so he ignored this message.
Maybe there was a signal interference inside the laboratory building, so the communication device of the Dark Knights could not receive the message from the tower.
Fang Heng turned on his survival radio to check.
Mo Jiawei: Fang Heng, the spy has made a move.
An armoured car just left the weapons factory, and judging from its direction, it should be heading towards the hospital.
“The player of the anti-federal organization has started to make a move.”
Fang Heng whispered.
He turned off the radio and looked at the time.
‘There were less than 15 minutes left before Tyrant’s transformation was completed.
That ‘spy’ wouldn’t be able to find Victor so quickly, right?
Fang Heng decided to first confirm Tyrant’s condition, then go to the hospital to complete the mission.
“Lucia, let’s go back first.”
Leaving the zombie clones to search for the T-virus, Fang Heng and Lucia returned to the G-virus laboratory once again.
Second basement, G-virus laboratory.
Standing in front of the three large cultivation pods, Fang Heng’s breathing couldn’t help but become rapid.
31% probability of transformation, 17% probability of fusion.
It was time to evaluate his character!
Fang Heng stared at the countdown.
He had never been so nervous before.
The first Tyrant transformation was completed.
The nutrient solution in the cultivation pod was drained.
The zombie clone didn’t move.
“Bang!!!”
Fang Heng watched as the zombie clone exploded into a pile of meat paste in the cultivation pod.

Your zombie clone is dead.]
“God d*mn it!”
Fang Heng cursed in his heart.
Next!
“Bang!”
Another pile of meat paste.
[Hint: Transformation for your zombie clone failed.
Your zombie clone is dead.]
“No way!
Am I that unlucky today?”
After failing twice in a row, Fang Heng was already panicking.
He clenched his fists tightly.
His face was already a little ugly.
He looked at the cultivation pod on the far right.
“Gulp... gulp... gulp...”
Aseries of bubbles emerged from the last cultivation pod.

“Eh?”
Fang Heng’s heart skipped a beat.
“Did it work?”

“It worked?!”
“And it was a great success!”
“Not only was the transformation successful, but the fusion was also successful!”
He originally thought that he had gambled for nothing, but who would have thought that he had turned the tables?
Fang Heng instantly felt as if he had gone from hell to heaven!
He immediately lowered his head and looked at the game log.

[Hint: After solidifying the clone’s state, the clone can still maintain the Tyrant’s form and the vine parasite’s fusion state after it dies and resurrects.]

“Solidify” meant to pay a protection fee to the King of Gods.
Previously, when the vine zombie evolved, there was a similar setting.
At that time, modifying the vine zombie required 3,000 points and 100 evolution crystal fragments.
‘The Tyrant’s body was a higher level of solidifying status.
Just the price alone was 15,000 survival points.
In addition, he needed three Tier 1 evolution crystals to complete it.
Fortunately, he had just killed a wave of mutated spiders and obtained a substantial amount of survival points and Tier 1 evolution crystals.
Otherwise, he really wouldn’t have been able to pay the ‘protection fee’ to the King of Gods.

chapters.title: Chapter 178 - Acquire the T-virus
paragraphs: After carefully examining the zombie clone’s attribute after the fusion with the Tyrant’s form, Fang Heng exclaimed that it was awesome.
Putting everything else aside, just looking at its HP, it was close to 6,800 points!
It was 20 times more than Fang Heng’s current HP!
On the other hand, Fang Heng had a lot of skills that increased his attribute, and he also drank a lot of potions. His current physique was as high as 24.1 points.
Ordinary player’s HP was not even half of his.

Fused with the vine parasite’s skill and coupled with the Tyrant’s high strength attribute and physique attribute, if anyone was trapped by Tyrant’s vine entanglement skill, who would be able to escape?
Other than being slightly bigger and easily beaten by long-range weapons, there was practically no other disadvantage!
Fang Heng was overjoyed.
‘The Tyrant form could even receive higher level commands!
Fang Heng looked at this two meter tall big guy with excitement.
He was satisfied!
It was worth spending so much on it!
The only pity was that the success rate of the Tyrant form was too low, only one out of the three succeeded.
He could only acquire one Tyrant.
That’s not right!
Thinking carefully, he had the SSS-level enhanced talent ‘rapid growth’!
In another 6 hours, he would be able to obtain an additional Tyrant proliferator!
He was rich!
Fang Heng was too excited, he even lowered his head and counted with his fingers.
Boom!
In theory, he could have four Tyrant vine-transformed zombies at the same time!
With these four, the mutated spiders he had encountered before were nothing!
Fang Heng felt like he had struck it rich overnight.
“Fang Heng.”
Lucia pointed the muzzle of her gun at Tyrant vigilantly.
She felt a strong sense of oppression from Tyrant and carefully walked to Fang Heng’s side,
“Will it be dangerous?”
Dangerous?
‘What kind of words are you saying!
Fang Heng was extremely happy in his heart. No matter how he looked at Tyrant, he found it pleasing to the eye.
“Dangerous? No way. Tyrant is very obedient.”
Tyrant? Very obedient?
Lucia was full of doubt as she heard Fang Heng’s words.
“Take a look if you don’t believe me.”
‘As Fang Heng spoke, he took out a silver live sample collector from his backpack.
‘Tyrant received Fang Heng’s order. It bent down slightly and extended its thick arm towards Fang Heng.
Fang Heng pressed the collector onto Tyrant’s arm.
The needle quickly pierced out from the end of the long tube.
“Chil”
A slow channelling bar appeared above Fang Heng’s head.
[Hint: You have obtained a live sample of Tyrant T103 (fusion transformed body*1.]
“Look, right?”
Lucia: ...
While Fang Heng was studying the attribute of Tyrant’s fusion form, the zombie clone that was searching for the T-virus research laboratory downstairs came back one after another.
‘They threw the items they found in front of Fang Heng one by one.

[Hint: You have obtained item basic T-virus*4, T-virus anti-infection agent*2, Hunter’s research analysis log*1, powerful T-virus blocker experiment log*1, modified T-virus*3, damaged monthly report*1...]
Found it!
Modified t-virus!
Three copies!
Good news came one after another.
Fang Heng felt that his luck was starting to change.
He stuffed all the items collected by the zombies into his backpack.
A great harvest!
This way, after returning to the shelter, the transformation of the Licker could also be put on the agenda.
Vine + Licker + Tyrant!
The three superimposed!
The strength of the Tyrant form could rise to another level!
Fang Heng couldn’t help but clench his fists.
Right, since he had already completed the Tyrant’s evolution, he could also plan the evolution of the nemesis in the future..
Didn’t he get the purple worm previously?
This worm was obviously the key to transforming the Tyrant into the nemesis!
After all, an ordinary Tyrant only had two forms, while the nemesis had four forms, not to mention its ridiculously strong resurrection ability...
Just thinking about it made Fang Heng extremely envious.
Fang Heng took a deep breath and shook his head to calm himself down.
Focus on the present.
It was still too far for him to think about it now. It was better to complete the main storyline mission first.
“Lucia, it’s not safe here. Let’s go back first.”
“Yes, okay.”
For safety reasons, he first returned to the fourth basement where the power distribution room was. He reactivated the power source of the T-virus research room and sealed the mutated spider inside.
“Next, it’s time to deal with that ‘spy’ friend...”
Fang Heng muttered to himself.
Fang Heng and Lucia returned to the weapons factory together.
At this time, Captain Barker had returned safely and was in charge of the overall situation in the factory.
“Fang Heng, you’re back. I’ve heard about what you’ve done. I’l report your outstanding performance to the Dark Knights when I return.”
Captain Barker leaned over and whispered into Fang Heng’s ear, “In addition, I still owe you a favor. Lucia has caused you trouble again, hasn’t she?”
Fang Heng glanced at Lucia, who was arranging her weapons and equipment.
“Not to the extent.”
(Hint: Your friendship with Barker has greatly increased.]
“Oh right, there’s something more important.”
Fang Heng leaned over and whispered into Captain Barker’s ear.
“Thave a piece of gossip. There’s a ‘spy’ in our Dark Knights. She’s very interested in the mysterious signal in the hospital. She just drove out of the weapons factory and went there alone.”
“Spy? Are you sure?”
“Tm more than 70% sure, Captain Barker. I hope that this matter won’t be exposed for the time being. I want to understand something.”
“Alright, Tl go and ask. We’ll keep this matter a secret for now.”
Barker realized the seriousness of the problem. He immediately called a few team leaders over and gathered the team to do a headcount.
Just as Fang Heng said, there was one person missing.
After a moment, Barker came back to Fang Heng.
“We’ve done a headcount. Just as you said, there’s one person missing. Her name is Liu Keyi, She joined the Dark Knights a week ago. Among the rookies, her strength is quite good.”
Fang Heng secretly memorized this name.
Liu Keyi.
He didn’t expect her to be a female player.
“Captain Barker, I want to go to the hospital to have a look.”
“Okay, I’ll leave the mission to you. But remember to rush back here before two o’clock in the afternoon. We’ll evacuate on time.”
“Also, do you need manpower? Do you need to send a small team to follow you and be under your command?”
“Thank you, one person is enough. It’s not convenient to have more people.”
Fang Heng said as he glanced at Lucia, who was tidying up her equipment not far away.
Lucia also seemed to have a telepathic connection as she raised her head and looked in Fang Heng’s direction.
She looked like she was eager to give it a try.
Catching a spy was such an exciting matter. If that boor Lucia knew about it, they would most likely quarrel and go over together.
Fang Heng immediately turned his head to avoid Lucia’s gaze.
He did not want to bring Lucia into this trouble.
The nemesis had already been taken care of, and the Dark Knights had already gathered more than half of their forces.
Now, they were just waiting to clear out a passage to the retreat assembly point.
Mission difficulty was about zero.
Wouldn’t it be nice if they could safely complete the main storyline and get the reward?
Why would he still bring Lucia around to increase the risk?
Fang Heng planned to go to the hospital alone..

chapters.title: Chapter 179 - Vehicle-Tyrant
paragraphs: Fang Heng looked at Barker and continued, “Please keep this matter a secret for the time being.”
“No problem. I’ll tell the others that you’re going on a special mission.”
Barker nodded at Fang Heng and then said to Lucia, “Lucia, come here for a moment. I have something to discuss with you.”
“Coming.”
Lucia walked up. “Is there a mission?”
While Barker and Lucia were talking, Fang Heng quietly returned to the underground parking lot.
There were two armoured cars left in the parking lot.
Fang Heng went on one of the armoured cars.
While looking at the steering wheel and the dashboard in front of him, Fang Heng was a little confused.
Armoured car?
How should he drive it?
He didn’t understand!
With a thought, Fang Heng noticed a row of red instructions for the operation of the armoured vehicle appearing on his retina.
At the same time, a game hint swept across the lower right corner of his retina.

[Hint: Player’s current driving level is Level 2, you can obtain the driving instructions for the armoured vehicle; player can not fully control the armoured vehicle, and will be limited in speed. There is a higher probability of a side flip when turning, please be careful.
Troublesome!
Lucia did not lie to him before. It was really difficult for ordinary people to drive an armoured vehicle.
The setting for driving skills was a little mind-blowing.
Fang Heng thought for a moment.
On second thought, that ‘friend’ from the anti-federal organization probably did not have advanced driving skills.
She would also be affected by the negative effects of not being able to drive.
The game’s weakening effect on both sides was the same.
With this thought, Fang Heng got out of the car and scanned the underground parking lot again.
There were still a lot of abandoned vehicles left in the parking lot, and some of them could still be used.
Level up on the spot?
Not really.
Fang Heng had been driving a truck to transport goods for quite some time, and he hadn’t even reached Level 3 driving.
His efficiency was extremely slow, and it wasn’t something that could be trained in a short period.
“Forget it, let’s go to the sewer.”
Fang Heng left the basement and returned to the entrance of the sewer.
Jumping into the sewer through the manhole cover, Fang Heng habitually put on a face mask.
“Bang!”
The huge Tyrant directly jumped into the sewer from a high altitude and landed heavily on the ground.
Fang Heng turned back to look at the Tyrant behind him.
He touched his chin.
The Tyrant’s form was the initial template for the Meteorite Company’s biological weapon project.
Although it was still unable to make the running movement, the frequency of his feet and the span of each step far exceeded that of an ordinary person.
There were players on the forum who had tested it. The Tyrant’s movement speed was very fast.
Ina short time, the player could throw the Tyrant some distance away by running at an increased speed.
However, as time passed, the player would be affected by the effects of his vitality. The player would not be able to continue running, and Tyrant would catch up to him very quickly.
“It seems like it can be done this way...”
Fang Heng had an idea. He snapped his fingers lightly.
“Chi chi chi...”
Tyrant accepted Fang Heng’s command. Fine vines grew out from under the skin on his back.
The vines formed a protruding chair.
Tyrant slightly squatted down and extended its thick arm towards Fang Heng.
Fang Heng climbed up along Tyrant’s arm. After a somersault, he directly sat on the vine chair behind Tyrant.
“It’s still quite stable.”
Tyrant’s clone stood up straight.
It took Fang Heng and strode towards the front of the underground passage.
Hehe!
Vehicle-Tyrant.
Acquired!
Liu Keyi indeed did not possess a high-level driving ability.
The movement speed of the armoured vehicle had always been very slow.
Before heading to the hospital, Liu Keyi also went to the chemical plant.
She spent some time finding the nemesis in the chemical plant and then used explosives to blow up the chemical tank that the nemesis was soaked in.
“Lassume that the nemesis will be resurrected in a few hours.”
Acruel smile appeared on the corners of Liu Keyi’s mouth.
At that time, the nemesis would bring a surprise to the Federation and the Dark Knights.
If they were lucky enough to wipe out the Dark Knights, the entire main storyline mission might end here.
Seeing that the armoured vehicle was about to arrive at the hospital, Liu Keyi pulled herself together and didn’t think about anything else.
Outside the window, a large number of zombies were gathered around the hospital.
Seeing this, Liu Keyi unconsciously frowned again.
She wasn’t strong enough.
At least, she wasn’t strong enough to break through the zombie team and directly enter the hospital to find the NPC.
However, she had already thought of a countermeasure.
The objective of the mission was to kill the NPC.
In other words, she just needed to think of a way to destroy the hospital.
Liu Keyi continued to drive the armoured vehicle and rushed towards the barbed wire on the periphery of the hospital.
“Bang!”
The armoured vehicle broke through the barbed wire on the periphery of the hospital and created a huge hole.
Liu Keyi stopped the armoured vehicle and tried to control the rocket launcher on the exterior of the armoured vehicle.
She aimed the muzzle at the outer wall of the hospital.
“Boom!!!”
Ahole was created on the outer wall of the hospital by the rocket launcher.
The zombie horde that had gathered outside the hospital was suddenly presented with an opening.
They rushed into the hospital.
Liu Keyi fired a few more rounds at the wall, making a few more holes in the wall. Then, she drove the armoured car into the park of the hospital.
She drove the armoured car around the inside of the hospital and soon noticed that the third building was different from the others.
Inall the buildings, only Building No. 3 was reinforced.
“Let’s see where you can hide.”
Liu Keyi sneered, turned the muzzle and pressed the button to fire the rocket launcher.
“Boom! Boom! Boom!!”
There were not many rocket launchers loaded on the armoured vehicle, only eight in total.
The remaining four rocket launchers all bombarded the building, directly blasting several holes in the building.
“Luck is on his side.”
After all the bullets of the rocket launcher were fired, Liu Keyi was a little disappointed.
If she had enough ammunition, she might have a chance to destroy the entire building.
However, it was about time.
Liu Keyi looked out of the car window.
A large number of zombies had already poured into the hospital building through the hole created by the artillery fire.
Apart from that, the sound of the rocket launcher had caused more and more zombies to gather at the hospital.
With so many zombies, no one in the hospital could survive.
“The second mission has been completed.”
Liu Keyi turned around and started the armoured car, preparing to return to the weapons factory.
Suddenly, she was stunned.
What was that?
The nemesis?!!!
“The spy arrived so quickly?”
Fang Heng had just walked out of the sewer.
Before he could take a breath of fresh air, he saw an armoured car bombarding the building with rocket launchers.
The entrance of the hospital was blasted a few times by the artillery, and a large group of zombies rushed into the building through the opening.
“This is bad.”
“Victor won’t be in trouble, right?”
On the side, the armoured vehicle was turning around and preparing to leave.
Fang Heng’s eyelids twitched.
“You want to run away after creating so much trouble?”
“This is a good opportunity to practice with you, and use this opportunity to test the strength of the Tyrant!”
“Stop her!”
Fang Heng jumped down from behind the Tyrant and gave it the order to attack.
“Bang! Bang bang!”
Receiving the order, the Tyrant immediately took heavy steps and chased after the armoured vehicle..

sentences.text: Fang Heng looked at Barker and continued, “Please keep this matter a secret for the time being.”
“No problem.
I’ll tell the others that you’re going on a special mission.”
Barker nodded at Fang Heng and then said to Lucia, “Lucia, come here for a moment.
I have something to discuss with you.”
“Coming.”
Lucia walked up.
“Is there a mission?”
While Barker and Lucia were talking, Fang Heng quietly returned to the underground parking lot.
There were two armoured cars left in the parking lot.
Fang Heng went on one of the armoured cars.
While looking at the steering wheel and the dashboard in front of him, Fang Heng was a little confused.
Armoured car?
How should he drive it?
He didn’t understand!
With a thought, Fang Heng noticed a row of red instructions for the operation of the armoured vehicle appearing on his retina.
At the same time, a game hint swept across the lower right corner of his retina.
[Hint: Player’s current driving level is Level 2, you can obtain the driving instructions for the armoured vehicle; player can not fully control the armoured vehicle, and will be limited in speed.
There is a higher probability of a side flip when turning, please be careful.
Troublesome!
Lucia did not lie to him before.
It was really difficult for ordinary people to drive an armoured vehicle.
The setting for driving skills was a little mind-blowing.
Fang Heng thought for a moment.
On second thought, that ‘friend’ from the anti-federal organization probably did not have advanced driving skills.
She would also be affected by the negative effects of not being able to drive.
The game’s weakening effect on both sides was the same.
With this thought, Fang Heng got out of the car and scanned the underground parking lot again.
There were still a lot of abandoned vehicles left in the parking lot, and some of them could still be used.
Level up on the spot?
Not really.
Fang Heng had been driving a truck to transport goods for quite some time, and he hadn’t even reached Level 3 driving.
His efficiency was extremely slow, and it wasn’t something that could be trained in a short period.
“Forget it, let’s go to the sewer.”
Fang Heng left the basement and returned to the entrance of the sewer.
Jumping into the sewer through the manhole cover, Fang Heng habitually put on a face mask.
“Bang!”
The huge Tyrant directly jumped into the sewer from a high altitude and landed heavily on the ground.
Fang Heng turned back to look at the Tyrant behind him.
He touched his chin.
The Tyrant’s form was the initial template for the Meteorite Company’s biological weapon project.
Although it was still unable to make the running movement, the frequency of his feet and the span of each step far exceeded that of an ordinary person.
There were players on the forum who had tested it.
The Tyrant’s movement speed was very fast.
Ina short time, the player could throw the Tyrant some distance away by running at an increased speed.
However, as time passed, the player would be affected by the effects of his vitality.
The player would not be able to continue running, and Tyrant would catch up to him very quickly.
“It seems like it can be done this way...”
Fang Heng had an idea.
He snapped his fingers lightly.
“Chi chi chi...”
Tyrant accepted Fang Heng’s command.
Fine vines grew out from under the skin on his back.
The vines formed a protruding chair.
Tyrant slightly squatted down and extended its thick arm towards Fang Heng.
Fang Heng climbed up along Tyrant’s arm.
After a somersault, he directly sat on the vine chair behind Tyrant.
“It’s still quite stable.”
Tyrant’s clone stood up straight.
It took Fang Heng and strode towards the front of the underground passage.
Hehe!
Vehicle-Tyrant.
Acquired!
Liu Keyi indeed did not possess a high-level driving ability.
The movement speed of the armoured vehicle had always been very slow.
Before heading to the hospital, Liu Keyi also went to the chemical plant.
She spent some time finding the nemesis in the chemical plant and then used explosives to blow up the chemical tank that the nemesis was soaked in.
“Lassume that the nemesis will be resurrected in a few hours.”
Acruel smile appeared on the corners of Liu Keyi’s mouth.
At that time, the nemesis would bring a surprise to the Federation and the Dark Knights.
If they were lucky enough to wipe out the Dark Knights, the entire main storyline mission might end here.

chapters.title: Chapter 180 - Crossing
paragraphs: Liu Keyi did not notice Fang Heng who was hiding behind the building.
Looking at Tyrant who was approaching from outside the window, cold sweat broke out on her forehead.
It was not convenient for the armoured vehicle to turn around. In addition, her driving ability was not competent enough, and she was also punished by the game’s negative movement speed.
The entire armoured vehicle’s movement speed was as slow as a turtle’s crawl!
D*mn it!
Seeing Tyrant rush to the front of the armoured vehicle, Liu Keyi shouted in her heart.
“Bang!!!”
A muffled sound.
Liu Keyi felt the entire body of the armoured vehicle shake violently!
The armoured vehicle’s alloy iron sheet was forcefully smashed by Tyrant’s fist, creating a clear dent!
Liu Keyi was so scared that her face turned ashen. Facing such a crisis, she temporarily maintained her calm and could not think.
How could this be?
Wasn’t the nemesis not completely ‘resurrected’?
Even if she was resurrected, why would she chase after her?
Moreover, the people of the organization had said that the nemesis was not the most hostile to players. Usually, their first target was NPCs!
What exactly happened?
Liu Keyi was very regretful that she had just used up all her ammunition.
Now she had become a lamb waiting to be slaughtered.
“Good fellow! Such strong strength?”
Fang Heng was very excited watching from the side.
‘Tyrant gave a few punches to the vehicle, continuously punching at the iron sheet.
Meteorite Company’s armoured vehicle was also of excellent quality and was extremely resistant to punches.
Although the exterior of the armoured vehicle had been punched until it was dented with holes, Liu Keyi was still safe in the driver’s seat.
After a dozen punches, the Tyrant realized that it couldn’t do anything to the turtle shell.
Liu Keyi curled up in the driver’s seat, not daring to leave the armoured vehicle.
All she could do now was pray for the Tyrant to leave.
‘As she was praying, Liu Keyi suddenly felt a tremor under her feet.
She felt weightless.
Fortunately, the seatbelt fastened her body to the driver’s seat.
Looking through the window, Liu Keyi’s face went pale.
After a long time, Tyrant seemed to be angry.
It held the chassis of the armoured car with both hands, trying to lift the entire armoured car up.
Unfortunately, Tyrant overestimated itself.
It was still lacking in strength, so it only lifted the entire body of the armoured car up halfway.
“Roar!”
Tyrant let out a roar and suddenly exerted strength with both hands, lifting the body of the armoured car up fiercely.
“Boom!!”
The armoured car rolled several times in the air, and finally fell heavily to the ground!
The sky and earth turned upside down!
Inside the car, Liu Keyi suddenly had the urge to vomit blood!
She felt that her internal organs had been stirred up as if she was in the washing machine!
But fortunately, the armoured car happened to be facing up and landed safely on the ground.
At the critical moment, Liu Keyi’s survival instinct burst out. She endured the intense dizziness and suddenly stepped on the gas pedal.
‘The armoured vehicle was severely damaged and its speed was greatly reduced, but its performance did not suffer too much damage. It continued to stagger out.
‘Tyrant’s brain was not very good. It did not think that this attack would actually help the other party. It took a step forward and was about to give chase.
“Forget it!”
Fang Heng immediately waved his hand, signalling Tyrant to stop chasing.
The purpose of the test had been achieved.
‘Tyrant was very strong.
Meteorite Company was indeed the most powerful technology company in the background of the apocalypse. The armoured vehicles were still able to move after being ravaged so badly.
It was a pity.
The armoured vehicles were too heavy, and there was no way they could not bring a few to the shelter.
As for Liu Keyi...
Fang Heng raised his head and looked in the direction where Liu Keyi had fled.
There was still a use for her.
After confirming that Liu Keyi was an anti-federal organization member, it would be better to keep her alive.
“Should I sell her to the Federation, or try to get more information from her?”
Fang Heng touched his chin.
“We’ll think about it later. Let’s go back and find Victor first.”
Looking at the zombie horde that was attracted by the explosion, Fang Heng was worried about Victor.
“Tyrant, let’s go.”
Fang Heng pulled out his machete and led Tyrant to the hospital building.
It was a one-sided massacre!
The zombie horde that entered the hospital were mostly ordinary zombies.
Tyrant could kill them in one hit.
Sometimes, if they were lucky, Tyrant could kill two or three of them with one punch!
‘Tyrant opened the way, while Fang Heng waved his machete to help.
Broken limbs flew everywhere!
Under the rocket launcher’s attack, the hospital building was torn apart.
The zombie horde rushed into the hospital building from all directions.
Fang Heng summoned the zombie team from the underground sewer to the hospital and followed Tyrant to the fourth floor.
They killed all the way until they reached the pathway on the third floor.
Fang Heng saw those familiar mechanical balls again.
The mechanical guards were still running, shooting at the zombies that were attacking them.
It seemed that the situation was not bad. The defensive net that Victor had set up was not destroyed.
But how should he go up?
Fang Heng glanced at the window beside him.
He was inspired again.
But could the Tyrant do this basic operation?
Fang Heng tried to communicate with the Tyrant’s elementary consciousness.
It seemed to understand Fang Heng’s meaning and nodded indiscernibly.
“Chi chi cl
Vines extended out from the Tyrant’s back again.
It bent down and stretched out its arm towards Fang Heng.
Fang Heng did not stand on ceremony and stepped out onto the Tyrant’s arm, sitting on the vine ‘chair’ protruding behind it.
The vine extended its ‘seat belt’ and firmly tied Fang Heng to the ‘chair’.
The preparations were complete.
“Pa, pa...”
Tyrant took two steps back.
It took a big step forward and accelerated towards the window.
“Bang!”
Its powerful body completely smashed the reinforced wooden planks of the window into pieces!
Tyrant brought Fang Heng through the window and jumped out.
Outside the window.
After Tyrant left the building, it suddenly raised its right hand.
“Chi! Chichi!!!”
Fine vines grew out from Tyrant’s right arm and quickly darted upwards, firmly clinging to the window on the fourth floor above.
“Chichi!”
The vines rapidly contracted again!
Tyrant’s falling body suddenly stopped, following the contracted vines quickly pulling Tyrant upwards.
In mid-air, the Tyrant once again stretched out its left hand.
“Chi! Chichi!!!”
The fine vines once again wrapped around the fifth-story window.
“Bang!”
After being pulled up five stories by the vines, the Tyrant broke through the fifth-story window with a punch, directly entering the interior from the fifth story.
“Hehe, this multi-purpose vehicle is really not bad.”
Entering the fifth-story corridor, Fang Heng patted the Tyrant’s shoulder and jumped down from its back.
“Stop! Stop there! Don’t move!”
Fang Heng slowly turned around and looked at Victor who was behind him.
Victor was pointing his long-barreled shotgun at him.
“Victor, I didn’t expect this kind of welcoming ritual.”
“Shut up!”
Victor stared at Fang Heng with a fierce expression.
“Don’t think that I don’t know that it was your Dark Knights who lured the zombies outside! What exactly do you want from me!”
“It’s a misunderstanding. Someone did want to harm you, but I have nothing to do with her. Do you remember what I told you before? There’s a spy in the Dark Knights.”
Victor was skeptical.
His trust in the Dark Knights had dropped to the freezing point..
