chapters.title: Chapter 181 - Conditions of Recruitment
paragraphs: “What about the Tyrant behind you! What’s with it!
Victor questioned again, “Aren’t you a member of the Dark Knights? Why are you able to control the Tyrant!?”
Fang Heng patted the Tyrant’s shoulder.
“I’ve introduced it to you before. It’s my special ability. Ever since the apocalypse, many people have awakened some special abilitie:
Fang Heng spoke slowly as he gestured to the bottle of medicine in his hand.
“Look, I spent a lot of effort to help you find the G-virus blocker. I immediately rushed back to look for you.”
“Blocker? You found it so quickly?”
Victor was full of surprise. He stared at the potion in Fang Heng’s hand.
This was a medicine that could save Angel’s life!
“Put the potion on the ground and roll over slowly.”
Fang Heng spread his hands and put the potion on the ground, rolling over to Victor.
Victor picked up the G-virus blocker from the ground as if he had found a treasure and examined it in his hand.
“How is it? Do you believe it now?”
“It’s true...”
Victor put down the long-barreled shotgun in his hand.
His heart was filled with joy, but he also felt a little guilty for his actions just now.
“Tm sorry, Fang Heng. I thought you were in cahoots with that bastard who blew up the building...”
Fang Heng waved his hand. “It’s okay, I understand.”
[Hint: You’ve completed the mission-Victor’s request.]
[Hint: You’ve completed the side mission-unknown distress signal.]
[Hint: Your friendship with Victor has greatly increased.]
“That’s great, that’s great. With it, Angel will be saved. Thank you so much, Fang Heng...”
“I don’t even know how to repay you. I’m so sorry for what happened just now...”
Victor was so excited that he started to ramble.
Fang Heng licked his lips.
Since the mission had been completed and the friendship had greatly increased, he should think of a way to trick Victor back into the shelter.
“It’s okay, Victor. The G-virus blocker has been obtained. What’s your next plan?”
“Next?”
Victor frowned.
“At the beginning of the disaster, I wanted to go back to the Meteorite Company. Only they have a way to help Angel recover.”
“But you can’t find the people from the Meteorite Company anymore. The outside has been reduced to ruins. No one knows the current situation of the Meteorite Company.”
“That’s right. So later on, I wanted to join the Dark Knights. But now it seems that they can’t be trusted either.”
Victor felt that he had been forced into a desperate situation.
He felt helpless and took a deep breath.
“Fang Heng, now you are the person I trust the most. If possible, I hope you can help me find a place to stay in the apocalypse.”
He took the bait just like that?
How could it be so easy?
Fang Heng silently looked out the window.
Should he thank the spy?
If it wasn’t for Liu Keyi, Victor might have joined the Dark Knights directly.
“Victor, although I joined the Dark Knights, I also built a shelter myself.”
“My shelter is still developing, and its power is not as big as the Dark Knights, but I can guarantee your safety.”
“Your shelter?”
Victor was surprised. He looked Fang Heng up and down.
“Yes, it’s me.”
Fang Heng pointed at Tyrant.
“This guy is the bodyguard of shelter. How is it?”
Victor looked at Tyrant beside Fang Heng.
‘Tyrant was tall and strong. It looked very convincing.
Victor lowered his head and was silent for a moment.
In this apocalypse, he did not know where to go.
Victor raised his head and said, “Fang Heng, I have always been very grateful to you, and I am very willing to join your shelter.”
“But you know Ange”s situation. The G-virus blocker can only be maintained for some time. Angel can only stay in the sterile ward to ensure her safety.”

“In addition, your shelter must have certain scientific research and medical conditions. Only then can you develop the G-virus drug that Angel relies on to survive and ensure the subsequent treatment of Angel.”
“What you said is not a problem. I will prepare the sterile ward in advance.”
“Okay, Fang Heng. After you prepare the sterile ward, we will immediately leave this place. We must be quick. Angel doesn’t have many potions left.”
(Hint: You have triggered a special mission -Victor’s recruitment.
Mission name: Victor’s recruitment.
Mission requirement 1: Player’s shelter has reached Level 25 (completed).
Mission requirement 2: Player’s shelter has reached Level 20 (completed).
Mission requirement 3: Player’s shelter has a sterile ward*1.
Mission requirement 4: Player’s shelter has a G-virus research project (completed).
Mission requirement 5: Player has G-virus blocker, complete G-virus (completed).
Mission requirement 6: Please ensure the safety of Angel and Victor until they return to your shelter safely.
(Special description: G-virus blocker has a maximum duration of 48 hours. If Angel fails to enter the sterile ward after the duration is over, the mission will fail).
Mission time limit: 60 days.
Fang Heng quickly scanned through the mission hint that appeared in his vision.
Oh lord!
Shelter to reach Level 25 and research level to reach Level 20, at this stage, even the Federation could not meet the recruitment requirements!
He was able to expand his shelter before entering Pine City to meet the level requirements. In the game, the higher the mission difficulty, the better the reward.
Victor was an S-level character!
Fang Heng was secretly excited.
What he needed to do next was to ensure the safety of Victor and Angel until they were escorted back to the shelter.
Wait a minute, there seemed to be trouble.
On second thought, Fang Heng suddenly realized that he had encountered a big problem.
The sterile ward in the shelter had not been completed yet. Two days was too short...
Something wasn’t right.
Fang Heng reviewed the mission description again.
The G-virus blocker could last for two days, but the mission’s time limit was 60 days.
In other words, he only needed to bring Victor and Angel back to the shelter safely within 60 days.
As long as he could ensure the safety of Victor and Angel during the process, he could leave Pine City and go back first.
After figuring out this crucial point, the mission’s goal became clear.
Fang Heng raised his head and looked out of the window again.
He needed to repair the damaged hospital building as soon as possible!
In the entire Pine City, only the hospital building had intact sterile wards.
If the hospital was breached by the zombie horde, Angel would die, and the mission would fail.
“Victor, it’s a deal then. I’ll go deal with the zombies below first.”
“Tl go with you.”
Victor looked serious. He raised the shotgun in his hand.
“No need. Just in case, you stay here and take care of Angel. I’ll take care of the zombies down there.”
After saying that, Fang Heng jumped onto Tyrant’s back again.
Tyrant took big steps and jumped down from the fifth-story window with Fang Heng again.
Victor opened his mouth and immediately followed him, sticking his head out of the window.
Using the vines, Tyrant was jumping down layer by layer.
In the outside world, a dense zombie horde was pouring into the hospital.
“Sigh!”
Victor sighed deeply.
‘What they had to face was a huge zombie horde!
If they wanted to repair the hospital, they would need more construction materials.
All of these could not be completed in a short time.
These zombies would soon break into the fifth-story and even collapse the entire hospital!
Victor was ready to fight to the death. He had to save Angel’s life no matter what.
He could only use that thing.
Victor made a decision and turned back to his mechanical laboratory..

What’s with it!
Victor questioned again, “Aren’t you a member of the Dark Knights?
Why are you able to control the Tyrant!?”
Fang Heng patted the Tyrant’s shoulder.
“I’ve introduced it to you before.
It’s my special ability.
Ever since the apocalypse, many people have awakened some special abilitie:
Fang Heng spoke slowly as he gestured to the bottle of medicine in his hand.
“Look, I spent a lot of effort to help you find the G-virus blocker.
I immediately rushed back to look for you.”
“Blocker?
You found it so quickly?”
Victor was full of surprise.
He stared at the potion in Fang Heng’s hand.
This was a medicine that could save Angel’s life!
“Put the potion on the ground and roll over slowly.”
Fang Heng spread his hands and put the potion on the ground, rolling over to Victor.
Victor picked up the G-virus blocker from the ground as if he had found a treasure and examined it in his hand.
“How is it?
Do you believe it now?”
“It’s true...”
Victor put down the long-barreled shotgun in his hand.
His heart was filled with joy, but he also felt a little guilty for his actions just now.
“Tm sorry, Fang Heng.
I thought you were in cahoots with that bastard who blew up the building...”
Fang Heng waved his hand.
“It’s okay, I understand.”

“But you can’t find the people from the Meteorite Company anymore.
The outside has been reduced to ruins.
No one knows the current situation of the Meteorite Company.”
“That’s right.
So later on, I wanted to join the Dark Knights.
But now it seems that they can’t be trusted either.”
Victor felt that he had been forced into a desperate situation.
He felt helpless and took a deep breath.
“Fang Heng, now you are the person I trust the most.
If possible, I hope you can help me find a place to stay in the apocalypse.”
He took the bait just like that?
How could it be so easy?
Fang Heng silently looked out the window.
Should he thank the spy?
If it wasn’t for Liu Keyi, Victor might have joined the Dark Knights directly.
“Victor, although I joined the Dark Knights, I also built a shelter myself.”
“My shelter is still developing, and its power is not as big as the Dark Knights, but I can guarantee your safety.”
“Your shelter?”
Victor was surprised.
He looked Fang Heng up and down.
“Yes, it’s me.”
Fang Heng pointed at Tyrant.
“This guy is the bodyguard of shelter.
How is it?”
Victor looked at Tyrant beside Fang Heng.
‘Tyrant was tall and strong.
It looked very convincing.
Victor lowered his head and was silent for a moment.
In this apocalypse, he did not know where to go.
Victor raised his head and said, “Fang Heng, I have always been very grateful to you, and I am very willing to join your shelter.”
“But you know Ange”s situation.
The G-virus blocker can only be maintained for some time.
Angel can only stay in the sterile ward to ensure her safety.”
“In addition, your shelter must have certain scientific research and medical conditions.
Only then can you develop the G-virus drug that Angel relies on to survive and ensure the subsequent treatment of Angel.”
“What you said is not a problem.
I will prepare the sterile ward in advance.”
“Okay, Fang Heng.
After you prepare the sterile ward, we will immediately leave this place.
We must be quick.
Angel doesn’t have many potions left.”

chapters.title: Chapter 182 - Mechanical Exoskeleton Armor
paragraphs: Liu Keyi drove the armoured vehicle and entered the Meteorite Company Park from the north entrance.
She felt like she had just walked through the gates of hell.
She had almost died.
But why did the nemesis appear in that place?
And why did she have such a great hatred for her?
Or perhaps she was unlucky and the nemesis was originally looking for that NPC?
No matter what, the most important mission had been completed. The NPC hiding in the hospital would definitely not survive.
‘The next mission was to find a way to cut off the internal power supply of the Meteorite Company and release the ‘monsters’ below...
Liu Keyi checked the explosives she carried with her.
A few hours later.
“It’s finally completed...”
Victor wiped the sweat from his forehead.
He slowly walked to the center of the research and development room, pressed the red button on the side and muttered to himself.
“hope Fang Heng can still hold on.”
“Creak... Creak...”
Seven or eight mechanical arms assembled iron armour parts on his body.
“Creak... Crack!”
The last screw was tightened.
Victor tried to lift the mechanical arm.
In recent years, Meteorite Company invested a lot in biochemistry, so the development of research in thermal weapons was stagnated.
‘The mechanical exoskeleton armour in front of him was one of the research projects that was stagnated a few years ago.
‘There was one time when Victor found the relevant information when he was looking through the archives of Meteorite Company.
After the disaster, Victor began to try to improve the production on his own.
The modified exoskeleton armour could provide him with powerful defense and strength!
With it, he might be able to fight against the zombies outside!
No one could take Angel away from him.
Not even the Grim Reaper!
Victor walked with heavy steps, took out his electromagnetic pulse rifle, and headed to the first floor.
When he reached the first floor and saw the scene on the first floor, Victor’s heart sank.
The zombie horde had entered the hospital building!
‘Where was Fang Heng? Was he in danger?
Victor raised the muzzle of his gun and was about to attack the zombie horde when he suddenly froze.
He subconsciously put down the electromagnetic pulse rifle in his hand.
Victor froze on the spot.
Zombie horde?!
Victor did see the zombie horde, but this zombie horde was different from the zombie horde he knew.
Each of the zombies held a hammer in their hands.
They...
Was this the hole created by the rocket launcher in the hospital building?
Victor was stunned.
More and more zombies walked in from the entrance, piling firewood and other materials on the ground.
‘There were even a few zombies in the corner making wooden planks...
Two zombies kept moving back and forth, transporting the finished wooden planks to the entrance of the damaged building, providing them to the zombie team to repair the damaged hospital.
What was going on?
Victor felt that his worldview had suffered a huge blow.
He couldn’t understand it for a moment.
Then, he saw Fang Heng walk in from outside the door.
“Fang Heng, these, these...”
Fang Heng was also shocked.
He looked at his friend who was fully armed in front of him and fell into silence.
What the hell! Was this Iron Man?
Victor was covered in a thick layer of iron sheet.
The two of them stared at each other for a full second.
Fang Heng scratched his head.
“They are my special ability. Ever since the disaster broke out... I told you about them. Do you understand what I mean?”
Victor hesitated for a moment.
He nodded.
Indeed, Fang Heng said the same thing when they first met.
But Fang Heng didn’t say that his special ability could control the Tyrant!
He also didn’t say that his special ability could control so many zombies!
He could even use the zombie team as coolies to repair the hospital?
Victor was a little confused and didn’t know what to say.
No wonder he had the ability to obtain the precious G-virus blocker from the dangerous Meteorite Company during this period of time.
Fang Heng broke the silence.
“This is your... eh... mech?”
“Yes, this is the latest mechanical exoskeleton armour that I have developed. It requires high-level mechanical mastery skills to be able to be assembled and used.”
Fang Heng sized up Victor’s equipment from top to bottom.
“It looks very heavy. Won’t its movement be restricted?”

“The outer layer is made of super-strong alloy metal designed by the Meteorite Company. It is indeed very heavy, but there is an internal circulation power supply system. The actual operation effect is actually quite good. It will be fine after you get used to it.”
Victor raised the electromagnetic pulse rifle in his hand as he spoke and continued to explain.
“In addition, the alloy attribute can increase sufficient defense and corrosion resistance. It can also directly supply power to the weapon.”
So powerful?
Fang Heng looked at Victor’s mech.
In the memories of this body, he had never seen such a powerful mech before.
It was probably one of the secrets hidden in the game when it reached a higher level, monopolized by the various guilds and the federation.
If he could equip all the Dark Knights mercenaries with one, wouldn’t he be invincible?
“Can it be mass-produced?”
“It’s still too early to say mass-produced. Currently, the one I have on me is only the first-generation model machine. It hasn’t been tested in actual combat. I need more test data to adjust it.”

“In addition, the energy source is also a big problem. The internal circulation system consumes a lot of power. The high-intensity battle can only last for less than half an hour before the power source has to be changed.”
Alright.
Fang Heng was even more determined to trick Victor back to the shelter.
Even a high-tech product like a mech had been developed.
If he was given more materials, he would be able to develop it eventually.
Just as he was thinking, a noisy electrical sound came from the communicator.
Following that, Mo Jiawei sent a communication message.
“God, I’ve finally contacted you! Our hometown has been ambushed!”
Ambushed?
Fang Heng was shocked.
“Slow down, who ambushed us?”
“It’s a mutated spider, a Tier 3 creature!”
On the other end of the communication, Mo Jiawei was very flustered.
“More than half an hour ago, a lot of mutated spiders emerged from the Meteorite Company.”

“There are more and more of them. The Dark Knights can’t hold on any longer. Fortunately, Lucia contacted the signal source of the helicopter in the outside world. We are preparing to evacuate from Pine City half an hour ahead of time.”
“The evacuation location is at the weapons factory in Area E. God, you should hurry back. If you don’t, it will be too late.”
Mutated spiders? Evacuate ahead of time?
The mutated spiders in the Meteorite Company escaped?
Why did the mission difficulty suddenly increase by a lot?
Fang Heng frowned. He realized that something was wrong.
“L got it. I’ll be back soon.”
After hanging up, Fang Heng looked at Victor and said, “Something happened. I need to go back as soon as possible. These zombies will stay here to protect you.”
“Okay, go do your work. I can stay here.”
Fang Heng thought for a while.
“TIL be back.”
After saying that, Fang Heng left the vine zombies to repair the hospital and retumed to the weapons factory with Tyrant..

chapters.title: Chapter 183 - Evacuation
paragraphs: ‘Meteorite Company.
Area E, weapons factory.
Just half an hour ago, a small number of mutated spiders appeared outside the weapons factory.
This type of Tier 3 mutated creature was extremely difficult to deal with!
Barker immediately organized the Dark Knights to defend with all their might.
‘Mo Jiawei and the other two Federation players gathered together.
He used his small pistol to blow up an ordinary zombie’s head and couldn’t help but complain.
“A Tier 3 mutated creature and we are just ordinary soldiers. Why is this game so hard to play?”
Xiao Jing and another Federation player named Xu Bin were perturbed by this situation.
They also braced themselves and shot with their pistols.
Facing a Tier 3 mutated creature, the small pistol in their hands was like a toy. It was ridiculous.
Before coming here, the Federation had also conducted face-to-face training for the two of them.
The training did mention that Pine City was an anomaly, but it did not mention that they would encounter such a terrifying thing as a Tier 3 mutated creature.
Fortunately, the Dark Knights were strong enough to rely on their powerful firepower to temporarily block the attack of the mutated spiders.
“Puchi Puchi...”
Everyone heard the sound of helicopters hovering in the air.
They looked up and saw a few helicopters hovering high in the air above the weapons factory, trying to find a landing spot.
Captain Barker shouted, “The helicopter that will pick us up is here! Attention, everyone, clear the landing point! We will evacuate in batches!”
The members of the Dark Knights were instantly energized.
‘Mo Jiawei was also overjoyed when he heard that.
They could finally evacuate!
They could leave this d*mned place immediately!
‘The square outside the weapons factory had already been mostly cleared.
The helicopter slowly descended into the safe zone that had been cleared out.
Just as Mo Jiawei was about to run towards the evacuation point, he suddenly heard heavy footsteps coming from afar.
He could not help but turn his head to look in the direction of the sound.
Mo Jiawei was shocked.
A tall figure strode towards the helicopter’s landing spot.
“What the hell?!”
“It’s the nemesis? Why is she here again?!”
‘The nemesis, which had barged in from outside the weapons factory, changed the battle situation in an instant. The members of the Dark Knights tensed up again.
“Quick! Hide! Take cover!”
‘The members of the Dark Knights took cover one after another, avoiding the nemesis’s line of sight while shooting with their weapons.
‘Mo Jiawei looked at Xiao Jing beside him.
“What’s going on? Why is the nemesis chasing after us again?”
Xiao Jing was also in a daze.
“How would I know?”
“Aren’t you from the Federation? Why don’t you know anything? It’s illegal to impersonate public officials!”
‘Mo Jiawei felt that Xiao Jing must be joking with him.
“What about the Federation’s intelligence department? You don’t know about the mutated spiders and the resurrection of the nemesis?”
“Is it really not written in your notebook?”
“Ltold you, I don’t know!”
‘Mo Jiawei was very angry now.
Just as he was about to leave with peace of mind, the nemesis appeared with a snap.
“Calm down.”
Another experienced Federation player, Xu Bin, tried to calm Mo Jiawei down.
“It’s not to the point where we can’t fight anymore. At least this time, the nemesis didn’t bring a rocket launcher. As long as we can find a way to board the helicopter and evacuate, we’ll be safe.”
That was easy for him to say!
“How about showing me what is ‘we’ll be safe’.”
‘Mo Jiawei cursed in his heart.
“Boom!!”
‘There was an explosion.
Mo Jiawei’s eyelids twitched.
A rocket launcher hit the nemesis’s chest hard, forcing her back a few steps.
“Who’s so awesome?”
Mo Jiawei opened his mouth and looked back in the direction of the rocket launcher.
An armoured vehicle was aiming the rocket launcher at the nemesis.
“Boom! Boom!”
‘The nemesis was hit by the rocket launcher and kept retreating.
“It’s Lucia. I saw her go to the underground parking lot.”
“Quick! Evacuate!”
Taking advantage of the temporary retreat of the nemesis, Barker ordered the team to move.
“Everyone line up and evacuate in an orderly manner! Private Mo Jiawei! Private Xu Bin! Private Xiao Jing! What are you waiting for! Your military rank is the lowest! The first group to evacuate!”
“Understood!”
‘Mo Jiawei was very afraid of death and immediately ran towards the evacuation point.
He was now somewhat glad that he was a private!
He still felt that it was a waste of time for him to participate in this b*llshit mission.
He had better hurry up and escape!
‘The first helicopter hovered in mid-air, swinging down a rope ladder from the sky.
‘Mo Jiawei climbed up the rope ladder and quickly climbed into the helicopter.
Did he manage to survive?
‘Mo Jiawei carefully looked down and pulled Xiao Jing who was following behind him.
“Boom! Boom! Boom!!”
In order to buy time for her teammates, Lucia used the rockets loaded on the armoured vehicle to continuously bombard the nemesis into a dual state of repulsion and stiffness.
Mo Jiawei also took out his small pistol and tried to shoot at the nemesis from high above.
However, it was useless.
“D*mn!”
‘Mo Jiawei cursed and put away his pistol.
Using a small pistol to deal with the nemesis?
It was simply a joke!
He was a little regretful.
Why did he have to leave the novice village?
‘The armoured vehicle was equipped with very few rocket launchers and the ammunition on Lucia’s armoured vehicle was running out quickly.
‘The nemesis was bombarded by a series of rockets and she suffered a lot of damage. She knelt on the ground for a long time.
Lucia drove the armoured vehicle directly, stepped aggressively on the accelerator and slammed straight towards the nemesis.
“Bang!”
The injured nemesis was hit hard by the armoured vehicle until she hit the wall behind her.
“Bang!!!”
A huge dent was formed on the wall by the back of the nemesis.
“Quick! Hurry up! Evacuate!”
Seeing that the nemesis was motionless as if she was dead, Barker continued to speed up the evacuation.
Lucia knew that the nemesis was not so easy to kill.
She pulled out her short dagger and quickly left the armoured car, running towards the nemesis.
She went around to the back of the nemesis.
Lucia brandished her dagger.
She stabbed the dagger into the back of the nemesis’s neck from the back.
“Chil”
‘A deep cut was made on her skin.
Lucia switched to the automatic rifle again and pressed the muzzle on the wound on the back of the nemesis’s neck.
She pressed the trigger all the way down!
“Bang! Bang! Bang! Bang! Ban;
Purple blood splattered.
“Roar!!!”
In an instant, the right arm of the nemesis transformed into a worm-like tentacle and grabbed towards Lucia.
This time Lucia was already prepared. She dodged to the side in advance and rolled on the spot to avoid the attack.
Tier 2!
‘The nemesis was still in a half-keeling position, not moving at all.
However, her left hand had already transformed into a tentacle. The muscles at the back of her neck were squirming rapidly, and a huge sarcoma actually protruded out!
“Quick! Take advantage of it now! Retreat! Retreat quickly!”
The second and third helicopters landed, and the Dark Knights retreated in batches.
About a minute later, Tier 2 nemesis began to move.
She withstood the fierce attacks from the Dark Knights around her and quickly rushed towards Lucia.
Lucia stood calmly on the spot until she saw the nemesis’s punch. She quickly rolled to the right, narrowly avoiding the attack.
“Bang!”
The punch landed on the wall behind Lucia.
“Shoo!”
The nemesis still did not let Lucia go, and her right arm tentacle extended forward.
“Chi Chi Chi!”
Lucia had just rolled up from the ground when she frowned.
She looked back.
Her right leg was tightly entangled by the tentacles of the nemesis!
“Roar!!!”
The hatred of the nemesis towards Lucia had reached its peak. She let out a roar and the tentacles pulled Lucia into the air.
Lucia was flung high into the air by the tentacles, and then she smashed onto the ground!
“Bang!”
A violent high-speed collision!
Lucia was severely injured, and she instantly fainted.
“Good grief.”
Seeing this, the players on the helicopter, including Mo Jiawei, helplessly used their small pistols to shoot the nemesis.
‘What should they do?
‘Mo Jiawei was also very desperate.
At this moment, another black shadow suddenly darted out from the side.
“What’s that?”
Mo Jiawei was shocked.
“Bang!”
The nemesis was slammed to the ground by the Tyrant who rushed from behind.

sentences.text: ‘Meteorite Company.
Area E, weapons factory.
Just half an hour ago, a small number of mutated spiders appeared outside the weapons factory.
This type of Tier 3 mutated creature was extremely difficult to deal with!
Barker immediately organized the Dark Knights to defend with all their might.
‘Mo Jiawei and the other two Federation players gathered together.
He used his small pistol to blow up an ordinary zombie’s head and couldn’t help but complain.
“A Tier 3 mutated creature and we are just ordinary soldiers.
Why is this game so hard to play?”
Xiao Jing and another Federation player named Xu Bin were perturbed by this situation.
They also braced themselves and shot with their pistols.
Facing a Tier 3 mutated creature, the small pistol in their hands was like a toy.
It was ridiculous.
Before coming here, the Federation had also conducted face-to-face training for the two of them.
The training did mention that Pine City was an anomaly, but it did not mention that they would encounter such a terrifying thing as a Tier 3 mutated creature.
Fortunately, the Dark Knights were strong enough to rely on their powerful firepower to temporarily block the attack of the mutated spiders.
“Puchi Puchi...”
Everyone heard the sound of helicopters hovering in the air.
They looked up and saw a few helicopters hovering high in the air above the weapons factory, trying to find a landing spot.
Captain Barker shouted, “The helicopter that will pick us up is here!
Attention, everyone, clear the landing point!
We will evacuate in batches!”
The members of the Dark Knights were instantly energized.
‘Mo Jiawei was also overjoyed when he heard that.
They could finally evacuate!
They could leave this d*mned place immediately!
‘The square outside the weapons factory had already been mostly cleared.
The helicopter slowly descended into the safe zone that had been cleared out.
Just as Mo Jiawei was about to run towards the evacuation point, he suddenly heard heavy footsteps coming from afar.
He could not help but turn his head to look in the direction of the sound.
Mo Jiawei was shocked.
A tall figure strode towards the helicopter’s landing spot.
“What the hell?!”
“It’s the nemesis?
Why is she here again?!”
‘The nemesis, which had barged in from outside the weapons factory, changed the battle situation in an instant.
The members of the Dark Knights tensed up again.
“Quick!
Hide!
Take cover!”
‘The members of the Dark Knights took cover one after another, avoiding the nemesis’s line of sight while shooting with their weapons.

“What’s going on?
Why is the nemesis chasing after us again?”
Xiao Jing was also in a daze.
“How would I know?”
“Aren’t you from the Federation?
Why don’t you know anything?
It’s illegal to impersonate public officials!”
‘Mo Jiawei felt that Xiao Jing must be joking with him.
“What about the Federation’s intelligence department?
You don’t know about the mutated spiders and the resurrection of the nemesis?”
“Is it really not written in your notebook?”
“Ltold you, I don’t know!”
‘Mo Jiawei was very angry now.
Just as he was about to leave with peace of mind, the nemesis appeared with a snap.
“Calm down.”
Another experienced Federation player, Xu Bin, tried to calm Mo Jiawei down.
“It’s not to the point where we can’t fight anymore.
At least this time, the nemesis didn’t bring a rocket launcher.
As long as we can find a way to board the helicopter and evacuate, we’ll be safe.”
That was easy for him to say!
“How about showing me what is ‘we’ll be safe’.”
‘Mo Jiawei cursed in his heart.
“Boom!!”
‘There was an explosion.
Mo Jiawei’s eyelids twitched.
A rocket launcher hit the nemesis’s chest hard, forcing her back a few steps.
“Who’s so awesome?”
Mo Jiawei opened his mouth and looked back in the direction of the rocket launcher.
An armoured vehicle was aiming the rocket launcher at the nemesis.
“Boom!
Boom!”
‘The nemesis was hit by the rocket launcher and kept retreating.
“It’s Lucia.
I saw her go to the underground parking lot.”
“Quick!
Evacuate!”
Taking advantage of the temporary retreat of the nemesis, Barker ordered the team to move.
“Everyone line up and evacuate in an orderly manner!
Private Mo Jiawei!
Private Xu Bin!
Private Xiao Jing!
What are you waiting for!
Your military rank is the lowest!
The first group to evacuate!”
“Understood!”
‘Mo Jiawei was very afraid of death and immediately ran towards the evacuation point.
He was now somewhat glad that he was a private!
He still felt that it was a waste of time for him to participate in this b*llshit mission.
He had better hurry up and escape!
‘The first helicopter hovered in mid-air, swinging down a rope ladder from the sky.
‘Mo Jiawei climbed up the rope ladder and quickly climbed into the helicopter.
Did he manage to survive?
‘Mo Jiawei carefully looked down and pulled Xiao Jing who was following behind him.
“Boom!
Boom!
Boom!!”
In order to buy time for her teammates, Lucia used the rockets loaded on the armoured vehicle to continuously bombard the nemesis into a dual state of repulsion and stiffness.
Mo Jiawei also took out his small pistol and tried to shoot at the nemesis from high above.
However, it was useless.
“D*mn!”

Using a small pistol to deal with the nemesis?
It was simply a joke!
He was a little regretful.
Why did he have to leave the novice village?

‘The nemesis was bombarded by a series of rockets and she suffered a lot of damage.
She knelt on the ground for a long time.
Lucia drove the armoured vehicle directly, stepped aggressively on the accelerator and slammed straight towards the nemesis.

chapters.title: Chapter 184 - Hand-to-hand Combat
paragraphs: What was going on?
Mo Jiawei was stunned.
Nemesis No. 2?!
Where did it come from?
And why were No. 1 and No. 2 fighting with each other?
Xiao Jing and Xu Bin looked at each other and then at Mo Jiawei at the same time.
“Mo Jiawei, what’s that?”
The two of them asked in unison.
Mo Jiawei wondered if the two of them were from the Federation or not?
How come they didn’t know anything?
Now was not the time to argue. Mo Jiawei immediately covered his left eye with his hand and used his skills to observe the Tyrant form.
A row of game hints appeared on Mo Jiawei’s retina.
Target: Tyrant zombie corpse.
Description: A type of powerful zombie. It seems to have integrated part of the Tyrant’s ability and is relatively large.
Description: Your talent level, character level and talent enhancement level are all lower than the other party. You are unable to obtain any more information.
Seeing the information, Mo Jiawei’s heart was in turmoil!
it was a creature controlled by a player!
Almost immediately, an image of Fang Heng appeared in Mo Jiawei’s mind.
tt must be him!!!
There was no one else other than Fang Heng!
Mo Jiawei was shocked beyond words.
All of his levels were lower than Fang Heng’s, so his skills did not obtain any useful information!
Mo Jiawei could understand that Fang Heng’s character level was higher than his. After all, Fang Heng was a God.
Even his talent level was able to surpass him?
But he had the highest level, the S-level skill!
The highest level in the game, S-level! How could he be surpassed?
And his talent enhancement level.
Fang Heng was even higher than him!
This meant that Fang Heng had already undergone his first talent enhancement!
He had already reached Level 10!
No, these were not the crucial points.
To be able to control a powerful creature as powerful as the nemesis...
The more he thought about it, the more Mo Jiawei felt that Fang Heng’s strength was terrifying.
Unknowingly, cold sweat had already started to form on his back.
The God had hidden his true colours so deeply?
To control a nemesis-level creature...
Was it a continuous control, or could it only be maintained for a short period?
Even if it was only for a short period, it was already a bug.
If it was the former, then it would be too...
“Mo Jiawei!”
Seeing Mo Jiawei not moving from his original position, Xiao Jing couldn’t help but push his shoulder.
“What did you see? What the hell is that?”
“Ah, this... nothing.”
Mo Jiawei finally came back to his senses from his wild imagination.
Xu Bin was a little anxious. “What did you see?”
Mo Jiawei was still in shock. He tried to clear his mind.
“I think it might be controlled by Fang Heng.”
“What? Fang Heng?”
“Is it his talent ability?!”
Xu Bin was shocked. His first reaction was disbelief.
There were many talent skills in the game. It was not impossible to control zombies, but was there anyone who could control the nemesis?
Wasn’t that bullsh*t??
Xiao Jing was also stunned, but he quickly reacted. He put down his pistol and took out the black notebook he always carried.
He scribbled furiously on the notebook.
“Suspect that the target has a powerful...”
“No, that’s not it.”
Mo Jiawei immediately thought of what Fang Heng had said before they split up. The matter regarding his talent ability had to be kept a secret from everyone.
Including the Federation!
He had to cling onto the leg of God!
Mo Jiawei hurriedly stopped Xiao Jing, who was scribbling on the notebook.
“Don’t scribble. It’s not a talent skill. I think Fang Heng completed a special mission and obtained a temporary, uh, that...”
Mo Jiawei didn’t know how to describe the zombie that was fighting with the nemesis.
“Uh... control of the Tyrant zombie corpse.”
Xu Bin was relieved.
That made sense.
Otherwise, how could there be such a thing that could destroy the balance in the game?
Below the helicopter.
The nemesis and the Tyrant fusion form stood up.
Two monsters that had been modified by the T-virus were fighting each other.
Tier 2 nemesis was powerful, but the Tyrant had also fused with the vine parasite’s ability, so its defense had a qualitative change!
n addition, the Tyrant form was able to inherit most of Fang Heng’s skills.
Block! Dodge!
These two skills were naturally not effective against a normal vine zombie that couldn’t even walk steadily.
But now, it had switched to Tyrant form!
After adding another 20 basic agility points, the Tyrant form’s movements were even faster than a normal person’s!
Bang!
The nemesis threw a punch, but the Tyrant form blocked it with both hands.
Hint: Your vine Tyrant form blocked the nemesis’s attack, reducing 85% of damage. Your skill-blocking experience points +57.]
Hint: Your vine Tyrant form’s HP has recovered +131.]
Hint: Your vine Tyrant form attempted to dodge the nemesis’s attack (but failed). Your skill-dodging experience points +3.]
Hint: Your vine...]
Fang Heng glanced at the game log.
“The experience points gained from blocking skills have increased by so much?”
Fang Heng was a little surprised as he muttered to himself.
erhaps the experience points gained from these two skills were related to the enemy’s strength, so they could not be gained when dealing with ordinary zombies.
Or normal zombies were not able to block and dodge according to the rules...
Fang Heng quickly assessed the situation before him.
Tyrant corpse vine fusion form had a recovery speed of 131 HP per second.
n addition, it has two powerful skills, blocking and dodging. It would not have any problem blocking the nemesis for a short period!
Closing the game log, Fang Heng brought Victor’s mechanical badge and rushed to the side of Lucia who had fallen.
“Lucia?”
Lucia was still unconscious.
Fang Heng quickly took out a bottle of healing spray from his backpack and sprayed it on Lucia’s body.
Barker shouted anxiously from the other side.
“Fang Heng! Don’t stay there, take her with you and evacuate!”
“Understood!”
Lucia was the NPC for the main storyline mission!
Fang Heng was more concerned about Lucia’s safety than Barker.
After using up the bottle of healing spray, Lucia still did not seem to be awake.
Fang Heng picked up the unconscious Lucia and ran towards the helicopter at the other evacuation point.
“Quick! Pilot, let’s go and pick up Fang Heng!”
The helicopter flew towards Fang Heng at a low altitude and dropped the rope ladder from the sky.
Fang Heng carried Lucia on his shoulders, grabbed her body with both hands and slowly climbed up.
“Quick! Quickly get on!”
Xiao Jing and Mo Jiawei, who were on the helicopter, hurriedly helped Fang Heng pull Lucia onto the helicopter.
“Whoosh!”
Until Fang Heng was pulled onto the helicopter, Mo Jiawei suddenly had a feeling that he had narrowly escaped death.
He hurriedly called for the pilot.
“Quick! Brother! We’re all here, take off! Quickly take us out of Pine City!”
The pilot made a ‘copy’ gesture and the helicopter began to slowly take off.
“Wait! Wait a little longer!”
Fang Heng stopped the pilot.
Everyone on the helicopter looked at Fang Heng in confusion.
“What’s wrong?”
Fang Heng said in a deep voice, “You guys protect Lucia and leave Pine City. I still have some things to deal with. I won’t leave Pine City with you guys this time.”.

chapters.title: Chapter 185 - Evacuation
paragraphs: Mo Jiawei was stunned. He immediately said, “Fang Heng, are you crazy?”
Xiao Jing’s eyes lit up. He took out a black notebook.
“The target has taken the initiative to stay in Pine City. It may be related to another mission.”
Fang Heng shook his head. He took out the mechanical badge that Victor had given him from his backpack and put it in Lucia’s pocket.
“You must ensure her safety! We’ll contact her again after we go offline.”
Mo Jiawei opened his mouth.
He was a little confused.
Protecting Lucia from Pine City while Fang Heng chose to stay behind alone?
What was he trying to do?
Could it be that everyone received different missions?
Without waiting for them to say anything, Fang Heng climbed down the rope ladder again.
“Let’s go first. Don’t worry about him. Fang Heng must have his reasons. Maybe he wants to use the nemesis to do something.”
Xu Bin nodded and signalled for the pilot to continue evacuating.
The helicopter rose quickly and flew in the direction away from Pine City.
After landing on the ground, Fang Heng quickly gathered at Barker’s location.
“Captain Barker.”
Hiding behind the cover, Barker was surprised to see Fang Heng return.
“Why aren’t you leaving yet? We need to evacuate this place immediately. You will go off first in the next helicopter.”
“Captain Barker, there’s something I want to discuss with you.”
Fang Heng hid behind the cover on the other side of Barker and said to him, “I’ve decided to stay here.”
Barker turned around and looked at Fang Heng in shock.
“What’s wrong with you?!”
“I’m serious.”
Fang Heng’s expression was solemn and brooding.
“| want to stay here alone to thoroughly investigate the Meteorite Company. I’ve already found out from Lucia about the secret passage to Area S.”
“But I need the help of the Dark Knights. After a period of time, I need you to help me leave Pine City.”
“Fang Heng, I understand your intentions, but can you handle so many mutated spiders?”
Wasn’t it just mutated spiders?
How could a mere Tier 3 mutated creature be a match for the Tyrant?
Fang Heng felt disdain in his heart, as if he had the pearl of wisdom in his hand.
“Of course, I have a way.”
Hearing Fang Heng’s affirmative answer, Barker was truly shocked.
He looked Fang Heng up and down again.
“What about the infection? Well, even if you have a way to deal with the mutated spider, what about the infection?”
Barker frowned and continued to persuade Fang Heng to give up the idea.
“Besides the high-level zombie corpses and the mutated spiders, the whole city is filled with poisonous gas. We can’t stay here for a long time.”
“Don’t worry, I’m prepared for this.”
After all, their shelter had an S-level researcher like Qiu Yaokang.
Fang Heng had brought a lot of anti-infection potions with him before coming here.
As he spoke, he threw a bottle of powerful anti-infection potion made by Qiu Yaokang to Barker, who was hiding behind a bunker.
“Look at this.”
Barker took the potion and quickly checked it. Then, he frowned and pondered.
After a moment, he compromised and threw the potion back.
“Alright, if you insist on doing this, I won’t object.”
“But you must take care of your own safety!”
Barker rummaged through his pockets and threw the remaining bottles of anti-infection spray in his backpack to Fang Heng.
Fang Heng gave Barker a thumbs up when he received the spray.
“Hey! Thank you!”
[Hint: You have obtained a powerful anti-infection spray*6.]
“When will we send a plane to bring you back?”
“Mo Jiawei and the others will tell you when they go back.”
Fang Heng turned his head and looked at the Tyrant who was fighting with the nemesis.
“Next, I’ll think of a way to stall the nemesis. You take all the Dark Knights and evacuate.”
As Fang Heng spoke, he narrowed his eyes and looked at the short-haired female player on the other side.

She was trying to climb up the rope ladder that the helicopter had lowered.
“And Liu Keyi, she was the one who ambushed the hospital.”
“Also, I suspect that the nemesis’s early awakening is also related to her. But for the time being, it’s better not to alert the enemy. Keeping her will still be useful later.”
“Yeah, that’s good too.”
Barker also glanced at Liu Keyi from the corner of his eyes and snorted in disdain.
“Then keep her for the time being. I’ll warn the other team leaders to be vigilant against her and find a reason to clear her honor points to zero.”
Awesome...
Fang Heng obediently shut his mouth and labelled Barker as a cynical person in his heart.
Not long after, more than half of the members of the Dark Knights boarded the helicopter.
They fired at the nemesis and the zombie horde from a high altitude, covering the retreat of the follow-up team.
“Bang!”
Fang Heng raised his automatic rifle and killed an ordinary zombie who was attacking from the side.
He turned to Barker who was hiding behind the cover and said, “The helicopter is here. You guys retreat first!”
“Okay! Take care!”
Barker nodded heavily at Fang Heng and gave the order to the last group of Dark Knights.
“Follow me! Retreat!”
ot long after, all the well-trained Dark Knights boarded the helicopter.
They didn’t leave directly. Instead, they hovered above and covered Fang Heng to kill the attacking zombie horde.
Fang Heng signalled to Barker’s helicopter and quickly returned to the weapons factory.
Seeing that Fang Heng had safely retreated, Barker ordered the helicopter to leave Pine City.
After entering the storage room behind the weapons factory, Fang Heng went into the sewer leading to the hospital.
Fang Heng knew very well that Tier 2 nemesis’s damage output was limited. She couldn’t kill the Tyrant.
Similarly, Tyrant’s damage output would not be able to do anything to the nemesis.
He did not know how long these two indefatigable creatures would fight.
On second thought, let them fight among themselves!
Taking advantage of this opportunity, he might as well let the nemesis help him max out his dodging and blocking skills!
Now that he had the Tyrant form, the nemesis did not pose any danger to him.
He could do whatever he want in Pine City.
Staying here was definitely the right choice.
“Hehe, Pine City is filled with treasures!”
Walking in the sewer, Fang Heng’s face unconsciously revealed a smile.
The plan was being formulated...
At the Federation’s temporary command center.
Xu Bin’s personal image was projected onto the large screen in real time.
“Reporting to superiors, the Dark Knights have all been evacuated from Pine City.”
“Dark Knights’ Captain Barker has survived. The exact number of deaths is still being calculated. The mission has been confirmed to be completed and the rewards will be received later.”
Upon receiving Xu Bin’s news, the entire temporary command center was instantly filled with joy.
The staff of the temporary command center also stayed up with them through the night.
The main storyline mission was successfully completed!
The mission ended perfectly!
However, among the many people, Wei Guangling, who had been temporarily transferred to act as the operation consultant, was still sitting in his seat.
He was a little silent and his brows were tightly knitted.
Wei Guangling was an elite of the Federation in District 4. He had once participated in the main storyline mission in District 4.
The operation chief commander, Zhang Yuekun, noticed his expression.
“The mission has been completed. Why do you still look unhappy?”.

chapters.title: Chapter 186 - Heroic Deeds
paragraphs: Wei Guangling raised his head.
“It’s best that we thoroughly investigate this main storyline mission.”
“Hmm? Is there a problem?”
“Due to the game’s restrictions, I can’t say too much. The thing that makes me most suspicious is the mutated spider that appeared at the end of this mission.”
“The mutated spider is a Tier 3 mutated creature. In theory, it’s a mission target that only appears when the main storyline mission is loop 9-12.”
“They appeared too early.”
“I suspect that they might have been affected by something, causing the high-level mutated creatures to be released early...”
Zhang Yuekun’s expression was solemn. “Is it related to the anti-federal organization?”
Wei Guangling nodded and gave a light hum.
“Yes.”
“Alright, I will report the situation to my superiors.”
“I will also provide you with a written report when we return. I hope that the superiors will pay attention to this matter.”
Zhang Yuekun rubbed his temples.
He had too many things to worry about recently, and he was a little out of sorts.
No matter what, the main storyline mission had been completed this time.
Wei Guangling relaxed a little and rubbed his stiff neck.
“I have a bad feeling. There will be about a month before the next main storyline mission is triggered. We can take advantage of this month to rest and also to investigate properly.”
Zhang Yuekun smiled bitterly.
“Youre still resting... Blood moon project, brother...”
“Huh?”
Wei Guangling was stunned.
Oh right, there was also the blood moon project.
He had completely forgotten about it.
Thinking carefully, Server 8 had only opened less than a month ago.
If that was the case..
The unease in Wei Guangling’s heart grew stronger.
Server 8’s game progress had exceeded his expectations by too much!
He remembered that back then, Server 4 had already survived two blood moons when they activated the main storyline mission loop 7.
The speed was at least twice as fast!
Wei Guangling had a very uncomfortable feeling.
It was as if there was an invisible big hand controlling the entire Server 8 secretly.
The two of them were conversing softly while Xu Bin continued to report the mission situation on the big screen.

“During this mission process, player Fang Heng has brought us great help. With him, we can quickly repair the communication base station and the armoured vehicles in the weapons factory, speeding up the mission
process.”
“He also brought an NPC to detonate the chemical plant, temporarily putting the nemesis into hibernation.”
As Xu Bin spoke, he hesitated for a moment.
He still reported the truth.
“But the strange thing is, at the last moment of the mission retreat, the nemesis appeared again.”
“In the end, it was Fang Heng who suddenly controlled the Tyrant to appear and help the Dark Knights halt the nemesis, which helped our entire team retreat safely.”
Xu Bin concluded, “Fang Heng contributed greatly to this mission.”
Controlled the Tyrant?!
Upon hearing this, the entire command room instantly became silent.
Everyone could understand things like repairing cars and radios.
it was normal for a player to have a talent skill like mechanical repair.
But controlling Tyrant?
What kind of trick was this?
[t was unheard of!
Chen Yu was also in the command room at this time.
He was sitting behind Wei Guangling and Zhang Yuekun, the two big bosses.
When he heard Fang Heng’s heroic deeds’, he scratched his head out of habit.
t was very strange.
Chen Yu actually did not feel that this matter was very shocking.
tt seemed..
Very normal.
Yes, this was Fang Heng’s style of doing things.
After meeting Fang Heng, if anything strange happened in the game, Chen Yu’s first reaction would be that Fang Heng had done it.
Wei Guangling frowned. He took the microphone from the side and asked, “What’s the deal with controlling the Tyrant? Please explain in detail.”
“I’m not sure about the specifics. I suspect that Fang Heng completed a side mission and temporarily gained control of the Tyrant within the Meteorite Company.”
So that’s how it was...
After Xu Bin’s explanation, the quiet hall began to fill with sounds of discussion.
Fang Heng was able to temporarily control the Tyrant through a special mission, helping the entire Dark Knights retreat from Pine City.
Therefore, controlling the Tyrant was also part of the mission.
This sounded much more reasonable.
o matter what, Fang Heng had indeed helped the Federation greatly in this mission.
However, Wei Guangling’s tightly knitted brows still did not relax.
He felt that Fang Heng was very strange.
Controlling a Tyrant?
Even in the current District 4, no player could do this.
Just the explanation of the mission made some sense.
However, he still felt that it was very strange.
Wei Guangling recalled Fang Heng’s personal information that he had read before.
He turned his head and asked Zhang Yuekun beside him in a low voice, “Is Fang Heng reliable?”
Zhang Yuekun turned his body and looked at Chen Yu together with Wei Guangling.
“Let me introduce him. This is Chen Yu. He has been in contact with Fang Heng a while ago, so he has the right to speak.”
Chen Yu shuddered and stood up in a flash. “Leader!”
“Sit down and talk about your understanding of Fang Heng.”
“Yes!”
Chen Yu nervously swallowed his saliva.

“Fang Heng has always been working closely with the Federation. First, he helped us successfully destroy Alex in the Hope Town incident and protected the safety of the Federation temporary resource point.”

“After that, Fang Heng also provided us with a large amount of materials and resources for the resource point. He doesn’t care about the price as most gaming companies do. I believe that he is more reliable than most
people.”
“Apart from that, we also cooperated with Fang Heng many times, and everything went very smoothly.”
“In addition, we were given the authority to conduct a detailed investigation of Fang Heng’s background and didn’t find any problems. I don’t think he’s a dangerous anti-federal character.”
Zhang Yuekun frowned slightly.
“You only need to report the situation, don’t make personal judgments.”
“Yes! Leader!”
Zhang Yuekun pulled Wei Guangling and turned around, saying in a low voice, “If necessary, you can secretly conduct an in-depth investigation on Fang Heng.”
Wei Guangling’s eyes flickered.
He shook his head and refused.

“There’s no need. Whether it’s the outcome or the process, Fang Heng’s effect on the entire main storyline mission is positive. He shouldn’t be a member of the anti-federal organization. An in-depth investigation will
easily lead to negative effects.”
As he spoke, Wei Guangling once again took the microphone in his hand.
“Thank you for your hard work. I’ll wait for you to come back and report the details of the Tyrant. In addition, I hope to meet Mr Fang Heng. When you’re online, help me convey it to him.”
“Uh... this...”
In the video channel, Xu Bin’s expression was a little strange.
“Consultant Wei, actually, Fang Heng... He didn’t evacuate from Pine City.”
“Didn’t evacuate? Did something happen to him?”
Wei Guangling was shocked.
“No, it’s not like that. When we were evacuating, Fang Heng had already boarded the helicopter. However, he said that he wanted to stay in Pine City, so he jumped down again...”
The entire hall instantly fell silent again.
Stay in Pine City?
Jumped down again?
It didn’t sound like what a normal person would do.
Chen Yu silently nodded in his heart.
He felt that this was the most normal thing.
Yes, that’s right.
This was Fang Heng!
A familiar scent.
A familiar operation..

chapters.title: Chapter 187 - Acting
paragraphs: When Wei Guangling heard this, he felt even more doubtful.
Stay in Pine City? What did Fang Heng want to do there?
The situation in Pine City was so bad. If he stayed there, wouldn’t he be asking for trouble?
Wei Guangling turned his head again and looked at Chen Yu.
“Chen Yu, based on your understanding of Fang Heng, what do you think his purpose of staying in Pine City is?”
“Well...”
Chen Yu subconsciously raised his hand, wanting to scratch his head, but he felt that it was a little unsightly in front of the leaders, so he forcefully put it down.
He decided to tell the truth.
“Leader, I think he might want to farm monsters...”
Farm monsters?
Wei Guangling and Zhang Yuekun looked at each other at the same time.
What on earth was farming monsters?
This word was often heard in the internet games in the past.
It was rather retro.
“Yeah, it’s just leveling up in there. There are a lot of Tier 2 mutated creatures in Pine City, which are very valuable to kill. | think Fang Heng’s character level is close to Level 10.”
“He probably wants to take this opportunity to kill more high-level zombies, so as to break through Level 10.”
Chen Yu had a deep impression of Fang Heng.
From the zombie pit in Hope Town.
And then there was the ‘tower defense’ that was built in the shelter.
tt was too flashy.
The few incidents that he had participated in with Fang Heng had changed Chen Yu’s understanding of this game.
He felt that Fang Heng was just itching to play, and was planning to stay in Pine City to do some stuff.
Level up while he was at it.
Thinking about it carefully, Fang Heng’s choice to stay in Pine City was not much different from the last time he chose to stay in Hope Town.
it was just that the enemy was a little stronger...
At first, he would farm ordinary zombies and Tier 1 mutated zombies, then he would go back to the shelter to farm Lickers. What was wrong with farming Tier 2 mutated creatures now?
This was very consistent with Fang Heng’s style of doing things.
Chen Yu felt that there was nothing wrong with it.
Wei Guangling and Zhang Yuekun were deep in thought.
Hint: You have completed the mission-desperate survivor.]
Hint: Please go to any branch of the Dark Knights to receive the reward.]
Climbing out of the sewer, Fang Heng received the latest game hint.
tt seemed that Lucia had safely evacuated from Pine City.
“That boor...”
Fang Heng was slightly relieved when Lucia’s face appeared in his mind.
The main storyline mission was finally saved!
ext, he could relax and play the official game.
While passing through the city’s sewer, a rough outline of a plan had been built in Fang Heng’s mind.
There were three steps.
The first step was to strengthen the hospital and ensure Victor’s safety.
The second step was to get Victor to help create another badge to block the pursuit of the nemesis. This way, he could farm the mutated spiders inside the Meteorite Company.
The third step was to find a way to completely eliminate the nemesis!
“Fang Heng, you’re back.”
Outside the hospital building, Victor was wearing the exoskeleton armour to stand guard.
“I saw a lot of helicopters leaving Pine City earlier. Have the Dark Knights evacuated?”
Victor sighed in his heart.
He felt that he owed Fang Heng too much this time.
“I’m sorry, Fang Heng. I’ve implicated you this time and caused you to stay in this dangerous place. I was suspicious of you before...”
“Since you’re ready to join my shelter, of course I have to protect your safety.”
“But Victor, don’t be so depressed. Be happy. After this, it’s our turn to counterattack.”
(Hint: You’ve chosen to stay in Pine City. Your friendship with Victor has greatly increased.]
Fang Heng glanced at the game log and narrowed his eyes.
Actually, he was still a little unhappy.
From the moment he entered Pine City, he had been assigned various main storyline missions.
He had been chased all the way.
Until now, he had finally figured out the background of Pine City.
“Next, I’ll see if I can clear this place!”
Fang Heng thought to himself.
“Counterattack?”
When Victor heard this, he looked at Fang Heng in surprise.
What did he mean by counterattack?
Victor felt that Fang Heng was becoming more and more unpredictable.
“Ha.
Fang Heng suddenly felt very sleepy after his ambitious speech.
He yawned.
He had been highly focused for a period of time and had not slept much last night. Fang Heng was very tired now.
“Let’s talk about the details later. I’m going back to catch up on my sleep.”
Fang Heng was about to walk upstairs when he suddenly thought of something and slapped his forehead.
“Oh right, Victor, there’s something else I need your help with. It’s quite urgent...”

chapters.title: Chapter 188 - Blood Moon Project
paragraphs: Fang Heng felt that it would be inconvenient for him to stay in Pine City.
For example, the main storyline of the current mission could not be submitted directly, and the rewards could not be received.
He did not even know what the follow-up mission for Pine City was like.
“Yes, our people have safely evacuated.”

“The Dark Knights have suffered quite a blow in this operation. Captain Barker plans to rest for a period of time before heading to Pine City to investigate again. It is estimated that it will be two to three weeks later.”
“The player is temporarily on standby for this period of time. You can choose to accept some missions to increase the Dark Knights’ honor level.”

“Our internal department estimates are that the next time we accept a mission, we will have to enter the operating company’s Area S to investigate. We will think of a way to deal with the mutated spiders there.”
As he said this, Chen Yu let out a deep sigh.
“Sigh, a Tier 3 mutated creature. We only have two to three weeks left. I don’t know what to do.”
“At this stage, the pistols that we are using can barely deal damage to Tier 2 mutated creatures, and now they have enhanced to Tier 3...”
“Our District 8 is an anomaly. I don’t know why, but the process of triggering the mission is way ahead of the other servers.”
“I’m sorry, I’ve really caused trouble for you guys...”
Fang Heng quietly listened to Chen Yu’s sighs on the other end of the phone, and at the same time, he began to think.
The Federation predicted that the next mission would be to kill a Tier 3 mutated spider?
Thinking about it carefully, the Federation’s speculation was not without reason.
This mission had failed because of the nemesis’s interference.
Based on common sense, the next time they came, they would definitely have thought of a strategy to deal with the nemesis.
After that, the mission would most likely continue to explore Meteorite Company’s Area S.
If they wanted to explore Area S, they would definitely have to fight the mutated spiders head-on.
Fang Heng could not help but mutter in his heart.
What did this mean?
Why did he have to complete the mission in advance?
Fang Heng thought to himself, if he cleared the mutated spiders in advance and thoroughly searched Area S, would that count as completing the mission in advance?
Would it become very awkward the next time when the people from the Federation took a helicopter to Pine City?
“There’s one more thing, Fang Heng. Are you interested in the blood moon project? On behalf of the Federation, I would like to formally invite you to the blood moon project.”
“What is the blood moon project?”
Fang Heng frowned. This was the first time he had heard of this code name.
“Yes, this is a semi-public project of the federal government.”

“Its purpose is to save more important people during the blood moon. The people they are targeting are those who have made great achievements in various fields or have made significant contributions to the
Federation.”
“The Federation will do its best to provide them with protection in the game.”
Chen Yu explained patiently.
“The first round of the blood moon after the game opens is the most dangerous.”
“After joining the blood moon project, the Federation will provide you with a list of people. During the blood moon, the people on the list will move into your shelter.”
“Correspondingly, the Federation will also give a certain amount of subsidies to the major game guilds participating in the blood moon project.”
“The subsidies include funds, in-game points, resources and so on.”
Fang Heng understood.
He had also seen the data released by the Federation’s official website.
After the initial new server was launched, the death rate would rise sharply from the third day onwards, and then gradually flatten out.
Until the first round of the blood moon, the death rate of the players would reach a peak.
There were many hidden settings in the blood moon.
For example, under the blood moon state, the zombies would enter a berserk state, which would greatly increase their attack power, making it easier for them to sense the presence of the player.
Other than that, there was another very important point.
The more players gathered in a certain shelter, the more zombies would attack that shelter!
The death rate of the blood moon was high, and the Federation was racking their brains.
With these hidden settings, the Federation had no choice but to rely on the strength of the other gaming unions and gaming companies.
Fang Heng thought for a moment and asked, “How much time would there be before the first blood moon?”
Chen Yu sighed in his heart.
He thought that Fang Heng really didn’t care about the blood moon at all.
But that was also true.
With the strength of Fang Heng’s prison’s shelter, even if he went offline to take care of it, it would be easy for him to survive more than ten rounds of blood moon.
“10 days left.”
Fang Heng counted with his fingers.
10 days was a bit tight, so he might not have enough time.
He still had to stay in Pine City to farm monsters, so he might not be able to make it back to the shelter by then.
In addition, Fang Heng did not want too many people to know the secret of the shelter.
“Forget it, I won’t participate. It’s a bit too late.”
“Uh, well, I suggest you reconsider. If you change your mind, feel free to contact me.”
Chen Yu felt it was a bit of a pity. If it was Fang Heng’s shelter, it could help at least 50 people survive.
After hanging up, Fang Heng turned on his laptop and pulled out the video file from the game.
Fang Heng opened the video and started editing.
“Bang! Bang! Bang!!”
After quickly taking care of the two zombies, Fang Heng knocked open the door of the room at the end of the corridor with his shoulder.
In the room, Victor, whose back was facing the door, suddenly turned around.
“Who are you?”
“Are you the one who sent out the distress signal?”
“That’s right, it’s me. Are you a member of the Dark Knights?”
“Bang!”
With a gunshot, Victor was shot in the head and fell in a pool of blood.
In the Express Hotel, Old Black looked at the video that he received in his private mailbox.
Throughout the whole process, the main character of the video did not show his face, only his back.
“Hehe, what an interesting guy.”
Old Black rubbed his chin and laughed dryly.
He turned on his phone and found Fang Heng’s number to call.
“Fang Heng.”
Fang Heng was still lying in bed when he picked up the phone.
When he heard that it was Old Black, he immediately woke up.
“How is it? Have you received the thing I gave you? When will you give me the reward?”
“Fang Heng, I admire you very much.”
“Huh?”
Old Black sat on the chair, and the mouse fixed the video on a frame, zooming in on him several times.
“Unfortunately, your skills are still lacking. You’re too inexperienced. It’s still a bit difficult to deceive the employer with this.”
Fang Heng covered his forehead and sighed. “Really? After all, I’m just a newbie. Actually, I think it’s still okay...”
Old Black asked in a deep voice, “Is Victor dead?”
Fang Heng had already prepared his plan.
“I don’t know. What you saw was the video of my first meeting with Victor. When I went back for the second time, the hospital building was already occupied by the zombie horde.”
“I can’t go into the hospital, but I think he might be dead.”
Old Black was silent for a moment.
He also got some information about Victor from his employer.
The information was consistent with what Fang Heng said.
But Old Black still couldn’t tell if Fang Heng was lying.
“Alright, I’ll take the ‘material’ you provided.”
Old Black paused and said in a deep voice, “But there’s one thing, I hope Victor won’t appear outside at all.”
“I promise he won’t.”
Hearing this, a smile appeared on Old Black’s lips.
Fang Heng agreed a little too quickly.
Judging from this, there was a high probability that Victor had already fallen into his hands.
This was also good!
If the situation was one-sided, it would be difficult for the middleman to make money.
Old Black hoped that this pool of water would be stirred up as much as possible..

chapters.title: Chapter 189 - Splitting the Profits
paragraphs: He continued, “Fang Heng, I also need more ‘material’, including the video of your first meeting with Victor and some of the footage from when you entered the hospital.”
“T’ll edit your video and hand it over to the employer. It won’t be a problem to trick him.”
“No problem. I’ll give it to you later. Happy working with you.”

“You’re welcome. This is business. In addition, I’ll take 20% as the labor fee for modifying the video files, plus 20% as the middleman referral fee. In the end, I’ll split it: 60% for you and 40% for me.”
“That’s fine. Oh right, I also need some information related to mutated spiders.”
“10 King of Gods’ points.”
“No problem. Please draw it from the reward!”
“Okay, I’ll send it to you via email in two minutes. Remember to check it.”
Old Black said and hung up.
Looking at the video file on his computer, he suddenly thought of something funny and chuckled.
“Ha, what a bold kid. He still doesn’t know how important Victor is... | hope he won’t be scared when the time comes.”
On the other side, Fang Heng excitedly hung up the call.
ice!
Before going offline, Fang Heng asked Victor to help set up a video of him being shot to death.
Although he worked hard to modify the video, Fang Heng didn’t have much hope.
He just wanted to cheat his employer out of some money to spend.
He wanted to disgust that employer.
What if it succeeded?
He didn’t expect it to succeed!
Old Black, this middleman, was really ‘black’.
He even cheated his employer of his money!
However, getting freebies was really enjoyable.
60-40 split, and by then, he would get 300 King of Gods’ points for free!
First, he would cheat some money from the anti-federal organization.
Then, he would find an opportunity to sell the information of anti-federal organization member, Liu Keyi, to the Federation, earning double the money!
This transaction was worth it.
Fang Heng lay on his bed and suddenly did not feel sleepy anymore.
After he went offline yesterday, he fell asleep immediately and slept for more than ten hours.
Fang Heng simply got up and ate some breakfast.
He did not enter the game immediately. Instead, he turned on his computer and looked at the encrypted email sent by Old Black.
The content of the email contained detailed information about the mutated spider.
Fang Heng opened the email and read it carefully.
The mutated spider was a Tier 3 lifeform.
its various attributes were as strong as a Tier 2 Licker. Its climbing ability was even stronger than a Licker!
What was more troublesome was that most mutated spiders moved in groups. They would also spray highly corrosive mucus and spider silk.
Spider silk could slow down the movement of the enemy. It was very troublesome.
In addition, after the mutated spider died, small spiders would also be produced from its body.
After a player was bitten by a small spider, not only would his HP decrease, but the infection index would also increase significantly.
Fang Heng looked at every one of them carefully.
The mutated spider was a second-generation product. It was hatched from the first generation of the mutated spider’s mother.
The mother spider’s predecessor was a type of carnivorous spider called the Collin Tarantula.
After it was infected with the primogenitor virus, it mutated and formed the first generation of the mother spider.
After the infected mother Tarantula laid eggs, the second generation of the mutated spider was born.
The mother spider and the second generation of the mutated spider communicated through a special enzyme smell.
“Primogenitor virus... Mother spider...”
Fang Heng muttered to himself and continued to click the mouse to turn the page.
The information given by Old Black was rather detailed, and there were even many illustrations and pictures.
The mother relied on the corpse of a human or an animal to obtain nutrients and nurture the next generation.
In the habitat of the mutated spider, one could see a large number of white ‘cocoons’ that were surrounded by spider silk.
The ‘cocoons’ contained their ‘food’.

The next generation of life-forms that were born from the first generation of the mother spider would stay in the cocoons and continue to devour and digest nutrients until they grew into adults and broke out of the
‘cocoons’.
Fang Heng quickly flipped to the last page.
The weakness of the mutated spider was flames.
In addition, the mutated spider still had a great reaction to the pesticides produced by the Meteorite Company (causing great damage).
The tests found that the pesticides produced by the Meteorite Company contained a special component, nitrochloroform, which was the main culprit for the damage to the mutated spiders.
“Pesticides...”
Fang Heng muttered softly and closed the email.
He made a mental calculation.
This time, his target was the mutated spiders in Area S.
ff he could think of a way to kill all of them, he would be able to get a significant amount of survival points and evolution crystals.
Fang Heng lay back on the bed and pondered carefully.
Just as he turned over, his phone rang again.
it was Pei Anan calling.
“Boss Fang, did you know that North River Gaming Company has offered to cooperate with us?”
“Cooperate? North River Gaming Company?”
Fang Heng was dumbfounded.
n his impression, North River Gaming Company was an unknown gaming company.
However, behind this company was a powerhouse-North River Heavy Industry!
orth River Heavy Industry was the leader of the Northern Enterprises, a regional overlord.
That was strange. How did they find him?
Fang Heng was curious and asked, “What kind of cooperation?”

“It’s said that it’s an in-game offensive and defensive alliance. North River is willing to provide us with a large amount of funds and personnel support, including offline promotions and the like...”
ei Anan went to work early in the morning. She was a little stunned when she heard the news.
That was North River Heavy Industry!
When she was young, she would watch TV and watch advertisements about them.
What was even stranger was that the collaboration proposed by North River Gaming Company sounded unusually attractive. It gave people the feeling that they were trying to suck up to them.
Pei Anan felt that the other party might be a fraud.
“Oh right, Boss, their manager said that the manager of North River Gaming Company is your friend.”
“Friend, what’s his name?”
“Mo Jiawei.”
Fang Heng opened his mouth.
Understood.
Mo Jiawei was a rich second generation!
Fang Heng thought for a moment.
He could consider cooperating with them.
However...
“Did they leave their contact details?”
“Yes.”
Fang Heng asked Pei Anan for the number and immediately dialled it.
“God!”
Mo Jiawei had been waiting for Fang Heng’s call in the game. When he heard the phone ring, he immediately picked it up.
He had been prepared to hug Fang Heng’s thigh from the beginning.
“God, please cooperate. I’m in charge of the initial investment. I’ll follow you no matter what! When the time comes, I’ll give you some soup to drink.”
Mo Jiawei was very self-aware.
He felt that his biggest gain from entering Pine City this time was getting to know Fang Heng, the player who had opened a cheat. He even formed a team with him.
After returning to Pine City, he obtained the highest score for the entire main storyline mission! He had definitely crushed the two Federation players.
Of course, he was temporarily in the first place. After all, Fang Heng had not received the mission reward and was not counted in it.
Mo Jiawei knew very well that this was all thanks to Fang Heng.

The mission had counted him and Fang Heng as a team and they had earned quite a lot of team points. In addition, he had contacted various teams through the communication tower, the rescue of Barker’s team
mission and the missions of various teams had also been divided into a large number of mission contribution points.
Mo Jiawei also did the right thing by cleverly finding an excuse to help God fool the Federation!
Now, the people of the Federation thought that Fang Heng could control the Tyrant as a reward for completing a side mission.
Only he knew that Fang Heng controlled the Tyrant form with his capabilities!
With the Tyrant, wouldn’t he be able to do whatever he wants in the Zombie Apocalypse game?
He had to seize the upper hand before anyone else!
Mo Jiawei even felt that Fang Heng might become a powerhouse like the Federation, and it was very likely that he would carve up all the game districts with the Federation!
One had to know that the industrial output in the game was frighteningly high!
The earlier he got into the car, the greater the benefits he would receive in the end.
At that time, he would be able to drink a mouthful of soup to his heart’s content!.

ice!

its various attributes were as strong as a Tier 2 Licker.
