chapters.title: Chapter 190 - Materialization
paragraphs: Two days later.
Wei Guangling left Fang Heng’s work studio building.
After meeting with Fang Heng, the doubts in his heart were not solved but increased instead.
However, his goal had been achieved.
He confirmed Fang Heng’s ability and persuaded him to join the blood moon project.
In exchange, the Federation would provide Fang Heng with a helicopter.
Wei Guangling was very curious.
Why did Fang Heng need a helicopter?
A helicopter appeared to be very powerful, but the actual effect was not good.
That thing burned too much oil, and its weight-bearing was limited. It also needed to be equipped with a pilot.
Other than being able to climb over some dangerous terrain, a truck would be more practical.
“Ring, Ring...”
Wei Guangling picked up his phone.
“Yeah, we’re done talking. He’s on his way back.”
“It’s not bad. He has agreed to join the blood moon project.”
“Yes, it’s confirmed. The first stage of game materialization ability .”
“Yes, it hasn’t been recorded yet.”
“My suggestion is not to deal with it for now, but to file it internally.”
After saying a few simple words, Wei Guangling hung up the phone again.
Even though he had acted very naturally during the entire conversation with Fang Heng, however, Wei Guangling was experienced in the game and could quickly identify it.
Fang Heng possessed the first stage of game materialization ability.
The materialization ability in the King of Gods’ game was divided into many stages.
The first stage of materialization ability involved the mapping of the basic attributes in the game.
In reality, the player could inherit part of the attributes of the game character.
The Federation had been artificially controlling the game materialization ability since a long time ago.
All players who had the game materialization ability would be registered by the Federation.
From Fang Heng’s various performances in the game, Wei Guangling roughly judged that Fang Heng was a member of a neutral organization that was not under the Federation’s control.
There were quite several such organizations.
At the very least, Fang Heng had yet to show any signs of danger.
Usually, the Federation would secretly file a report on Fang Heng’s situation, observe him regularly and try their best to rope him in.
Fang Heng stood by the bed.
After watching Wei Guangling leave, he heaved a huge sigh of relief.
He had finally obtained the helicopter!
Then, he dialled Mo Jiawei’s cell phone again.
“Hello? God?”
“Is the pesticide ready?”
“It’s done!”
Mo Jiawei was excited.
He excitedly took credit from Fang Heng.
“I sent a mercenary to rob a batch of chemical plants that produce pesticides and got more than ten barrels of nitrochloroform. It’s expected to be delivered this afternoon.”
“Well done!”
Fang Heng’s eyes lit up and he praised Mo Jiawei.
The pesticide was a cover. The nitrochloroform mixed in it was the poison that would be truly effective in killing mutated spiders.
If there was a large amount of nitrochloroform, his plan could also be slightly modified to greatly increase the efficiency of farming monsters...
Fang Heng stroked his chin and continued to ask, “Are you interested in coming to Pine City to help?”
What?
Mo Jiawei was stunned.
“Didn’t we agree on a partnership? Come to Pine City and help me with something. This time, I guarantee you’ll make a profit.”
Mo Jiawei’s heart skipped a beat.
He had just escaped from that d*mned place in Pine City, and now he had to go back in again?
“Think about it. I don’t trust others on this matter, so...”
Mo Jiawei suddenly quivered.
A hint!
God was hinting at him!
Whether or not he could get into God’s good favours depended on his performance this time.
What was there to be afraid of! At most, he would die.
In any case, he had three lives. After he was resurrected, he would continue to rely on him.
Mo Jiawei immediately agreed.
“No problem! God, just say the word, and I’ll go to a mountain of swords or a sea of flames. When do I come over?”
“A mountain of swords and a sea of flames is not enough. Before I come here, I need you to prepare one more thing.”
“What is it?”
“The pilot.”
“Huh?”
Mo Jiawei was stunned.
What the hell was the pilot?
Three days after the Dark Knights left Pine City...
Victor was wearing the exoskeleton armour and standing in the middle of the hall on the first floor.
Looking around, he didn’t know whether to laugh or cry.
n three days, the hospital’s entire Building No. 3 had been reinforced by the zombie team controlled by Fang Heng.
This was not the end.
ow, the entire first floor had been completely transformed into a warehouse by Fang Heng.
More than half of the first floor was filled with materials collected by the zombies from the outside world.
tt should be good news.
At least for a short period, they would not be short of food and water.
Fang Heng was currently doing an inventory.
Hint: During the hacking period, you have obtained 206,000 survival points, evolution crystal fragments*36,000, complete evolution crystal fragments*2128, Tier 1 evolution crystal*11.]
Hint: During the hacking period, you have obtained firewood*273, scrapped cloth*513, broken jar*12, recipe*34, damaged battery*1, Green Army coat*2, pistol bullets*7261, pesticide*3... ]
After the Tyrant clone was left in a static position for 18 hours, Fang Heng had successfully obtained three Tyrant proliferators.
With four Tyrant clones, their strength had increased greatly!
Fang Heng also wanted to build a zombie pit or something.
But after thinking about it, it wasn’t very realistic.
The main problem was the lack of fuel. The other Tier 2 Lickers could easily jump out of the zombie pit.
tt wasn’t easy to deal with.

Therefore, Fang Heng could only use a stupid method. He divided the zombie team into four groups, each led by four Tyrant clones respectively. They directly used the hospital as the centre to farm monsters.
ow, the four zombie teams had been farming in Pine City for three whole days.
ot only did they gain a lot, but the density of the zombie horde in Pine City had also decreased by a lot.
Fang Heng crushed the eleventh Tier 1 evolution crystal he obtained from the hack and continued to search through the pile of materials.
Finally, he found all the books and tools in the miscellaneous pile.
Apart from more than 20 recipes, Fang Heng also collected a lot of blueprints of buildings, recipes and two skill books.
Skill book-Old Hunter.]
Description: Acquired skill after learning-Old Hunter.
Skill description: Triggered passively, increases 35% damage when attacking a beast; increases 20% critical strike rate and 30% hit rate when using a shotgun.
Skill book-Ammo Dump.]
Description: Acquired skill after learning-Ammo Dump.
Skill description: Active use, consumes 20 points of mental strength. In the next 60 seconds, your minimum firing interval will be reduced by 5/1.
Both skill books were D-level skills.
They were dispensable!
Fang Heng roughly glanced at the attribute of the two skill books and slapped them together with more than 20 recipes and blueprints on his forehead.
Hint: You have learned skill-Ammo Dump, skill-hunting, recipes*17, blueprints*7.]
Looking at the pile of materials that covered almost half of the first floor, Fang Heng could not help but sigh.
There might be some high-value materials among them.
But he was too lazy to sort them.
Even if he cleaned them up, it would be difficult to bring them back to the shelter.
“Victor, is there anything you can use?”
Victor looked at the pile of junk on the ground and felt a headache coming on.
“I probably won’t be able to use it.”
Victor said and threw a small and long iron nugget to Fang Heng.

chapters.title: Chapter 191 - Pesticide
paragraphs: “This is a signal device that I copied according to the badge. With it, the nemesis won’t attack you on her own.”
“Thanks.”
Fang Heng held the small iron piece in his hand and looked at it before stuffing it into his backpack.
“Fang Heng, are we going? It’s too dangerous there.”
“It’s fine. Maybe we can find some useful information inside. Maybe it can help treat Angel’s illness.”
“I’ve dragged you into this. Because of Angel’s matter...”
Fang Heng waved his hand.
“It’s nothing. I intended to go into the Meteorite Company to look for something.”
(Hint: Your favorability rating with Victor has increased significantly.]
Victor pointed at a few boxes that he had brought down from upstairs a while ago.

“By the way, these are energy crystals. The energy consumption of the exoskeleton device is too high. There are also a lot of weapon assembly parts stacked on the second floor. You’ll need to bring them all along.”
“Alright, leave it to me.”
Fang Heng nodded. He controlled the vine zombies to act as coolies to move boxes of energy crystals and mechanical assembly parts...
As the two of them were talking, the sound of a helicopter could be heard outside the square.
“Puff Puff Puff Puff Puff Puff...”
When he first got the helicopter from the Federation, Mo Jiawei even felt like he was dreaming.
God was too awesome. He even obtained the helicopter from the Federation.
Even though it was only a relatively basic helicopter and didn’t have much capacity.
In the co-pilot seat, Mo Jiawei looked down.
To pilot the helicopter here, Mo Jiawei had staked everything on it. He spent the last bit of honor points and directly recruited a pilot from the Dark Knights.
“Hiss...”
Mo Jiawei sucked in a breath of cold air.
The hospital square was densely packed with the zombie horde and Fang Heng was standing in the middle of these zombies.
Four big guys were standing beside him.
They were Tyrants!
Oh my god!
There were four of them!
Three more than the last time!
Seeing four Tyrants up close, the shock was even stronger than the last time.
Mo Jiawei’s heart was thumping. He was even more determined to cling to Fang Heng’s thigh.
After confirming Fang Heng’s safety signal, the helicopter landed steadily on the empty ground.
“Fang Heng, this...”
Walking out of the cabin, Mo Jiawei looked around.
He was stunned.
D*mn it, after a few days, Fang Heng turned this place into a shelter?
Fang Heng came up to them and said, “It’s been a long journey. Where are the items?”
“They’re all on the plane. A total of 13 barrels.”
“Well done!”
Fang Heng patted Mo Jiawei on the shoulder.
With the nitrochloroform that Mo Jiawei had brought, the final part of the plan was completed.
After a period of preparation, Fang Heng and the other two used the sewer to sneak into the Meteorite Company’s back garden in Area D.
This time, their goal was not to find the hidden Area S but to kill more mutated spiders and find a way to earn more Tier 1 evolution crystals.
Although there were many zombies in the city, high-level hunters like the Tier 2 Licker had powerful predator instincts.

There was a dull sound.

“Bang! Bang!”
Dull sounds were heard.
Tyrant’s attack was very straightforward. It grabbed the mutated spider with one hand and swung its fist with the other.

After clearing the mutated spiders in the back garden, Fang Heng commanded the zombie clones to climb up from the sewer with boxes of equipment.

“Let’s start, Victor. We’ll set up an ambush point here.”
Victor also looked around.
He nodded and said, “Okay, I need some time to prepare.”
According to the plan, Victor began setting up automatic cannons at the entrance of a building in Area D.
Fang Heng controlled the zombie clones to raise their shovels, digging a very shallow trench on the ground and pouring gasoline into the trench.

Tyrant’s strength was indeed very strong, but it was hard for two fists to fight four hands. If they were to deal with a large number of Tier 3 mutated spiders, there was a high chance that they would fail.
Fang Heng’s plan to farm monsters this time was very simple.
He had to think of a way to attract the entire Meteorite Company’s mutated spiders over.
Four Tyrants would seal off the exit of the building in Area D, and the automatic cannons would be the main output of the remaining forces.
More explosive packets would be buried in the ground.
n the event of an uncontrollable accident, they could immediately evacuate through the sewer.

“God, I brought over a dozen barrels of pesticide. Why is there only one barrel left?”
“It’s okay. I have plans. You’ll know soon enough.”

Fang Heng turned to look at Mo Jiawei and Victor.
“God, what’s next? Shall we stay here?”
“Yes, get ready. There’s going to be a tough battle.”
Mo Jiawei looked at the open door of the laboratory building.
“Er... but Fang Heng, what if the spider inside doesn’t come out?”
“It won’t. I have a plan.”
Fang Heng opened the game log as he spoke.
Long before he made the plan, Fang Heng had already learned from Victor about the circulating water supply system and the fire pump system of the Meteorite Company Park.
The water supply pipeline and the sewer partially overlapped.
After that, it was very simple.
He just needed to find a backup reservoir in advance and pour nitrochloroform into it.
Now, Fang Heng only needed to have the vine zombie guarding there manually turn on the automatic fire alarm water sprinkler device in the laboratory.
At that time, the pesticide would be sprayed out in the entire Area D experimental building!
Kill all those d*mn bugs!
Mo Jiawei didn’t know what Fang Heng had done. He blinked his eyes inexplicably.
The order was given.
Fang Heng waited in silence..

“Fang Heng, are we going?
It’s too dangerous there.”
“It’s fine.
Maybe we can find some useful information inside.
Maybe it can help treat Angel’s illness.”
“I’ve dragged you into this.
Because of Angel’s matter...”

“It’s nothing.
I intended to go into the Meteorite Company to look for something.”

There are also a lot of weapon assembly parts stacked on the second floor.
You’ll need to bring them all along.”
“Alright, leave it to me.”

He controlled the vine zombies to act as coolies to move boxes of energy crystals and mechanical assembly parts...
As the two of them were talking, the sound of a helicopter could be heard outside the square.
“Puff Puff Puff Puff Puff Puff...”
When he first got the helicopter from the Federation, Mo Jiawei even felt like he was dreaming.
God was too awesome.
He even obtained the helicopter from the Federation.
Even though it was only a relatively basic helicopter and didn’t have much capacity.
In the co-pilot seat, Mo Jiawei looked down.
To pilot the helicopter here, Mo Jiawei had staked everything on it.
He spent the last bit of honor points and directly recruited a pilot from the Dark Knights.
“Hiss...”
Mo Jiawei sucked in a breath of cold air.
The hospital square was densely packed with the zombie horde and Fang Heng was standing in the middle of these zombies.
Four big guys were standing beside him.
They were Tyrants!
Oh my god!
There were four of them!
Three more than the last time!
Seeing four Tyrants up close, the shock was even stronger than the last time.
Mo Jiawei’s heart was thumping.
He was even more determined to cling to Fang Heng’s thigh.
After confirming Fang Heng’s safety signal, the helicopter landed steadily on the empty ground.
“Fang Heng, this...”
Walking out of the cabin, Mo Jiawei looked around.
He was stunned.
D*mn it, after a few days, Fang Heng turned this place into a shelter?
Fang Heng came up to them and said, “It’s been a long journey.
Where are the items?”
“They’re all on the plane.
A total of 13 barrels.”
“Well done!”
Fang Heng patted Mo Jiawei on the shoulder.

chapters.title: Chapter 192 - Water Cannon
paragraphs: A few seconds later, his game log was filled to the brim with new notifications.
(Hint: Affected by the low-concentration pesticide you released, mutated spider received 28 damage.]
(Hint: Affected by the low-concentration pesticide you released...]
“Get ready, it’s coming!”
Fang Heng’s expression was solemn.
He called out and stared at the entrance of the building, setting up the automatic rifle.
“Ah?”
Mo Jiawei was still staring at Fang Heng in a daze.
Soon, he heard a sizzling sound coming from inside the building.
Were they coming?
In less than ten seconds, groups of mutated spiders rushed out of the experimental building!
Mo Jiawei was so shocked that his mouth was wide open, and his scalp went numb!
What the hell!
How on earth did Fang Heng do it?
The mutated spiders were stimulated by the pesticide, and rushed out of the gate crazily!
The four Tyrants blocking the gate immediately waved their fists and started to kill.
“Bang Bang! Bang Bang Bang!”
More than forty automatic cannons aimed at the gate fired at the same time.
“Fang Heng! They are too many, we can’t hold them off.”
A layer of cold sweat appeared on Mo Jiawei’s forehead.
The number of mutated spiders was beyond his imagination.
The four Tyrants at the entrance couldn’t hold on at all. A large number of mutated spiders crawled out from the cracks in the human wall formed by the Tyrants.
Besides the main entrance, a large number of mutated spiders crawled out from the windows of the building and climbed along the walls.
The scene looked particularly terrifying.
“Hehe, just in time! We’re just waiting for them to deliver themselves to us!”
As Fang Heng spoke, he pulled Mo Jiawei to the back of the bunker at the side and detonated the explosives that had been buried beforehand.
“Boom!!!”
An explosion.
Mo Jiawei had just hidden behind the bunker when his feet shook violently.
Explosives!
With such a big commotion, just how many explosives had he buried?
Mo Jiawei’s heart pounded wildly.
He carefully poked his head out from behind the cover.
This wave of explosion directly killed or maimed twenty to thirty mutated spiders!
The corpses left behind by the mutated spiders exploded one after another, and the second wave of tiny spiders crawled out from the mother spider’s body.
Mo Jiawei was about to throw a Molotov cocktail when he was stopped by Fang Heng.
“Don’t waste it.”
Fang Heng took out a lighter from his backpack and lit up the small ditch that he had dug beforehand.
“Chil!”
The fuel that was mixed in the ditch was ignited and formed a short wall of fire.
The small spiders were naturally afraid of flames. When they saw the flames, they all retreated.
After blocking the first wave of mutated spiders, the next step was much easier.
The automatic cannons rained bullets on the mutated spiders.
Fang Heng took out his automatic rifle and fired at the mutated spiders.
Hint: You have killed the mutated spiders. You have obtained survival points +23. You have obtained a complete evolution crystal*1.]
Hint: Your guns have hit a vital point and killed the mutated spiders. You have obtained gun mastery experience points +3.]
Hint: Your team member Victor controls the automatic cannon to kill the mutated spider. You gain survival points +6...]
ows of messages kept refreshing in the game log.
Fang Heng took a glance.
it was a good opportunity to take a good look at the gun mastery skill experience point.
Fang Heng raised his head and gulped down a bottle of concentrated Red Bull.
Hint: You have used concentrated Red Bull. For the next 60 minutes, your mental strength recovery speed will be increased by an additional 20%.]
Activate skill-Ammo Dump!
“Bang Bang Bang!”
The automatic rifle’s firing speed instantly increased by five times, and the gun skill experience points slowly increased.
While switching the magazine, Fang Heng turned his head.
He saw that Mo Jiawei was still using the rather weak small pistol, and could not help but curl his lips.
Mo Jiawei also noticed Fang Heng’s gaze and gave him a bitter face in response.
He was despised by the God...
Mo Jiawei was also very helpless.
He did have an automatic rifle, but his gun mastery level was too low, so he couldn’t equip it at all.
“Forget it, let’s try this.”
Fang Heng took out a water pistol toy from his backpack and handed it to Mo Jiawei.
“This...”
Mo Jiawei silently took the water pistol.
[Item: Duper deluxe air pressure type water pistol Gold Family pack commemorative home edition.]

Description: Produced by the Meteorite Company. It has the characteristics of large capacity, resistance to fall, long-range, bright colours and so on. For high-end players, you can return the item within 20 days
without any reason.
“Uh, okay... Thank you.”
Loading the pesticide, Mo Jiawei took the water pistol and sprayed at the mutated spider in the distance.
Needless to say, the lethality was much better than using a normal pistol.
After farming for more than two hours, the building finally quieted down.
No more mutated spiders came out of the building.
Fang Heng sat down on the spot, stuffed an Oreo biscuit into his mouth and handed over another pack.
“Here, have a taste?”
Mo Jiawei wiped the sweat off his forehead, then relaxed and sat down beside Fang Heng.
He was completely convinced.
This was the power of a God. He treated a Tier 3 mutated spider like a normal zombie and killed so many of them.
Fang Heng ate to recover his strength while counting the rewards.
“Heh, not bad.”
He had obtained 27 evolution crystal fragments.
He had only cleared Area E, after that will be Areas A, B, C and D, and even the hidden Area S.
Fang Heng felt that this game was quite interesting.
He squeezed hard, and the collected Tier 1 evolution crystal exploded one after another.
The purple-red mist was absorbed by his palm, and his level rose again.
Hint: Your character’s level has risen to Level 14. Due to your skills, you have gained an additional 20 zombie clones.]
The newly born zombie clones climbed out of the soil one after another.
Then, Fang Heng continued to control the zombie clones to collect items from the battlefield.
They picked up the items that dropped after killing the mutated spider and threw them in front of Fang Heng.
[Hint: You have obtained wrench*1, sharp hunting knife*1, mutated spider sac*6, Meteorite Company’s internal construction map*1, Meteorite Company’s reconstruction map*1, rusty scalpel*1...]
“So much rubbish...”
Fang Heng was mumbling when his eyes lit up.
Eh? Two maps dropped?
Fang Heng held the dropped maps in his hands and looked at them.
These two were professional construction maps, he couldn’t quite understand them.

Seeing this, Victor walked over and carefully examined them, he said, “Fang Heng, this map is the construction map used by the Meteorite Company when they were renovating five years ago. It may contain
information about Area S, I need to study it carefully.”
“Okay, okay.”
Just as Fang Heng agreed, the game hint suddenly sounded again.

Mission difficulty: SSS.
Completion rate: 100%
[Hint: You have triggered and completed the ninth stage ring mission-eliminate the mutated spider.]
Mission difficulty: SSS.
Completion rate: 100%

mutated spiders, you can try to explore the Meteorite Company in greater depth.
Mission difficulty: SSS.
Mission requirements: Try to find an anomaly in the Meteorite Company..

chapters.title: Chapter 193 - Triggered Ahead of Time
paragraphs: Mo Jiawei also received the game mission hint.
After the initial shock, he checked the mission description in detail.
Mo Jiawei was pleasantly surprised!
Oh my god!
It was a follow-up mission related to the Dark Knights!!
Furthermore, there were two of them!
And they were already completed!
He earned it big!
Just now, he had been paddling by the side, and without doing anything, he had already completed two SSS-level missions!
This time, he had come to Pine City for the right reason!
When he returned, his promotion to sergeant would be inevitable!
He looked at Fang Heng with admiration.
It turned out that everything was within the God’s plan!
Fang Heng was also looking at the mission description that he had just received.
As expected, just as Chen Yu had said, the next mission of the Dark Knights was still to investigate the Meteorite Company.
Since he had chosen to stay in Pine City, the next mission had been triggered and completed ahead of time...
This was good too. He had to think of a way to complete the mission ahead of schedule.
He also didn’t want to be harmed by the anti-federal organization.
Seeing that Fang Heng was thinking about something, Mo Jiawei asked in a low voice, “God, shall we take a look inside the experimental building?”
“Yes, let’s go in and take a look.”
Fang Heng closed the mission description.
After nearly two hours of continuous fighting, many automatic mechanical turrets had been damaged due to overheating.
Victor still needed to disassemble them and bring them back to the hospital for proper maintenance.
During this time, they could first go to the experimental building to roughly check the situation.
After discussing with Victor, Fang Heng left a Tyrant and a group of zombie clones to guard Victor. He led the three Tyrant zombies into the experimental building for preliminary exploration.

“Take this. I made a communication device earlier. The communication device has strengthened the signal’s penetrative power, but the range isn’t large. It should be able to communicate within the Meteorite Company. If you encounter any trouble, contact me immediately.”
“Impressive.”
Fang Heng received his communication device and gave Victor a thumbs up.
As expected of an S-level engineer, he was indeed impressive. He could create anything!
They stepped into the experimental building.
It was an old tactic. The three Tyrants led the way while Fang Heng followed behind.
Mo Jiawei held a water pistol filled with pesticide and cautiously followed Fang Heng.
The entire experimental building was still filled with the smell of pesticide.
The ground was sticky.
There were white spider webs everywhere.
The backup power source had already lost its effectiveness.
This caused the mutated spiders, which had been sealed inside, to completely invade the outside world.
Fang Heng took Mo Jiawei to the backup room in the fourth basement first.
He checked it carefully and found that the generators in the backup room had all stopped working
“Someone used the Meteorite Company’s main control room to turn off the backup power supply switches in all the areas.”
“This is the fundamental reason why the mutated spiders escaped.”
“What?”
Mo Jiawei had a baffled look on his face. He had never heard of anything related to the ‘spy’.
It was possible that Liu Keyi did it... in order to obstruct the Federation from completing the mission. Fang Heng did not explain further to Mo Jiawei. Instead, he was guessing in his heart.
“It’s nothing. There might be someone who doesn’t want us to complete the mission
easily.”

As he spoke, he switched the backup generator set to manual mode and activated the backup generator set in Area D. After repairing the power supply, Fang Heng and Mo Jiawei returned to the T-virus research room.
Lucia had once said that the secret passage to Area S was behind the T-virus laboratory and required a special password to open the passage.
Victor had also confirmed this point.
He used to be the chief engineer, and he had the entire design map of the Meteorite Company.
He found that many places on the design map were obviously strange.
Fang Heng walked along the end of the T-virus laboratory, then turned into a small room at the back and moved the cabinet away.
Mo Jiawei leaned over to observe.
He was confused.
There was only the floor under the cabinet, and nothing seemed to be there.
“Fang Heng, what are we looking for?”
“A secret passage.”
Fang Heng waved his hand while speaking, and more than twenty zombies behind him rushed up and smashed the floor.
“Bang! Bang! Bang!” Half an hour later, a small hole was made in the floor.
He shone his flashlight at the bottom of the hole, and found that it was a flight of stairs leading to the depths.
Looking at the dark entrance below, Mo Jiawei was pleasantly surprised.
“Is it the passage leading to Area S?”
“Yes, that’s right.”
Good God! So the God had already prepared it!
He just needed to follow behind.
The zombie clone knocked open the small holes, completely exposing the stairs leading to the bottom.
Fang Heng nodded at Mo Jiawei.
The two had just entered the underground passage when the game hint appeared again.
(Hint: You have completed the tenth stage of the ring mission, exploring the Meteorite Company.]
(Hint: Your ring mission reward will be accumulated. Please go to any Dark Knights’ contact point to find the person in charge of the area to receive the reward.)
(Hint: You have triggered the next stage of the mission-Secret Area S.)
Mission description: During the process of exploring the Meteorite Company, you have discovered the Meteorite Company’s special area-Area S.
Mission difficulty: SSS.
Mission requirements: Attempt to enter Area S for exploration (please do not destroy the main building).
Wow! That’s the third one!
Another SSS-level mission was completed!
Mo Jiawei felt that the feeling of hugging close to a powerful guy was too great!
Other rewards aside, just by relying on honor points, wouldn’t he be promoted to sergeant immediately after returning??
He stole a glance at Fang Heng beside him.
No wonder the God’s rank in the Dark Knights was so high.
How long had he been in Pine City? This speed of completing the mission was as if he had activated cheats.
Mo Jiawei became even more determined to cling onto his thigh and not relax.
The secret passage leading to Area S was very wide, enough to accommodate seven to eight Tyrants walking side by side. Just as he stepped into the passage, the automatic sensor light lit up.
The ground was very dry.
The automatic fire alarm sprinkler system didn’t affect this place.
After taking a few steps forward, there were more spiderwebs under his feet.
(Hint: You have entered an area covered with spiderwebs. Your movement speed will be slightly restricted. When you run, you will consume more stamina.) “This is a bit troublesome.”
Fang Heng could feel that the difficulty of the game had increased slightly.
“Be careful.”
“Okay, okay.”
Mo Jiawei tightened his grip on the water pistol in his hand.
As the passage gradually went deeper, the ground, walls and even the ceiling were covered with white spiderwebs. “Chi Chi Chi...”
Fang Heng’s eyelids twitched slightly. He keenly heard the faint sound of friction coming from the darkness in front of him.
“Coming! Be careful!”
As soon as he finished speaking, several brown-black shadows darted out from the inside of the passage.
It was the mutated spiders!
The difference was that under the dense spiderweb environment, their movement speed had increased significantly.
The three Tyrants blocked the front of the team and formed a blocking net. They raised their fists and swept forward.
“Bang!”
With a punch, the two mutated spiders that were charging forward were sent flying by the Tyrant.
After landing on the ground, the mutated spiders rolled on the ground a few times before quickly standing up and entering battle mode, charging towards Fang Heng and the others.
The remaining mutated spiders swarmed out along the passage.
The number was around 20-30.
Fang Heng quickly assessed the strength of both sides.
Just the three Tyrants would not be able to stop them.

chapters.title: Chapter 194 - Mutated Spider-mother Spider
paragraphs: “Back off. ”
Fang Heng grabbed MO Jiawei and pulled him back to the vine zombie army.
“Chi Chi Chi...”
In the next moment, the vine zombies extended their vines at the same time.
The vines gathered in front of the passage and quickly formed a wooden defensive barrier.
The defense net directly sealed the entire passage from top to bottom, and even
gradually thickened!
“Ah, this... This works?”
It was the first time that MO Jiawei had seen the vine zombies’ ability, so he couldn’t help but exclaim in disbelief.
Fang Heng raised his automatic rifle and poked out the muzzle from the gap of the wooden defense net that was connected by the vines, shooting at the mutated spiders!
Seeing this, MO Jiawei imitated Fang Heng and raised his water cannon. He used the gaps of the defensive web to spray pesticide on the mutated spiders.
“Swish!”
“Swish! Swish!”

Soon, the mutated spiders broke through the blockade line formed by the three Tyrants. They passed through the gaps left by the three Tyrants through the ceiling and pounced on Fang Heng and MO Jiawei.
The mutated spiders waved their enhanced forelimbs to launch an attack.
The vines blocked the attack, but a huge crack appeared on them.
Fang Heng switched to a shotgun and aimed at the mutated spider’s head at close range.
“Boom!!”
A headshot.
The mutated spider was smashed into pieces, and its corpse flew out.
MO Jiawei took out a Molotov cocktail and threw it at the corpse, bypassing the defensive web formed by the vines in front of him.
“Bang!”
The Molotov cocktail broke into pieces, and flames lit up on the ground, burning the small spiders that crawled out of the mutated spider’s corpse into ashes.
‘Well done.”
Their teamwork was not bad.
Fang Heng looked at MO Jiawei.
It took more than ten minutes.
This wave of mutated spiders was completely wiped out.
“Phew...”
MO Jiawei didn’t care about the disgusting spider web on the floor, and just lay down on the ground.
It was too freaking thrilling.
He had never felt that he was so strong!
In the past, he would run as far as he could when he saw a Tier I mutated zombie.
D*mn, now he even had the guts to deal with a Tier 3 mutated creature!
After tidying up his harvest, Fang Heng put the three Tier 1 evolution crystals dropped by the mutated spiders into his backpack.
“Let’s continue.”
They continued forward.
At the end of the passage, there was a safety door on the right.
The two pushed the door open and entered.
Was it sealed?
There was still a large area on the right behind the safety door.
However, due to the collapse caused by the explosion, the entire right side of the passage was completely sealed.
“There’s no way out?”
The passage on the left reached the end after five to six meters. There were still a few more rooms.
Fang Heng entered the room to roughly search, but he did not find any anomaly.
Strange, why was there no way out?
Fang Heng took out his communicator and tried to contact Victor.
After a series of noisy electrical sounds, Victor’s voice came from the communicator.
“Fang Heng?”
“Victor, can you hear me?”
“Yes, there are a lot of noises but I can hear you.’
Fang Heng nodded and roughly described what he had encountered earlier on.
On the other end, Victor also took out the construction blueprints that he had obtained from the mutated spider and compared them.
“Mm, Fang Heng, based on what you’ve said earlier, I’m guessing that you’re currently at the passage leading to Area S.”
“Follow the passage on the right and you’ll be able to reach the elevator 20 meters ahead. Take the elevator directly to Area S.”
“But the passage is sealed.”

“Yes, I suspect that after the outbreak of the biochemical virus, the Meteorite Company, for reasons of confidentiality, detonated all the entrances to Area S, completely hiding Area S in the depths of the Meteorite Company.”
Fang Heng frowned and said, “Now we can’t go in?”

“Theoretically, all the passages to Area S had been destroyed. If you want to go in, you can only enter through the cargo elevator passage of the Meteorite Company’s internal factory. It’s very difficult to seal that place with explosives.” “The cargo elevator of the internal factory? How do I get there?”
‘You need to return to the previous main passage.”

“Look carefully. There’s a ventilation duct in the penultimate section. You can enter through the ventilation duct and leave through the second exit. That’s the storage room on the third floor of the freight passage.”
“After entering the storage room, confirm the environment condition first. The power supply system at the freight passage might not be working.”
“Okay, I got it...”
After hanging up, Fang Heng nodded and said to MO Jiawei, “Let’s go back and take
a look.”
Following Victor’s suggestion, the two of them went back the way they came.
The entrance of the ventilation duct was entangled by a spider web. If Victor didn’t remind them, it would be hard for them to find it.
To be safe, Fang Heng let the vine zombies drill the duct in advance.
After confirming that there was no danger, the two of them followed the vine zombies into the duct.
After a while, the two of them drilled out of the ventilation duct and went to another storage room.
Opening the door of the storage room, Fang Heng poked his head out.
The outside world was the Meteorite Company’s internal secret factory.
The storage room was built on the third floor.
Standing on the high ground, they could see the overall situation of the factory hall on the first floor.
MO Jiawei’s face instantly turned pale.
What kind of monster was that?!
A giant spider body was occupying the entrance of the cargo elevator on the first floor below!
Its body was unusually large, at least five to six meters in size!
Apart from that, the factory hall on the first floor below was filled with densely-packed mutated spiders and white cocoons.
[Hint: You have completed the 11th stage of the ring mission, Secret Area S.]

[Hint: Your ring mission reward will be accumulated. Please go to any Dark Knights’ contact point to look for the administrator to receive the reward.] [Hint: You have triggered the next stage ring mission-the mother spider.]
Mission description: You have encountered the mother spider on the way to Area
s.
Mission difficulty: SSS.
Mission requirements: Enter Area S without destroying the main building.
It was too crazy!
Seeing the game hint, MO Jiawei felt that the game was insane!
Not only was there a dense cluster of mutated spiders, but there was also a mother spider that was ten times larger than an ordinary zombie.
What made people feel extremely creepy was that the mother spider was covered with red eyes.
Even the joints of the limbs had strange eyes.
The red eyes opened and closed rhythmically.
“Fang Heng... This...”
“Shh, keep it down.”
Fang Heng gently closed the door, leaving only a small gap.
“Use your skills to check.”
“Okay.”
MO Jiawei took a deep breath and forced himself to calm down. He covered his right eye and looked down.
“Mutated spider-mother spider.

“The mutated mother spider creature was infected by the progenitor virus. It has low-level intelligence and is the leader of the spider community. It controls the population by secreting a special biological enzyme.”
“To expand the population, the mother spider treats zombies as its feed, but the living humans can provide it with the greatest nutrition.”

“As it is responsible for breeding the entire population, the mother spider’s evolution is somewhat special. Its attack ability is not strong, and its movement speed is unusually slow. However, its skin will secrete a very powerful poison.”
“The mother’s red eyes are its weakness. Other than that, the mother spider’s weakness is its fear of flames and pesticides containing nitrochloroform.

chapters.title: Chapter 195 - D*mn! Its Never Ending
paragraphs: As Mo Jiawei spoke, he couldn’t help but swallow a mouthful of saliva.
He carefully turned his head to look at Fang Heng, even his voice was slightly trembling.
“Fang Heng, it, it’s a Tier 5... Tier 5 mutated creature...”
“Chi Chi Chi Chi...”
The group of spiders below seemed to have noticed Fang Heng and the others, and they all turned their heads in their direction.
“Retreat.”
Fang Heng quickly closed the door and locked it.
Fortunately, the mutated spiders didn’t chase after them.
The two of them fell silent.
Mo Jiawei’s heart was beating wildly.
What the hell! That was a Tier 5 creature!
Tier 5!
The mission difficulty jumped another level.
In the Zombie Apocalypse game, Mo Jiawei had heard that the top-tier creature was the Tier 5 Corpse King.
That terrifying monster could destroy a large shelter with hundreds of people by itself!
He didn’t expect to see a creature of the same level with his own eyes today!
MO Jiawei flipped through the mission hint again and again.
Fortunately, the mission didn’t require them to kill the mother spider by force.
There was still a chance!
It was also possible to find a way to lure the mother spider away from the factory’s delivery passage or to use some method to put it into hibernation.
While he was pondering, MO Jiawei raised his head and looked at Fang Heng.
If it was God, there should be a way...
MO Jiawei asked in a low voice, “Fang Heng, why don’t we think of a way to spray some pesticide to drive the mother spider away from here? It’s probably feasible?”
“Yes.”
Fang Heng was also observing the mission hint.
He nodded lightly.
Using pesticides to drive away the mother spider was feasible.
There was a chance of success.
However...
It was not easy to see a Tier 5 creature. If he did not think of a way to extract a live sample from its body, would he be able to sleep well at night?
He could even...
He could even think of a way to kill it?
Fang Heng was inexplicably tempted.
In the past, when he killed a Tier 4 creature for the first time, he could get a skill book reward.
If he killed a Tier 5 creature, there was no reason why he could not get a reward, right?
Moreover, the reward was higher than killing a Tier 4 creature!
Fang Heng pondered over it carefully.
Creatures of the same tier were not equally strong.
For example, the Licker and the ordinary Tier 2 enhanced zombie had a huge difference in strength.
After all, the Licker had been trained by the Meteorite Company to fight from the start.
And from MO Jiawei’s introduction, the mutated mother spider was the product of an accidental leak of a virus.
Its initial evolution direction was not to fight but to reproduce.
A large part of its strength came from its race.
Finding a way to eliminate its race would greatly weaken its strength.
“How can I...”
Fang Heng muttered to himself.
“What?”
MO Jiawei did not hear Fang Heng’s whisper.
He would never have thought that Fang Heng had already begun to think about how to counter-kill the Tier 5 mutated mother spider to earn a reward.
What a joke. Kill a Tier 5 mutated spider?
Wasn’t he courting death?
Fang Heng patted MO Jiawei on the shoulder and decided to think about the battle plan after he went back.
“Let’s go back first.”
“Yes, our lives are more important. Let’s go back quickly.”
MO Jiawei nodded repeatedly.
He felt that the God was still very steady in doing things. When he knew that he couldn’t do it, he wouldn’t force himself to do it.
He would retreat and think of a countermeasure before coming back.
“Let’s clean up Area E first.”
After more than two hours of discussion with Victor, Fang Heng gave an answer that puzzled MO Jiawei.
MO Jiawei was confused.
“Huh? Area E?”
What was the situation with the God? He didn’t think of a way to chase away the mutated mother spider to complete the mission, but instead was trying to farm monsters?
Fang Heng was indeed not in a hurry.
Anyway, he didn’t have a good way to deal with the mother spider.
Besides, the main storyline mission was right there, no one would fight with him.
First, he would farm all the mutated spiders in the other areas of the Meteorite Company to earn more survival points and evolution crystals. Then, he would level up.
“By the way, the pesticide you brought may not be enough. I need more.”
MO Jiawei understood what Fang Heng meant. He nodded and said, “Alright, I’ll go order now and ask the mercenary to help me collect it. I’ll go back to collect it once I’ve purchased it.”
“Okay, thank you for your trouble.”
“I’m just running errands. It’s a small matter.”
Ever since the game had opened the server transfer function below Level 5, a large number of players and mercenary groups had moved into Server 8.
MO Jiawei felt that this matter was much simpler than the water cannon.
It was just a matter of moving his fingers and spending more money to place orders on the platform.
There would be many players and mercenary guilds helping him gather materials.
Using money to exchange for Dark Knights honor points, he would make a good profit from this deal!
Just nice, he could also hand in the mission when he went back and raise his Dark Knights’ military rank.
MO Jiawei thought happily.
As for the God’s plan, he didn’t want to think about it even if he didn’t understand it.
Since he was already on the God’s ship, he could just hug his thigh and finish the job.
At worst, he could just follow behind the God with a water cannon!
Three days later.
Other than Area S, the five areas within the Meteorite Company had already been cleaned up.
During this period, the mother of the mutated spiders had a short-lived anomaly.
A large number of mutated spiders crazily rushed out of the building and attacked
Fang Heng and the others.
Unfortunately, in the end, this attack was mercilessly suppressed.
After cleaning up the outer park, Fang Heng led the zombie team to find trouble with the mutated spiders.
Later on, MO Jiawei saw Fang Heng’s wondrous operation.
MO Jiawei would never forget it.
Fang Heng first commanded the zombies to dig a passage from the entrance of Area S to the storage room.
Then, he pulled a power cord from the fourth basement and set up a turret sniper line in the passage...
Then, he lured the monsters...
And killed them...
And this went on and on.
At this time, in the secret passage of Area S.
Seeing Fang Heng excitedly going to the storage room to lure the monsters, MO Jiawei sighed in his heart, picked up the water pistol and followed him.
He couldn’t remember how many times this was.
From being scared at the beginning to walking on thin ice and being careful later on...
Until now, MO Jiawei’s state of mind was very calm, as if he was going downstairs to pick up a delivery.
He felt a bit sorry for the Tier 5 mutated spider mother that was left in the factory’s delivery passage.
Fang Heng’s operation made MO Jiawei feel a bit of a pain in the ass.
Initially, because the densely packed spiders were all mutated spiders, after discussing, they decided to take care of them in batches. Wave after wave of monsters was taken care of in batches.
But the plan could not keep up with the changes.
The mutated spider mother’s reproduction speed was extremely fast!
Fang Heng had just attracted a wave of mutated spiders, but before they could finish farming, a new batch was produced, occupying the entire internal factory.
At that time, MO Jiawei felt that the plan had completely failed.
But he did not expect Fang Heng to be extremely excited.
Time and time again, he worked tirelessly to lure out the mutated spiders from the factory delivery area, and then lured them to the passage to kill them!
After being provoked, the mutated mother spider would be stimulated, and quickly breed a new batch of mutated spiders.
The mutated spiders once again chased and attacked Fang Heng crazily.
This went back and forth, as if on repeat mode.
A batch of monsters was lured out.
And then killed.
Another batch of monsters was lured out.
And killed again.
During the short rest, they had to repair the damaged automatic turret.
Another batch of monsters was lured out.
And killed again...
It was as if it would never end..

sentences.text: As Mo Jiawei spoke, he couldn’t help but swallow a mouthful of saliva.
He carefully turned his head to look at Fang Heng, even his voice was slightly trembling.
“Fang Heng, it, it’s a Tier 5...
Tier 5 mutated creature...”
“Chi Chi Chi Chi...”
The group of spiders below seemed to have noticed Fang Heng and the others, and they all turned their heads in their direction.
“Retreat.”
Fang Heng quickly closed the door and locked it.
Fortunately, the mutated spiders didn’t chase after them.
The two of them fell silent.
Mo Jiawei’s heart was beating wildly.
What the hell!
That was a Tier 5 creature!
Tier 5!
The mission difficulty jumped another level.
In the Zombie Apocalypse game, Mo Jiawei had heard that the top-tier creature was the Tier 5 Corpse King.
That terrifying monster could destroy a large shelter with hundreds of people by itself!
He didn’t expect to see a creature of the same level with his own eyes today!
MO Jiawei flipped through the mission hint again and again.
Fortunately, the mission didn’t require them to kill the mother spider by force.
There was still a chance!
It was also possible to find a way to lure the mother spider away from the factory’s delivery passage or to use some method to put it into hibernation.
While he was pondering, MO Jiawei raised his head and looked at Fang Heng.
If it was God, there should be a way...
MO Jiawei asked in a low voice, “Fang Heng, why don’t we think of a way to spray some pesticide to drive the mother spider away from here?
It’s probably feasible?”
“Yes.”
Fang Heng was also observing the mission hint.
He nodded lightly.
Using pesticides to drive away the mother spider was feasible.
There was a chance of success.
However...
It was not easy to see a Tier 5 creature.
If he did not think of a way to extract a live sample from its body, would he be able to sleep well at night?
He could even...
He could even think of a way to kill it?
Fang Heng was inexplicably tempted.
In the past, when he killed a Tier 4 creature for the first time, he could get a skill book reward.
If he killed a Tier 5 creature, there was no reason why he could not get a reward, right?
Moreover, the reward was higher than killing a Tier 4 creature!
Fang Heng pondered over it carefully.
Creatures of the same tier were not equally strong.
For example, the Licker and the ordinary Tier 2 enhanced zombie had a huge difference in strength.
After all, the Licker had been trained by the Meteorite Company to fight from the start.
And from MO Jiawei’s introduction, the mutated mother spider was the product of an accidental leak of a virus.
Its initial evolution direction was not to fight but to reproduce.
A large part of its strength came from its race.
Finding a way to eliminate its race would greatly weaken its strength.
“How can I...”
Fang Heng muttered to himself.
“What?”
MO Jiawei did not hear Fang Heng’s whisper.
He would never have thought that Fang Heng had already begun to think about how to counter-kill the Tier 5 mutated mother spider to earn a reward.
What a joke.
Kill a Tier 5 mutated spider?
Wasn’t he courting death?

“Let’s go back first.”
“Yes, our lives are more important.
Let’s go back quickly.”
MO Jiawei nodded repeatedly.
He felt that the God was still very steady in doing things.
When he knew that he couldn’t do it, he wouldn’t force himself to do it.
He would retreat and think of a countermeasure before coming back.
“Let’s clean up Area E first.”
After more than two hours of discussion with Victor, Fang Heng gave an answer that puzzled MO Jiawei.
MO Jiawei was confused.
“Huh?
Area E?”
What was the situation with the God?
He didn’t think of a way to chase away the mutated mother spider to complete the mission, but instead was trying to farm monsters?

Anyway, he didn’t have a good way to deal with the mother spider.

chapters.title: Chapter 196 - The Last Wave
paragraphs: Mo Jiawei felt that if it were any other player, they would be driven crazy by repeating the same routine over and over again.
However, Fang Heng seemed to be enjoying it.
To be more precise, he was enjoying it endlessly.
Mo Jiawei carefully glanced at Fang Heng beside him and thought to himself, “Terrifying
God!”
Fang Heng was indeed enjoying it.
It had been a while since he had slept properly, so he would occasionally rest for an hour or two while Victor was repairing the automatic cannons.
His eyes were bloodshot.
But he was extremely excited! Fang Heng felt as if he had discovered a BUG in the game and had completely grasped the password to wealth!
That’s right! Get those crystals!
At first, Fang Heng only thought of luring a wave of mutated spiders out and slowly reducing the number of mutated spiders in the periphery.
But he didn’t expect that after he dealt with the wave of mutated spiders that he lured out, and returned to the place...
Oh god!
A new wave of mutated spiders spawned again!
Oh god!
He has picked up these survival points and evolution crystals for free!
Fang Heng immediately began the crystal collection plan.

Every time he lured out a wave of mutated spiders, he would receive over a thousand survival points and around 10 Tier 1 evolution crystals, plus some low-tier crystal fragments and additional income from recipes.
It was a no-cost business!
It was a sure win!
Fang Heng had already begun to think.
Could he think of a way to control the zombies to design a fully automatic monster-hunting system?
It was fully automated. He just needed to sit by the side and wait for the rewards.
The two of them went to the storage room again.
As usual, Mo Jiawei opened the door of the storage room with a small gap.
“Eh?”
It was different from the previous times!
This time, the number of mutated spiders at the bottom of the factory decreased!
Mo Jiawei let out a soft exclamation.
The number of mutated spiders didn’t respawn?
It has reached the upper limit?
Awesome!
It turned out that there was an upper limit to the reproduction of the mutated mother spider!
Everything was under the control of the God!
They spent two days and one night to reach this critical point.
Mo Jiawei looked back at Fang Heng with excitement.
The God was bold and patient!
Who else could do it other than him?
As long as they finished dealing with the large number of mutated spiders below, they could attack the mutated mother spider!
But...
Mo Jiawei blinked his eyes in confusion.
But why did the God’s expression not look too
good?
Beside him, Fang Heng’s expression instantly darkened.
No more?!
Not giving birth?
Not letting him feel good?
Could it be that his action of farming monsters had been discovered? The loophole had been sealed?
Fang Heng was rather displeased. He said to Mo Jiawei, “Try to lure another wave.”
“Mm.”
According to the plan, Mo Jiawei skillfully took out a Molotov cocktail from his backpack and threw it towards the place where the mutated spiders gathered below.
“Bang!”
The Molotov cocktail shattered and an area on the ground burned violently.
Attracted by the Molotov cocktail, the mutated spiders all turned around and looked at the place where Mo Jiawei was hiding.
Mo Jiawei gave them a middle finger.
Then he turned around and ran.
Huh?
Mo Jiawei turned his head and started to walk, then he stopped again.
Something was wrong.
He realized that there was no sound of friction behind him.
What was going on?
Mo Jiawei turned around.
This time, the mutated spiders didn’t pay attention to Mo Jiawei’s provocation. They quietly stayed where they were.
Did the taunt fail?
“Fang Heng, what... what’s going on?”
“Tsk... prepare to use backup plan No. 2.”
Fang Heng gritted his teeth. He thought to himself, “You’re not going to let me get what I want, right?!”
“Then don’t just lie there!”

Fang Heng had already prepared a backup plan. He opened the game log and controlled zombie clone No. 9 to carry out the action plan. A moment later, the vine zombie group came up with a water pipe with a large-diameter nozzle.
The end of the sprinkler was connected to a long water pipe.
The other end of the water pipe was connected to the underground sewer pump outside the Meteorite Company.
Fang Heng nodded at Mo Jiawei.
“Come on, let’s start.”
Mo Jiawei took the water pipe from the zombie team and wiped the sweat off his forehead.
“D*mn it...”
This thing was much more powerful than the water pistol in his hand.
Fang Heng helped open the door of the storage room.
Mo Jiawei pulled the water pipe and threw it through the gap in the door.
Fang Heng opened the water pipe valve. “Sizzle sizzle...”
A large amount of pesticide liquid mixed with nitrochloroform poured down from the third floor like rain.
When the pesticide fell on the mutated spiders, they instantly exploded as if they were in a frying pan.
The mutated spiders frantically ran in the direction of Fang Heng.
It worked!
“You run first!”
Fang Heng tightened the valve again and calmly looked back at the group of mutated spiders chasing after him.
This time, there were more mutated spiders than before!
Good!
Fang Heng felt exhilarated internally and ran back with Mo Jiawei.
After running back for more than 50 meters, the four Tyrants blocked the intersection in unison.

Fang Heng and Mo Jiawei immediately hid behind the Tyrant and hid in the wooden defensive net made of vine zombies. “Bang! Bang, Bang, Bang!!” The automatic defense turret set up in the pathway opened fire at the same time.
Fang Heng also set up his automatic rifle and activated the “Ammo Dump” skill, while at the same time brushing up on his basic shooting.
(Hint: Your team member Victor relied on the automatic turret to kill the mutated spider. You have obtained survival points*21, complete evolution crystal fragments*1.]
(Hint: Your zombie clone (Tyrant vine fusion form) killed the mutated spider. You have obtained survival points*19, evolution crystal fragments*1.)
(Hint: Your shot has hit a vital point. You have obtained gun mastery skill experience points +2...]
Another row of notifications appeared in the game log.
For the past few days, Fang Heng had been farming the mutated spiders for three days and two nights relentlessly, obtaining a large number of Tier 1 evolution crystals.
His character level had risen to Level 16. Excluding the proliferators, there were already 168 zombie clones.
Not only that, even the extremely difficult basic shooting skill level had risen to Level 9!
In less than half an hour, a wave of mutated spiders had been cleared.
Fang Heng waved his hand, and all the evolution crystal fragments on the ground were crushed and sucked into his palm.
“Bang! Bang! Bang!!”
(Hint: You have obtained evolution crystal fragments*12, complete evolution crystal*31, Tier 1 evolution cystal*14.]
(Hint: You have absorbed the power of a Tier 1 evolution crystal.]
Fang Heng had planned to use the pesticide water pipe tactic to deal with the final mutated mother spider.

Now that there was a change in plan, the effect was surprisingly good. Fang Heng was in high spirits. He rubbed his hands and ordered the zombie team to continue waiting for orders, then walked toward the storage room. It was still early, and he could still farm a dozen more waves today...
Level 17 was not a problem.
“Let’s go, let’s continue.”
Looking at Fang Heng, who was still in high spirits, Mo Jiawei silently put away the water pistol.
Perhaps this was the secret of the God’s success!
The God was so strong and had worked so hard, so he had to work hard too.
Mo Jiawei patted his cheeks and forced himself to cheer up.
But...
Mo Jiawei lowered his head and looked at the water cannon in his hand.
This thing doesn’t add gun mastery skill experience points at all!

chapters.title: Chapter 197 - You’re Not Going to Let Me Get My Way, Right?
paragraphs: Just like drawing a tiger after modelling the cat, Fang Heng went back and forth three times.
During this time, Mo Jiawei even took the time to go offline and have supper.
When he came back, the fourth wave of mutated spiders that were lured out was also eliminated by Fang Heng.
“Let’s go! Continue, continue, continue!”
Fang Heng was now unusually excited.
After using pesticides to attract the mutated spiders, his efficiency had doubled!
Mo Jiawei couldn’t hold on any longer. “God, why don’t we take a break and continue farming tomorrow?”
“Huh?”
Fang Heng looked at the time.
It was not even 1 am.
He looked at his character’s experience points again.
What a joke!
He was just a little bit away from Level 17. If he didn’t level up to this rank, would he be able to sleep at night?
Looking at Mo Jiawei’s haggard face, Fang Heng shook his head. “Alright then, this is the last time!”
Mo Jiawei rubbed his dazed eyes.
He couldn’t help but sigh in his heart.
God is God, he is full of energy!
With the thought of “this is the last time”, Mo Jiawei followed Fang Heng back to the storage room.
Opening the door to the internal factory, Mo Jiawei was completely shocked.
What the hell!
The mutated mother spider had moved!
Perhaps due to the huge size of its body, its spider legs appeared very thin and weak, and the speed of its movement was extraordinarily slow.
This scene made Mo Jiawei somewhat unable to believe it.
It was going to escape?
The mutated mother spider was escaping?!
Was this also part of God’s plan?
Crazily killing the mutated spiders, then using pesticide...
He could even chase the mutated mother spider away?
Mo Jiawei turned to look at Fang Heng again, his eyes filled with admiration.
This was God!
However, he did not see any joy on Fang Heng’s face.
Instead, he saw Fang Heng gnashing his teeth, looking very unhappy.
Fang Heng was gnashing his teeth in hatred.
He was very unhappy now.
Run?
He was only a little bit away from reaching Level 17, but the mutated mother spider was not reproducing anymore?
It was also trying to run away?
Of course, Fang Heng didn’t want to let it go.
“Go!”
Receiving Fang Heng’s order, the four Tyrant zombie corpses caught up from the passage behind them.
They rushed out of the storage room and jumped down from the third floor.

“Bang! Bang! Bang!!” The Tyrants were not afraid of death. After landing on the ground, they directly rushed in front of the slowly crawling mutated mother spider. They raised their fists and smashed at it.
It seemed that the mutated mother spider did not resist at all. It could only continue to be beaten.
The game log continued to refresh with rows of hints. Fang Heng lowered his head to observe and analyze.
(Hint: Your zombie clone (Tyrant vine fusion form) causes damage to the mutated mother spider.]
(Hint: Your zombie clone (Tyrant vine fusion form) receives poison damage.]
(Hint: Your zombie clone (Tyrant vine fusion form) receives poison...)
The mutated mother spider’s movement was slow, and it did not possess very strong offensive abilities.
It used its enhanced sharp limbs as its main attack method.
And then there was the poison!
The mutated mother spider’s skin could secrete a layer of poisonous mucus as protection.
As the Tyrant threw a punch on the mother spider, it ended up poisoning itself and had a portion of its HP reduced.
Fang Heng flipped through the game log and instantly cheered in his heart.
This was good!
Tyrant form had fused with the vine body’s characteristics. Its HP was high and its recovery speed was also fast.
It was not afraid of its HP being depleted slowly!
Fang Heng immediately felt at ease and hid behind the rear with Mo Jiawei to supervise the battle.
The Tyrant form punched into the flesh of the mother spider.
It endured the mother spider’s poison damage and continued to pummel the latter.
Not long after, the Tyrant’s HP fell to a certain extent, and it immediately entered Tier 2.
The Tyrant’s hands transformed into sharp tentacles and its strength was enhanced once again.
Mo Jiawei watched from the side, his heart palpitating with fear.
At first, he wanted to quickly go offline to rest, but now he didn’t feel sleepy at all.
His mood became more and more uneasy, and he became more and more excited...
He unconsciously clenched his fists.
There’s a chance!!
Tyrant was too strong!
Good heavens, if this continued, wouldn’t the mutated mother spider be pressed to the ground and beaten!
Could it be...
That there was a chance to kill the mother of the mutated spiders?

The four Tyrant forms were battling with the mutated mother spider for nearly two hours. Every time the Tyrant’s HP fell to a certain level, Fang Heng would control it to withdraw from the battle and rest at the side.
When the negative effect of the poison on the Tyrant disappeared, its HP would fully recover. Then, it would continue to engage in a round of battle.
At this moment, the mother spider looked extremely weak.
It looked like it was about to die.
“Oh right, I almost forgot.”
Fang Heng controlled a Tyrant form that was watching the battle to recover its HP and walked over, throwing a live sample at it.
The Tyrant form took the sample collector and strode forward, quickly walking to the side of the weakened mutated mother spider.
“Chi!”
The live sample collector fiercely pierced the skin of the mutated spider mother.
(Hint: Your zombie clone (Tyrant vine fusion form is currently in the process of collecting a live sample...)
(Hint: You have received poison damage, collection status interrupted, collection failed!)
This...
Due to the poison on the skin, the Tyrant was unable to collect a live sample.
It was fine if he didn’t collect evolution crystals from the mother spider.
But now, he couldn’t even get a live sample from it?
Fang Heng felt that the mutated mother spider had always been going against him.
Then what was the point of keeping it?
Kill it!
With this thought, Fang Heng turned around and returned to the storage room. He picked up the water pipe on the ground and threw it down from the third floor.
A Tyrant strode forward. It picked up the water pipe with one hand and stuffed it into the mouth of the mother spider.
Fang Heng turned his head and immediately pressed the water pump switch. “Chi Chi Chi!!!”
Water in the water pipe continuously gushed out from the nozzle. The mother spider struggled violently, but it was firmly held down by the four Tyrant forms.
After being forcefully injected with pesticides, the entire body of the mother spider rapidly expanded.
The pesticide mixed with light green blood flowed out from the red eyes on the mother spider’s body! The data in the lower right corner of Fang Heng’s retina refreshed over a dozen rows.
(Hint: Affected by the pesticide, the mutated mother spider’s HP has decreased.]
(Hint: Affected by the pesticide...]
“Bang!”
A minute later, the mutated mother spider’s body had doubled in size!
It finally couldn’t take it anymore, and its entire body exploded with a bang.
The stinky pale green blood and broken limbs sprayed over half of the factory. “It’s... dead?”
Mo Jiawei had already guessed that the mutated mother spider might die, but he still couldn’t believe it when he saw it in front of his eyes.
The Tier 5 mutated creature had been taken care of!
In the next second, numerous young spider bodies crawled out from the broken limbs of the mutated mother spider.
“Chi Chi Chi!”
The baby spiders crazily rushed toward the nearest living beings, including the Tyrant form.

They climbed onto the Tyrant, and once they stuck to it, they would self-destruct crazily. “Bang! Bang! Bang!!” The corrosive liquid produced by the self-destruction of the baby spiders on the Tyrant form was extremely wasteful.
“Don’t just stand there. Quick, close the door!”
Fang Heng neatly took out his machete and cut the rubber hose. With a bang, he closed the door of the storage room to prevent the baby spiders from flooding into the room.
Even now, Mo Jiawei still felt like he was dreaming
He turned to look at Fang Heng and asked, “Is it settled?”
“What?”
“We killed a Tier 5 mutated creature?” Mo Jiawei felt like he hadn’t done anything, so he helped to move the water pipe and brought some materials over.
At most, he could only use the water cannon to help. How did they kill a Tier 5 creature out of nowhere?

chapters.title: Chapter 198 - Killing the Mother Spider
paragraphs: Fang Heng wasn’t too sure either. “It should be dead, right? Wait till you see the game log’s hint.”
Mo Jiawei nodded.
That was true. After all, it was a Tier 5 creature. Who knew if it had any special resurrection methods.
In just a few seconds, a few game notifications flashed across Mo Jiawei’s right retina.
(Hint: Your team has killed a Tier 5 mutated spider-mother spider.]
(Hint: As the first player to kill a Tier 5 creature, you will receive a skill book (Level: A-) reward according to your contribution quota.)
(Hint: Skill book is randomly being drawn... you have obtained A-level skill-Nightwalker (soul binding).]
The hint has arrived!
It was a successful kill!
An A-level skill book!!!
They were rich!
Looking at the rewards, Mo Jiawei felt his heart twitch violently.
He was so happy that he was about to faint.
He had made a huge profit!
An A-level skill book!
Mo Jiawei did not even look at it. He directly picked up the skill book and patted it on his head.
“Awesome...”
With this pat, Mo Jiawei felt that his entire body had been sublimated from head to toe.
He felt that coming to Pine City this time was absolutely right! This was how the game was supposed to be played, this was how hugging a thigh was supposed to be!
At this moment, Fang Heng was also observing the game hint from the side.
(Hint: Your zombie clone has killed the mutated mother spider (Tier 5), you receive high energy crystal*1(purple).]

(Hint: As a player team that has killed a Tier 5 creature for the first time, your reward will be distributed according to the contribution quota. You will receive an additional highest level reward.]
(Hint: You have obtained a random skill book (Level: S-) reward.)
(Hint: Skill book is being randomly drawn...]
(Hint: You have obtained a random skill book-low-level vampires (soul binding).]
It was an Sskill!
Fang Heng was shocked.
His previous unhappiness was completely swept away. This was the first time Fang Heng had seen an S-level skill book in the game.
He remembered that a long time ago, this body had seen a player post an S-level skill book on the forum.
Before he could click on it, the thread had been deleted by the moderator.
There was a huge leap in the level of skills, from B+ to A-!
Fang Heng’s breathing was a little hurried. He held back the excitement in his heart and clicked on the skill description.
(Skill book: Low-level vampires (soul binding).)
Description: After using the skill, you will automatically grasp the vampires’ bloodlines. Soul binding, cannot be traded.
Type of skill: Bloodline type
(Description: Player can have multiple bloodlines at the same time, but some bloodlines cannot be owned at the same time.)
Level of skill: S-.
Level restriction: This skill can be upgraded to Level 15. (the current highest level of the skill cannot exceed the player’s current level. Player can find a way to upgrade the bloodline.)

Skill description 1: After learning the skill, you will immediately gain an additional 100% maximum HP, strength +1, agility +5, physique +1, perception +1; you will gain strength skill level *0.3, agility skill level*1, physique skill level*0.3, perception skill level*0.1.

Skill description 2: Vampires can gain strength by devouring blood. By devouring blood, they can gain 150 HP recovery speed, and an increase in skill experience points per second (the gain of skill experience points is related to the energy in the blood).

Skill description 3: Vampires have powerful self-healing and night vision abilities. Player gains normal night vision ability. Under non-sunlight environment, player gains 5 HP recovery speed per second. Under non-combat condition, player gains 10 HP recovery speed per second.
Skill description 4: Additional 10% damage when hit by light attribute attacks. Player is immune to all critical hits except for the heart. “It’s actually vampires...”
Fang Heng was very surprised. This was also the first time he saw a skill related to vampires.

He was very sure that if this book was in the Vampire Apocalypse, its value would be immeasurable! Even in the Zombie Apocalypse, the strength of the skill book would be enough to crush an A-level skill book.
Soul binding item could not be traded. Even if Fang Heng could, he would not use it to trade.
Learned!
Who knew if he would enter the world of vampires in the future?
(Hint: You have learned a skill-Vampire Bloodline.]
The effect was obvious. After he patted the skill book on his head, Fang Heng instantly felt his body become lighter than before.
But it was a little strange.
Fang Heng flipped through the skill description again.
Most of the skills he had learned in the past were skills that increased experience points through proficiency.
In other words, the more he used them, the faster his experience points would grow.
However, the skill of vampires had a new and clear description.
To level up a skill, one needed to devour blood to gain strength.
Blood-sucking?
The scene of vampires sucking blood from the movies in Fang Heng’s previous life appeared in his mind.
No way! Did he have to drink blood?
Fang Heng found it hard to accept mentally and physically.
“Eh?”
“No way!”
Fang Heng suddenly had an idea.
Didn’t he have a zombie clone?!
The zombie clone had also inherited the skills of the vampires.
According to the usual pattern, the experience points gained by the zombie clone would be transferred back to him.
With that thought, Fang Heng controlled a zombie clone to stagger out of the storage room.
The factory outside the storage room had already returned to normal.

The four Tyrants had been badly injured by the last spider’s self-destruct attack, and were slowly recovering their HP. Fang Heng found a piece of the mutated spider’s carcass on the ground, then forcefully ordered the zombie clone to swallow it.
The zombie clone picked up a piece of the carcass and began to chew on it.
Soon, a game hint sounded.
(Hint: Your zombie clone has swallowed a part of the blood.)
(Hint: The blood has been diluted and decayed. It doesn’t have strength.] “Eh... The blood is decayed...”
Fang Heng was a little disappointed as he murmured. “Decayed” referred to zombies?
“”‘It can’t absorb strength from the blood of zombies?”
Fang Heng felt a little regretful. The good news was that his previous guess was right. He could indeed use the zombie clone to drink blood to level up his skill.

“Forget it. I’ll do some more experiments when I get back. I’ll let the zombie clone eat some animal blood to try again.” Mo Jiawei also finished testing his new skill, Nightwalker, and walked to Fang Heng.
He was going to go offline after killing a wave of mutated spiders, but he didn’t expect to waste two more hours in a BOSS fight.
Mo Jiawei’s eyes were bloodshot like Fang Heng’s.
However, his spirit was extremely excited.
Just a single A-level skill book was enough to make him so excited that he could not sleep for several nights!
Not to mention that they had already taken care of the mutated mother spider. Meteorite Company’s mysterious Area S was right in front of them!
What good stuff was in Area S?!
How could he sleep if he went offline now!
“God, Let’s go in and take a look?”
Mo Jiawei pointed at the cargo elevator not far away.
“Yeah, let’s go take a look.”
Fang Heng had the same thought.
He was also very curious about Area S.
There must be treasures inside!
