chapters.title: Chapter 199 - Primogenitor Virus
paragraphs: Walking into the elevator with Mo Jiawei, Fang Heng checked the cargo elevator. Very good, the backup power source was still on.
Fang Heng nodded at Mo Jiawei.
“It’s still working!”
“Great!”
Mo Jiawei waved his fist, even more, excited than Fang Heng.
When the four Tyrants and more than 30 zombie clones crowded the elevator, Fang Heng pressed the ‘Down’ button.
The elevator slowly descended.
A few rows of new notifications appeared in the game log.
(Hint: You have completed the twelfth stage ring mission: the mother spider.]
(Hint: You have successfully killed the mother spider. You have completed an additional mission. You will receive an additional reward at the end of the mission.]
(Hint: Your ring mission reward will be accumulated. Please go to any contact point of the Dark Knights to look for an administrator to receive the reward.]
(Hint: You have triggered the next stage of the mission-secret information.)
Mission description: Please search Area S, find the relevant mission documents and hand them over to the Dark Knights.
Mission difficulty: E.
Looking at the new mission hint, Fang Heng was relieved.
The next stage of the mission difficulty was only Level E. This meant that the risk was very small, almost negligible.
“Dong!”
The cargo elevator landed at the bottom of Area
The scene in front of Fang Heng made him frown.
Most of Area S had been buried by the ruins after the explosion.
Only a laboratory at the front of the passage could be entered.
The Tyrant form pushed the door open and entered first.
Fang Heng followed behind and turned on the flashlight to illuminate the room.
The laboratory was in chaos, two-thirds of the area had collapsed.

After confirming that there was no danger in the laboratory, Fang Heng waved his hand. The zombie team behind him began searching the entire laboratory. Soon, the zombie clones threw all the items they found in front of Fang Heng.

(Hint: Your zombie team has searched the secret research room. You have obtained an unknown liquid sample*1, data-primogenitor virus, high-level energy crystal*3). “Primogenitor virus... it should be the mission item.”
Fang Heng murmured in a low voice and tried to open the primogenitor virus file.
After opening it, he found that the dense text on the file couldn’t be read smoothly.
Fang Heng immediately understood.
The file was encrypted.
It seemed that he needed to return to the Dark Knights to get the follow-up information.
Fang Heng thought about it and put away the
file.
“How is it?”
On the side, Mo Jiawei asked curiously.

“The Dark Knights are looking for this primogenitor virus file, but it’s encrypted. I don’t know what’s written in it.” “Primogenitor virus? The mutated spider mother we encountered before was infected by the primogenitor virus, right?”
“Yes, you’ve heard of the primogenitor virus?”
“I did a little research when I went offline before. The relevant information is relatively small. The T-virus and G-virus were both developed from the primogenitor virus.”
“Alright.”
Fang Heng looked at the other two items that he had collected from the laboratory.
[Item: Unknown potion*1.]
Description: This drug does not have a label on it. It is impossible to determine what it is. It needs to be further identified. It is not recommended to use it directly.
[Item: High-level energy crystal*3.]
Description: The latest technological product of the Meteorite Company. It forms a stable cube-shaped crystal. A crystal the size of a fist can provide a powerful energy supply.
Fang Heng held the three blue transparent stones in his hands and looked at them.
“They are all strange things.”
It was still alright if it was an unknown potion. If he brought it back and threw it to Qiu Yaokang, he would most likely be able to analyze what it was.
But what the hell was this blue stone?
Providing energy? He had never heard of how such a high-level energy crystal was used.
Anyway, it was something found in the top secret research room of the Meteorite Company. Pack it up and take it away!
After thinking for a while, Fang Heng stuffed them into his backpack.
The mission in Pine City was almost completed.
It was about time to return to the shelter.
Unfortunately, the mutated mother spider was not very strong.
Fang Heng had planned to level up to Level 19 here, but he had not even reached Level 17!
From Level 10 to Level 19, the game required a Tier 1 evolution cystal to level up.
As for what would happen after Level 19, Fang Heng did not know. All the information available on the forum was up to Level 19.
It seemed to be a watershed.
Fang Heng had a vague feeling that after Level 19, there might be some changes in the way the game leveled up.
Seeing that Fang Heng was still in a daze, Mo Jiawei couldn’t help but ask, “God, the mission has been completed. Should we prepare to go back?”
“Yes... it’s about time.”
Fang Heng nodded and ordered the zombie clone to follow. “Let’s go back first.”
Thanks to Mo Jiawei’s help, the construction of the sterile ward in the shelter could be completed in two days.
The actual evacuation would take another day or two.
He couldn’t stay idle for the next two days!
Fang Heng thought carefully again.
The mutated spiders had been cleared, and the Meteorite Company had been searched thoroughly. The creatures in the entire city had also cleared quite a few times.
Most of the places in Pine City had been mostly cleared.
It was considered to be cleared, right?
Hmm?
“Wait, I seem to have forgotten something?”
Fang Heng’s eyes lit up as he murmured to himself.
“Oh right! I almost forgot, there was still the nemesis!”
Fang Heng unconsciously licked the corner of his mouth.
The nemesis held the key to Tyrant’s next tier evolution, it was very valuable for research!
If it was possible...
It would be best...
To bring the nemesis back to the shelter with him.
As soon as this thought arose, Fang Heng couldn’t help but ponder. It seemed to be really feasible!
Currently, he had four Tyrant clones.
Whether he could kill the nemesis or not, the four Tyrants could easily pin the nemesis to the ground and hammer it.
But how could he bring it back to the shelter?
Fang Heng narrowed his eyes and muttered to himself.
“Federation...”
Fang Heng thought of the Federation.
He remembered that during the mission in Hope Town, he had seen the Federation use a special anesthetic.
That anesthetic successfully put Alex into a coma for a period of time.
If he could get this drug from the Federation, it was not impossible to knock out nemesis completely and bring it home for research.
For some reason, when he saw the strange smile on Fang Heng’s face, Mo Jiawei, who was taking the elevator, inexplicably shivered.
During this period, Chen Yu had been busy with the blood moon project.
He had no choice. His superiors had given him a death order.
The lives of these Federation talents and important political figures were extremely precious.
The Federation would do its best to ensure their safety.
The arrangements of the personnel were extremely tense. Chen Yu scratched his head, thinking that he should stuff these people into those corners.
In the end, there was really no other way.
Chen Yu thought of that place.
Fang Heng’s prison shelter. Not only was there the protection of the Dark Knights, there was also a huge sentry tower!
Not to mention 50 people, even if the number was doubled, it would not be a problem to accommodate 100 people!
But how could he convince Fang Heng?
Speaking of which, Fang Heng was still in Pine City. He did not know how his situation was.
Just as he was thinking, Chen Yu’s phone rang.
Was it Fang Heng?

chapters.title: Chapter 200 - Three Steps
paragraphs: It was very rare for Fang Heng to take the initiative to call.
Chen Yu could not help but be surprised.
“Hello? Fang Heng?” “Yes, I need the help of the Federation.”
Chen Yu was overjoyed when he heard that.
Was it a request for help?
A request for help was good!
Wasn’t this sending himself to his doorstep!
Just as he was thinking of how to ask Fang Heng for help, now that there was an opportunity, Chen Yu was instantly in a great mood.
“Fang Heng, we’ve worked together so many times. If you have anything to say, just say it. I’ll try my best to help you think of a way.”
“Em, I remember that last time in Hope Town, you used a special potion that could make a Tier 4 zombie, Alex, fall into a coma.”
“Do you have something similar that can make the nemesis fall into a coma?”
Chen Yu fell into momentary silence.
His first reaction was that Fang Heng was going to start some brilliant plan again.
Why did he need the anaesthetic?
Could it be...
Got it!
Fang Heng wanted to make a move on the nemesis!
That was the strongest type of zombie corpse among the Tier 4 zombies!
“How is it? Do you have it?”
“Yes, we do. However, apart from the formula, some special materials require King of Gods’ points to purchase. I need to report to my superiors, so...” Fang Heng understood.
“As soon as possible. I want them tomorrow. What do you want in exchange?”
“Okay, then I won’t stand on ceremony. How about adding another 50 people to the blood moon project?”
Chen Yu didn’t waste any time. He gritted his teeth and asked, “Fang Heng, only you can help me with this. I need you to add another 50 people to your shelter.”
Fang Heng made a rough estimate in his mind.
The strength of the blood moon zombies would increase with the number of players in the shelter.
At most, there would be 100 more people. With the current strength of the shelter, it wouldn’t be a problem at all.
“Okay, when can you get it ready?”
“I’ll go and report it now. I’ll get it by tomorrow afternoon!”
Done!
Hearing Fang Heng agree, Chen Yu breathed a sigh of relief.
Another big problem was solved!
The next day, Fang Heng took a helicopter back to the shelter.
There was no need to waste time here.
According to Fang Heng’s expectations, the sterile ward of the shelter would be built in about two days, and he could also get the special anaesthetic provided by the Federation.
At that time, he could return to Pine City and bring Victor and his daughter to his shelter.
Just to be cautious, Fang Heng left two-thirds of his zombie clones and the Tyrant form in Pine City.
The remaining one-third of the zombie clones stabbed one another to death!
As for Mo Jiawei, he would be staying in Pine City with Victor.
In case of danger, Mo Jiawei could communicate with Fang Heng offline.
The other thing was the nemesis. What should he do with it?
Sitting in the copilot seat of the helicopter, Fang Heng had been thinking about this question.
It was quite simple. There would be three steps. The first step was to knock the nemesis out.
The second step was to move the nemesis back.
The third step was to find a high-intensity experimental container and load the nemesis in it for research purposes.
The first step of knocking out the nemesis would be settled by using the Federation’s special potion.
As for the second step which was to transport the nemesis, that would be challenging.
The nemesis was huge. It was still uncertain if it could be lifted in a helicopter.
The key was that the Federation’s special potion was not very effective. A slight shake could wake the nemesis up.
He had to think of a more reliable method.
Four hours later, the helicopter slowly landed at the Dark Knights’ gathering point.
Barker had already received the news of Fang Heng’s return. He brought a few members of the Dark Knights over to welcome him.
“Fang Heng! It’s great to see that you’re alright.” Barker warmly greeted Fang Heng. “Let’s go in and talk.”
Back at the Dark Knights’ camp, Fang Heng roughly told Barker what had happened in Pine City and handed him the mission document.
After that, Barker looked at Fang Heng and fell into a long silence.
During this period, their entire Dark Knights team was preparing for the next operation to invade Pine City.
The original plan was for the Dark Knights to send out an elite team of about 60 people.

The research team was still researching and creating weapons and tools to deal with the nemesis and the mutated spiders. The problem was that the higher-ups of the Dark Knights disagreed on this matter. They were discussing whether it was necessary to spend such a huge price to enter Pine City to investigate.
Barker was still having a headache about this matter.
He did not expect Fang Heng to suddenly appear and personally tell them that they did not need to go to Pine City.
Great, he didn’t have to be troubled by this matter now, and the higher-ups did not need to quarrel anymore.
Would they believe that the mission was completed?

The Tier 5 mutated mother spider had already been destroyed by Fang Heng, and the secret information had already been obtained... The Dark Knights had sent out more than ten teams for this mission which they failed to complete and in the end, they had come back in a sorry state...
The mission was eventually completed by Fang Heng alone.
And it was completed in a perfect state.
After a long time, Barker sighed deeply.
He did not know why but he still felt a sense of loss.
A smile appeared on Barker’s face again.
“You gave me another huge surprise. I never thought that you would be able to do this. I can only say that you are a genius, Fang Heng.”
“Lucia is right. You can change our world.”
(Hint: Your favorability rating with Barker has greatly increased.]
As Barker spoke, he opened the research manual of the primogenitor virus that Fang Heng had collected from Area S of the Meteorite Company and read it carefully.
“We had originally planned to infiltrate Pine City again in a few weeks to investigate.”
“During this period, the Dark Knights are still assessing the risks of infiltrating Pine City and looking for ways to deal with the nemesis and the mutated spiders.”
“I didn’t expect you to have completed the mission ahead of time... how should I put it, it’s beyond our expectations and you have been a great help.”
Fang Heng waved his hand without any modesty.
“It’s no big deal. Just leave it to me in the future.”
“By the way, what does this document say?”
Barker shook his head and closed the document.
“It should be the highest-level secret of the Meteorite Company. They used encryption methods.”
“I will immediately pass it to a professional to decipher it. I estimate that it will take some time. I will contact you immediately when I have news.”
“Okay.”
“Also, let’s take a look at your mission reward this time.”
“You have done very well. The Dark Knights will never treat their people unfairly. If you have any needs in the future, you can tell me. I will try my best to help you.”

“I’m
rich!”
Fang Heng was overjoyed.
The Dark Knights’ honor points were very valuable!
